title: HR & Corporate Relations- Immediate Joiners only
description:

Location: Bengaluru – Work From Office

Company: SIEM XPERT

Experience: 2–5 Years (Immediate Joiners only)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Package: 5-9LPA

Working Hours: Monday to Saturday (2 Saturday Off)

SIEM XPERT is looking for an HR & Corporate Relations who can independently handle day-to-day HR operations while also building strong corporate relationships for placements, corporate collaborations and corporate training opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

HR & People Management

\* Manage end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, attendance, leave management, employee engagement and exit processes.

\* Handle employee concerns, grievances and day-to-day internal issues independently.

\* Monitor employee performance, KRAs/KPIs and follow up with teams on accountability.

\* Manage hiring requirements across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Trainers and other departments.

\* Conduct candidate screening, interviews, salary discussions and offer coordination.

\* Maintain HR policies, SOPs, employee records and documentation.

\* Handle employee feedback, performance discussions and workplace concerns.

\* Ensure a positive, professional and productive work environment.

\* Coordinate employee engagement activities and internal initiatives.

\* Provide regular HR and employee-performance updates to management.

Corporate Relations & Placements

\* Build relationships with HR teams, Talent Acquisition teams, hiring managers and cybersecurity leaders across organizations.

\* Develop corporate tie-ups for placement opportunities for SIEM XPERT students.

\* Connect with companies to understand their current and upcoming cybersecurity hiring requirements.

\* Coordinate candidate profiles, interviews, placement drives and hiring activities.

\* Build and maintain a strong database of corporate hiring partners.

\* Regularly follow up with companies for new job requirements and placement opportunities.

Corporate Training & B2B Collaborations

\* Identify and approach organizations for corporate cybersecurity training opportunities.

\* Connect with HR, L&D, Talent Development and Cybersecurity teams.

\* Understand client requirements including training topics, technologies, number of participants, skill level, delivery mode and timelines.

\* Coordinate with trainers and management to develop suitable training solutions.

\* Support corporate meetings, proposals, commercial discussions and follow-ups.

\* Build long-term relationships with corporate clients for recurring training and collaboration opportunities.

\* Participate in relevant corporate/networking events and represent SIEM XPERT professionally.

What We’re Looking For

\* 2–5 years of relevant experience in HR, Corporate Relations, Talent Acquisition, Placement/Corporate Connect or similar roles.

\* Strong experience in recruitment and employee management.

\* Excellent communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills.

\* Strong LinkedIn networking and corporate outreach skills.

\* Ability to independently manage employee issues and take ownership.

\* Comfortable communicating with HR Heads, Talent Acquisition teams, L&D teams and senior corporate stakeholders.

\* Experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Training or EdTech will be preferred.

\* Experience in placement tie-ups, corporate training or B2B partnerships will be a strong advantage.

If you enjoy people management, corporate networking and building long-term business relationships, we would love to connect with you.

📩 Interested candidates share their CV at sulabh.mishra@siemxpert.com

Mention- Current and Expected CTC, Notice Period (If any)

title: Assistant Vice President Human Resources
description:
**WHO ARE WE?**

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

**CloudSEK's Product Suite**

* **CloudSEK XVigil**
  constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
* **CloudSEK's BeVigil**
  is a powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. It uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
* **CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil**
  identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

**Key Milestones**

* **2016:**
  Launched our first product.
* **2018:**
  Secured Pre-series A funding.
* **2019:**
  Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
* **2020:**
  Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
* **2021:**
  Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
* **Awards & Recognition:**
  Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
* **2025:**
  Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

**About the job**

At CloudSEK, performance, culture, and happiness are not separate — they are deeply linked.

We are building a company where people do the best work of their careers, and we want someone who owns that outcome end-to-end.

The Chief Happiness Officer(Director/AVP HR) is accountable for keeping our teams engaged, motivated, focused, and performing at a high level — while ensuring we retain our best people and build a culture that compounds over time.

This is not a “feel-good HR” role. This is a systems + culture + performance role.

**What you will own**

1. Measure what matters

You will build the instrumentation to continuously track:

• Engagement, morale, burnout, and energy levels

• Manager effectiveness and team health

• Attrition risk, regretted exits, and retention of top performers

• Alignment to company mission, clarity of goals, and execution focus

You will turn these into dashboards, signals, and early-warning systems — not once-a-year surveys.

2. Build feedback and improvement loops

You will design and run:

• Continuous feedback systems (pulse surveys, 1:1 frameworks, skip-levels)

• Clear escalation and resolution loops for friction, conflict, and disengagement

• Manager coaching programs to improve leadership quality across the company

Your job is to detect problems early and fix them before they impact execution.

3. Identify, grow, and retain top performers

You will:

• Build a clear, fair system to identify high performers and high-potential talent

• Ensure top performers are recognized, rewarded, and developed faster than the rest

• Design retention strategies for critical talent

• Work with leadership on promotions, growth paths, and succession planning

Your outcome: our best people feel seen, valued, and challenged — not ignored or burned out.

4. Design a culture that scales

You will:

• Codify and reinforce our cultural values through rituals, stories, and behavior systems

• Ensure culture is consistent across geographies, teams, and growth stages

• Remove incentives and behaviors that create politics, fear, or low-trust environments

• Build a company where speed, ownership, integrity, and excellence are the norm

Culture is not posters — it’s what people do when no one is watching. You will shape that.

5. Partner with leadership on org design and people strategy

You will work closely with:

• The CEO and leadership team on org health and structure

• Managers on team effectiveness and leadership quality

• HR / People Ops on compensation, performance, and growth systems

You will bring data, insight, and perspective to leadership — not just execution.

**What success looks like**

• High engagement and energy across teams

• Low regretted attrition, especially among top performers

• Managers who are trusted, effective, and respected

• A culture that attracts strong talent and repels low-integrity behavior

• A company where people do great work and want to stay

**Who you are**

• 12+ years in people leadership, culture, org design, or performance roles (startup / tech preferred)

• Strong systems thinker — you can design feedback loops, metrics, and processes

• Deep empathy + high standards — you care about people, but you don’t tolerate mediocrity

• Comfortable with data, dashboards, and analytics

• Confident influencing senior leaders and holding them accountable

• High integrity, low ego, extremely trustworthy

• You genuinely care about helping people do their best work

**Benefits of Joining CloudSEK**

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

* Flexible working hours.
* Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.
* And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!

**CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.**

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
About SIFANG

SIFANG is a leading provider of power system protection, automation, power electronics and energy storage solutions. Founded in 1994 and headquartered in Beijing, we generated approximately USD 1.1 billion in revenue in 2025 and rank No. 2 in China and among the top five globally in power system protection and automation. Our technologies help utilities, renewable energy developers and industrial customers build safer, smarter and more sustainable power systems.

We are looking for a hands-on HR Manager to support the growth of our Philippines team. Your priorities will be engineering recruitment, university partnerships and campus hiring, supported by dependable HR operations and a team environment where employees can develop and work well together. You will partner with local managers and our International HR team.

What you will do

* Lead recruitment for electrical engineers, field service engineers and other local positions, covering sourcing, interviews, offers and onboarding.
* Build working relationships with universities, engineering faculties and career offices. Coordinate campus recruitment, internships and graduate hiring.
* Develop local talent pipelines through direct sourcing, employee referrals, professional networks and recruitment partners.
* Manage employee documentation, probation, HR records, attendance, leave and exits. Keep local HR processes clear and consistent.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, benefits administration and HR service providers. Support local salary benchmarking and compensation reviews.
* Guide managers on performance discussions, learning needs and employee relations. Organize onboarding and team activities that support communication and belonging.
* Apply company HR policies in line with local requirements and provide timely updates on recruitment, staffing costs and employee concerns.

What you will bring

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* At least 5 years of progressive HR generalist or HR business partnering experience, including responsibility for recruitment and HR operations.
* A demonstrated record of hiring engineering or technical talent in the Philippines and coordinating campus or graduate recruitment.
* Practical knowledge of Philippine employment requirements, payroll coordination, benefits administration and employee relations.
* Strong communication skills in English and Filipino, with the ability to work across local teams and international stakeholders.
* A practical working style, sound judgment and the ability to follow through on several priorities with limited supervision.

Preferred experience

* Experience in electrical engineering, power equipment, renewable energy, industrial technology or engineering services.
* Experience strengthening HR processes in a growing local team. Mandarin language skills are a plus.

title: Senior Manager - Organisational Culture Assurance
description:
**Job Purpose:**
The Organizational Culture Assurance Analyst develops A&A’s behavioral and risk analytics capability, delivering data-driven insights that strengthen assurance planning, audit execution and enterprise risk oversight.
  
  
The role acts as the technical and analytical lead for Organizational Culture Assurance and wider A&A analytics initiatives, combining expertise in data analytics, visualization, behavioral indicators, organizational data and emerging AI-enabled analytical approaches.
  
  
Working across A&A, Human Resources, Compliance, Risk Management and business leadership teams, the role develops analytical products that identify organizational conditions, behavioral patterns and emerging risks which may impact business performance, governance effectiveness and risk management outcomes.
  
  
The role plays a central part in delivering A&A's Organizational Culture Assurance model through:
  
  

* Development of organizational Culture dashboards to support audit teams.
* Creation of enterprise behavioral and risk intelligence products for senior leadership and governance forums.
* Advanced analytics supporting targeted organizational culture assurance & Insights reviews.
* Integration of data-driven behavioral insights into assurance planning, testing and reporting.

The role serves as a center of excellence for behavioral and assurance analytics and helps position A&A as a leading-edge assurance function that combines traditional audit techniques with advanced analytics and organizational insight.
  
  
The role acts as the technical owner for organizational cultural analytics, dashboard architecture, culture and behavioral risk indicators and analytical methodologies used by the Organizational Culture Assurance team and wider A&A function.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**
**Behavioral and Culture Analytics**

* Develop analytical models to identify behavioral patterns, cultural indicators and emerging organizational risks.
* Analyze large and complex datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, anomalies and relationships relevant to governance, risk management and organizational effectiveness.
* Interpret behavioral indicators associated with accountability, leadership effectiveness, collaboration, decision-making, challenge, escalation and psychological safety.
* Support development of methodologies that enable objective assessment of organizational behaviors.

**Dashboard Development and Reporting**

* Design, build and maintain a suite of behavioral and risk dashboards for A&A, leadership teams, RMCBs, ExCom and the ARC.
* Develop leading and lagging indicators that provide visibility of organizational and behavioral risk.
* Ensure dashboards are intuitive, evidence-based and aligned to strategic and enterprise risk priorities.
* Continuously enhance reporting capabilities through automation, visualization and advanced analytics techniques.

**Audit Enablement**

* Develop analytical products to support risk assessment, audit planning and assurance prioritization.
* Develop organizational Culture indicators relevant to key audit themes and enterprise risks.
* Provide specialist analytical support for complex or high-risk audit engagements.
* Support identification of audit targets and trigger points for dedicated Organizational Culture Assurance reviews.

**Data Integration and Insight Generation**

* Consolidate information from diverse data sources to develop enterprise-level insights.
* Analyze trends from workforce data, employee engagement surveys, speak-up reporting, compliance indicators, safety data, organizational structures, attrition metrics, performance measures and other relevant information sources.
* Identify themes that may signal emerging organizational vulnerabilities or opportunities.
* Translate analytical outputs into practical insights that support executive decision-making.
* Develop and maintain culture and behavioral risk models, trend analyses and predictive indicators that support identification of emerging organizational risks.
* Design and maintain data pipelines and analytical processes that consolidate information from multiple enterprise systems into consistent assurance products.
* Establish controls and quality assurance processes for behavioral and risk analytics outputs.

**AI and Innovation**

* Develop AI-assisted analytical techniques to identify behavioral patterns, cultural themes and potential risk indicators across large and complex datasets.

title: Payroll Lead
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What You'll Do**
We are seeking an experienced
**Payroll Lead**
to oversee payroll operations across
**EMEA and India**
, ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll delivery in a complex global environment. This role serves as the regional payroll subject matter expert and is responsible for the delivery, governance, compliance, and optimization of payroll operations across multiple countries.
  
  
**Payroll Operations**

* Own end-to-end payroll delivery across assigned EMEA countries and India.
* Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing, including gross-to-net calculations, payments, taxes, statutory deductions, benefits, and reporting.
* Manage payroll calendars, approvals, funding requirements, and operational controls.
* Monitor payroll performance and service levels while ensuring a high-quality employee experience.
* Support employee payroll inquiries and issue resolution.

**Compliance & Risk Management**

* Maintain expertise in payroll legislation, taxation, social security, and statutory requirements across EMEA and India.
* Ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements and payroll governance standards.
* Partner with Tax, Legal, HR, and external advisors to assess regulatory changes and mitigate payroll-related risks.
* Support payroll audits, reconciliations, and ongoing compliance activities.

**Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with third-party payroll providers and local payroll partners.
* Establish and monitor SLAs, KPIs, escalation processes, and service quality standards.
* Lead issue resolution and root-cause analysis for payroll-related challenges.
* Support payroll vendor assessments, implementations, transitions, and RFP processes.

**Stakeholder Leadership**

* Serve as the primary payroll SME for EMEA and India.
* Partner closely with HR, Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Benefits, HRIS, and IT teams.
* Communicate payroll risks, recommendations, and operational updates to key stakeholders.
* Build strong partnerships with regional business leaders to ensure alignment and compliance.

**Systems & Continuous Improvement**

* Support optimization of payroll technologies and integrations, including Workday, payroll platforms, time and attendance systems, and financial systems.
* Ensure payroll data integrity, controls, and interface accuracy across systems.
* Participate in payroll system implementations, upgrades, testing, and enhancements.
* Drive automation, standardization, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve payroll accuracy, efficiency, scalability, and employee experience.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred.
* 6+ years of progressive payroll experience, including multi-country payroll operations.
* Strong experience managing payroll across EMEA and India.
* Deep understanding of payroll legislation, taxation, social security, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience managing third-party payroll providers and complex vendor relationships.
* Experience working with payroll and HRIS systems and integrations.
* Strong analytical and Excel skills.
* Experience supporting payroll audits, controls, reconciliations, and compliance requirements.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across global teams, cultures, and time zones

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Workday HRIS.
* Experience with NetSuite or other ERP platforms.
* Experience implementing or transitioning payroll providers.
* Experience with global payroll platforms such as ADP or similar solutions.
* Project management experience.
* Professional payroll certification (CPP, CIPP/E, or equivalent).
* Experience supporting payroll transformation, automation, or global payroll consolidation

**Working Hours**

* Standard schedule: Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week, generally from 11:00 AM IST to 8:00 PM IST.
* Flexibility to support EMEA and India time zones, including occasional early morning or evening meetings during payroll cycles and critical business periods.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

and capability-building initiatives across the South region. This role will focus on

strengthening product knowledge, sales excellence, customer engagement, leadership

development, and operational standards. The ideal candidate will work closely with

Retail Operations, HR, and Business Leaders to ensure every store team is equipped to

deliver the GIVA experience.

Training Strategy & Execution

region.

• Conduct regular training sessions on jewellery product knowledge, customer

experience, sales techniques, SOPs, and store operations.

Retail Capability Development

• Build strong selling capabilities by coaching teams on consultative selling,

upselling, cross-selling, and customer relationship management.

• Train store teams on gold, silver, diamond, and gemstone product knowledge.

management programs.

learning initiatives with business goals.

opening training.

stores.

Performance & Training Effectiveness

ATV, UPT, customer satisfaction, and employee productivity.

• Prepare and present training dashboards, reports, and action plans to

leadership.

• Continuously enhance training content based on business feedback and market

trends.

Learning Content Development

• Design and update training modules, facilitator guides, SOPs, assessments, and

e-learning content.

• Create engaging learning experiences using classroom sessions, virtual training,

role plays, and digital learning tools.

• Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or certification in Learning &

**Development is preferred.**

Training.

brands is highly preferred.

• Proven experience managing regional retail training across multiple store

locations.

• Strong facilitation, coaching, and presentation skills.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); exposure to LMS

platforms is an advantage.

• Willingness to travel extensively across South India.

Preferred Skills

• Retail Sales Training

• Jewellery Product Knowledge

• Customer Experience Excellence

• Leadership Development

• Coaching & Mentoring

• Performance Management

• Training Need Analysis

• Content Development

• Stakeholder Management

• Data Analysis & Reporting

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title:**
**Resource Management – Supervising Associate**
**At EY,**
we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services:**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key business stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities:**
**Service Delivery:**

* Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
* Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
* Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
* Champion and lead Strategic Resource Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
* Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Planning & Optimization:**

* Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
* Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.

**Performance Management:**

* Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
* Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
* Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
* Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.

**Data & Analytics:**

* Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
* Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.

**Skills and attributes for success:**

* Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
* Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
* Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
* Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
* Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
* Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
* Demonstrate an eye for detail
* Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Graduate / MBA (preferably HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
* Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.

**What we look for:**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What we offer you:**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Strategic HR Business Partner
description:
Job Location: Bangalore, Braga, Cebu City, Chennai, Frankfurt am Main, Heredia, Hyderabad, Kuala Lumpur, Lisboa, Lodz, Noida, Pune, Taguig City
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations Globally
  
  
Req Id: 13477
  
  
Posting Start Date: 10/21/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
  
  
**[Open to Multiple Locations in Asia and Europe]**
Global Delivery is Fujitsu’s delivery engine with currently over 21,000 employees across the Global Delivery Centers (GDCs) with an ambition to grow further in line with Fujitsu strategy. Our GDCs provide competitive and innovative services to customers via the Regions and exciting times are ahead of us as we continue to accelerate our Globalization journey.
  
  
**A critical component of our journey is to implement global service lines, standardized across all our Global Delivery Unit locations.**
**HR**
Our aim is to support the business's transformation and ensure high employee engagement throughout this journey.
  
  
**Simultaneously, HR is undergoing its own transformation. Through the ONEPeople Program, HR is becoming a truly global organization with a new organizational design and a common global platform.**
**Purpose**
The
**Strategic HR Business Partner**
will function as a trusted advisor to the Service Line leadership team, focusing on strategic human capital initiatives that align with the Service Line and Fujitsu’s broader business objectives. This role is essential to support Applications Service Line in driving talent management, leadership development, and change management across the organization. Providing the business with a pro-active and strategic HR business partnering service and advice on HR matters while keeping consistency through influencing all aspects of HR. This role delivers strategic direction and coaching, support and solutions to meet senior business leadership’s medium- and long-term business and people issues.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Workforce Planning: Collaborate with business leaders to assess current and future talent needs, ensuring that workforce plans align with business strategies and succession planning.
* Succession Planning: Lead initiatives to develop succession plans for critical roles, ensuring a seamless transition and continuity in leadership.
* HR Strategy: Driving and delivering culture change into the business by working with the relevant HR CoEs to apply appropriate HR interventions, such as Performance Management, Talent Management, L&D, Leadership approaches, etc.
* Business aspects: Works with the business to ensure any strategic organizational development/change activities are built into the annual HR budget process.
* Leadership Advisory: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to support decision-making in areas such as people management, leadership development, and cultural alignment.
* Talent Management: Drive leadership development initiatives, high-potential programs, and career progression strategies to nurture key talent within the organization.
* Change Management: Lead or support significant organizational changes, including restructurings, mergers, acquisitions, and cultural transformation efforts.
* Strategic Recruitment: Work in partnership with talent acquisition teams to create hiring strategies that align with the organization’s long-term business needs.
* Leadership Development: Offer coaching and mentoring to managers and senior leaders to enhance leadership capabilities across the organization.
* Data and Analytics: Leverage HR analytics to provide insights into workforce trends, engagement, and productivity, informing decision-making across all levels of the business.
* Employee Engagement: Drive initiatives to measure and enhance employee engagement, ensuring alignment with company culture and values.
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I): Collaborate with CoEs to implement DEI strategies and foster inclusive workplace environments.
* Risk & Compliance Management: Ensure adherence to risk and compliance management protocols across all HR initiatives.

**Key Skills And Competencies**

* Building Relationships and Influencing: Experienced in building trusted relationships at all levels of the organization and managing senior stakeholders, with outstanding influencing skills.
* Strategically Minded: Excellent organizational skills to utilize the wider HR function for transactional support, enabling a focus on strategic outcomes.
* Leadership: Strong leadership skills to lead and manage a team of Strategic HRBPs, providing guidance, coaching, and support to ensure high-quality service to the business.
* Dynamic and Agile: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, challenge the status quo, and manage multiple priorities and stakeholders effectively.
* Tenacity: A driven individual passionate about making the HR agenda successful, contributing to real business outcomes.
* Commercial Acumen: Partners with the business to deliver commercially focused people strategies, possessing a solid understanding of company finances and operations.
* Adaptability: Ability to adjust to rapidly changing environments while applying a problem-solving mindset to address people challenges.
* Resilience: Maintains focus and capability during setbacks, challenges, and organizational change.
* Financial Acumen: Demonstrated experience in understanding company finances and the ability to align HR initiatives with business objectives to enhance profitability.
* Presentation & Communication: Ability to present the People & Culture vision across all levels in the organization combined with excellent communication skills.

Relocation Supported: No
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
  
  
At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Sr Manager - HR Transformation and Automation
description:
**About Diversified**
Diversified is a global leader in audio visual and media innovation, recognized for designing and building the world’s most experiential environments. Our award-winning team specializes in delivering solutions for the most complex, large-scale and immersive installations. Serving a global clientele that includes major media organizations and retailers, sports and live performance venues, corporate enterprises, and government agencies, Diversified partners with clients to create spaces that bring people together and keep them coming back.
  
  
**What To Expect**
At Diversified, we're on a mission to create a world without boundaries, where technology enables all people to connect and experience the moments that matter, wherever they choose to be. With clients spanning the globe and an exciting pipeline of projects across industries, Diversified offers more than just a job. We offer a career path with the flexibility to grow personally and professionally, wherever your ambitions take you.
  
  
As a Diversified associate, you'll dive headfirst into big, complex, and rewarding projects that push the boundaries of what's possible. Plus, you'll enjoy a flexible work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and a culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.
  
  
**IF YOU CAN DREAM IT, YOU CAN DO IT AT DIVERSIFIED.**
**Shift Timings - 5PM - 2AM IST**
**Senior Manager – HR Process Automation & Transformation**
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Scope:**
Global
  
  
**Reports to:**
Sr. Director – Global HR Operations
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Manager – HR Process Automation & Transformation will lead the redesign, standardization, and automation of HR processes across the global employee lifecycle.
  
  
This role partners with HR functional leaders to understand how work is performed today, challenge unnecessary complexity and variation, and design scalable global processes that improve efficiency, service delivery, and the employee and manager experience.
  
  
The Senior Manager will bring a combination of HR process expertise, continuous improvement methodology, and hands-on technology capability. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable facilitating global process design, challenging existing ways of working, and personally building practical low-code automation solutions.
  
  
The role sits within HR Operations and works closely with HR Shared Services (HRSS), HCM/HRIS, HR Centers of Excellence, regional HR teams, and Enterprise Technology.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end discovery, assessment, and redesign of HR processes across functions and regions, identifying opportunities to eliminate unnecessary steps, simplify work, and create scalable global standards. Begin with Talent Acquisition and work through entire employee life cycle.
* Facilitate current- and future-state process design, including workflows, ownership, handoffs, controls, regional variations, service expectations, and measures of success.
* Establish and apply consistent process improvement and documentation methodologies, ensuring redesigned processes can be successfully implemented, operationalized, and continuously improved.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, increase self-service, and create capacity through automation and technology.
* Personally design, build, test, and implement appropriate low-code solutions using Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint/Lists, Forms, and related enterprise technologies.
* Partner with HCM/HRIS to leverage native platform capabilities where appropriate and with Enterprise Technology when solutions require broader integration, architecture, security, or technical support.
* Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and identify practical opportunities to apply AI, agents, intelligent workflow, knowledge retrieval, and other technologies to improve HR processes and service delivery.
* Partner with HR functional owners, HRSS, HCM/HRIS, HRBPs, and regional HR teams to translate business needs into practical solutions and drive stakeholder alignment, implementation, and adoption.
* Use data and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities and demonstrate measurable results in efficiency, quality, cycle time, experience, and capacity.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in HR Operations, HR transformation, HR Shared Services, HR technology, business process improvement, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end business process transformation, from current-state discovery through future-state design, implementation, and stabilization.
* Strong knowledge of HR processes across multiple areas of the employee lifecycle.
* Experience facilitating process-design sessions with functional leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to challenge existing processes, identify root causes, and translate business requirements into practical future-state solutions.
* Experience designing processes across multiple countries, regions, business units, or other complex operating environments.
* Hands-on experience designing and building workflow automation using Microsoft Power Automate.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform and related technologies, including Power Apps, SharePoint/Lists, Forms, or comparable enterprise automation tools.
* Experience working with enterprise HCM platforms and partnering with HRIS/HCM teams on technology-enabled process solutions.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience transforming Talent Acquisition, onboarding, or other Hire-to-Retire processes.
* Experience working within or closely partnering with a global HR Shared Services or HR Operations environment.
* Understanding of HR service-delivery models, case management, service levels, operational metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Previous experience leading employees, project teams, or operational teams.
* Experience with Dayforce or another major enterprise HCM platform.
* Practical experience applying Microsoft Copilot, AI assistants/agents, or other generative AI capabilities to business processes.
* Lean, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, business process management, or similar training/certification.
* Experience within a Global Capability Center (GCC), multinational organization, or HR transformation/consulting environment.
* Change management and/or project management experience.

**Success Profile**
The successful candidate will be a
**process thinker first and a technologist second**
. They will be naturally curious about why work is performed a certain way and comfortable challenging established practices while building strong partnerships with functional experts.
  
  
They will balance global standardization with legitimate local requirements and understand that automation is not the objective—better business outcomes are.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be comfortable moving between strategy and execution and demonstrate the operational and leadership capabilities to take on broader HR Operations responsibilities as the organization and role evolve.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Along with competitive compensation, you will be eligible for the following benefits:
  
  

* Multiple medical plan for self and family
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, and Employee Assistance Plan (EAP)
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Commuter & Shift Benefits (US / APAC shifts)

To learn more about becoming part of the Diversified team, visit us at https://onediversified.com/careers/careers-at-diversified or email us at careers@onediversified.com.
  
  
Diversified is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All aspects of employment will be based on job requirements, individual qualifications, merit, performance, and business need.
  
  
We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
  
  
We believe in fair and equitable hiring practices and strive to create an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered.

**About The Role**
Responsible for driving the full learning cycle at Zeta – from detailed learning needs analysis and diagnosis through content design, facilitation, vendor partnering, and impact measurement – in close partnership with HRBPs and business leaders. The role also leads organization-wide, high-impact learning programs and oversees learning operations, including learning technology, compliance training, budgets, and policies. This role will require close collaboration with Business stakeholders, People Partners, and the larger People Success team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with HRBPs to conduct detailed learning needs analysis (LNA) using data insights, performance trends, and structured discussions with leaders, managers, and employees.
* Diagnose capability gaps at the individual, team, and organizational levels, and translate them into clear learning objectives and solution recommendations.
* Design and develop learning content and journeys across behavioral, functional, technical, and leadership areas, applying sound instructional design principles and blended formats.
* Facilitate learning sessions, workshops, and programs, creating engaging experiences for diverse audiences.
* Partner closely with HRBPs and business leaders to understand priorities, co-create learning solutions, and drive adoption within their teams.
* Identify, evaluate, and manage external vendors and consulting partners – from scoping and selection through delivery and quality oversight.
* Measure learning effectiveness and business impact using structured evaluation frameworks, and use insights to continuously improve programs.
* Lead organization-wide, high-impact learning programs end-to-end – from design and rollout through communication, adoption, and impact measurement.
* Drive capability-building initiatives such as manager and leadership development, role-level certifications, and function-specific training.
* Own learning policies and manage learning budgets, including planning, allocation, spend tracking, and reporting.
* Govern mandatory compliance training (e.g., Infosec, POSH, Code of Conduct), ensuring timely completion and audit-ready records.
* Oversee learning technology, including LMS administration, learning KPIs, and dashboards that give leaders actionable insights on learning.

**Skills**

* Learning Needs Analysis & Diagnosis
* Instructional & Content Design
* Facilitation
* Stakeholder & HRBP Partnering
* Program Management Vendor Management
* Learning Analytics & Learning Tech (LMS)

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in L&D, with hands-on ownership of the full learning cycle – LNA, diagnosis, content design, facilitation, and evaluation
* Qualification - MBA/ Master's in psychology from a reputed institute
* Experience with managing learning/ other talent programs/ processes (from design, delivery, execution, communication, logistics, follow through and closure)
* Strong analytical, interpersonal and communication skills
* Experience with managing LMS, related data and reporting
* Demonstrated experience in partnering with business leaders and teams
* Experience with application of L&D/OD concepts, principles, methodologies, and tools

title: Deputy General Manager - Talent Management & Leadership Development, ISEA
description:

Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

description:

* Strong communication, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.
* Good ownership, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Comfortable working with HRMS tools, spreadsheets, and employee data.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

description:

title: Compensation & Benefits Analyst - HR Ops
description:
**The Opportunity**
At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to creating a sustainable energy future through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. We are looking for a Compensation & Benefits Analyst to join our Global HR Services team and play a critical role in delivering compensation and benefits support across multiple geographies.
  
  
In this role, you will partner with HR teams, business leaders, employees, and external vendors to ensure the efficient administration of compensation programs and employee benefits. You will be responsible for supporting key annual compensation processes, maintaining data accuracy within Workday, providing insightful reporting and analytics, and ensuring a high level of service delivery to stakeholders worldwide.
  
  
This position offers an excellent opportunity to gain global exposure while working on complex compensation programs, incentive plans, salary reviews, and benefits administration. You will collaborate with colleagues across regions, contribute to process improvements, and help drive operational excellence within a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
As part of a high-performing HR Services organization, you will leverage analytical thinking, digital tools, and process expertise to enhance employee experience, ensure compliance, and support strategic business objectives. If you are detail-oriented, customer-focused, and passionate about compensation and benefits, this role provides an exciting platform for professional growth and impact.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Support the execution of global compensation processes, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short-Term Incentive (STI) programs, Long-Term Incentive (LTI) programs, scorecards, and other compensation initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.
* Administer compensation programs across multiple countries and regulatory environments while maintaining compliance with company policies and local requirements.
* Maintain, validate, and monitor compensation-related employee data in Workday, ensuring data integrity and accuracy across HR systems.
* Generate standard and ad hoc compensation reports, analytics, and insights to support global and regional stakeholders in decision-making.
* Coordinate and support regional and global employee benefits programs, including vendor management and service delivery activities.
* Manage end-to-end compensation transactions, including data validation, calculations, approvals, and payout readiness through established workflows and systems such as ServiceNow.
* Ensure delivery of compensation services in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), maintaining high standards of quality, turnaround time, and customer satisfaction.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) to ensure process consistency and compliance.
* Identify process improvement opportunities, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and service excellence.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional and global teams while leveraging digital and analytical tools to improve productivity and decision-making.

**Your Background**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in HR Shared Services, Compensation Operations, or Compensation & Benefits Administration within a global organization.
* Hands-on experience supporting compensation programs, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short-Term Incentives (STI), Long-Term Incentives (LTI), salary administration, and compensation reporting.
* Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday, including compensation data management, reporting, and process administration.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of PowerPoint, Power BI, and other digital reporting tools.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively manage stakeholders across different functions and geographies.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
* Experience supporting employee benefits administration and vendor coordination is preferred.

**More About Us**
At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure. We foster an inclusive and collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and continuous learning is supported.
  
  
Joining our team means working alongside talented professionals across the globe while contributing to meaningful work that supports employees and business success. We offer opportunities for career growth, global exposure, and professional development in an environment built on integrity, safety, and respect.
  
  
**Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem-solving, decision-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.**

title: Plant Admin & HR Manager
description:
**About Origin**
Origin (formerly 10xConstruction) is building general-purpose autonomous robots for US construction, taking on rising costs, safety risks and labour shortages. Our modular, multi-trade platform pairs purpose-built hardware with real-time site intelligence to work in complex environments and execute tasks precisely. Trained in high-fidelity simulation and already deployed on live sites, our robots deliver 5x faster execution, 250%+ margin expansion and significant cost savings. Join India's most talent-dense robotics team, with people from IITs, Stanford, UCLA and more.
  
  
**About The Role**
Origin is moving V3 robot assembly in-house in Bengaluru, growing to a 19-person plant team building 3 to 5 robots a month and scaling to 20. You will be the person who gets both sites open and legal, hires and onboards the technicians and engineers who run them, and keeps the plant compliant, staffed and running day to day. You report to the Supply Chain Lead & Plant Head and work alongside the Plant Supervisor and the Manufacturing Engineer. This is a founding, hands-on role: on day one there is a bare shed and a plan.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Facility set-up and administration**

* Run the lease search and sign-off for the interim unit and the SEZ factory with brokers, landlords and legal: term sheet, fire NOC, electrical load, fit-out permissions, exit terms
* Own the fit-out schedule with the Manufacturing Engineer: contractors, racking, partitions, test rooms, mezzanine, power, internet, water and sanitation, delivered on the plan dates
* Run the plant day to day: security, housekeeping, canteen, transport, utilities, AMCs, consumables, visitor and vendor access, and the move from the interim unit to the SEZ factory

**Statutory compliance and licensing**

* Obtain and maintain every registration the plant needs: GST additional place of business, Shops & Establishments, trade license, Factories Act license, KSPCB consent, fire NOC, BESCOM sanction, and the SEZ/EOU or MOOWR filings with the liaison and customs consultants
* Own the statutory calendar: PF, ESI, professional tax, labour-welfare, contract-labour and factory returns, registers, inspections and renewals, with zero lapses
* Set and enforce plant safety and security routines: battery charging and storage SOPs, lifting, PPE, fire drills, incident log and first-aid readiness

**Hiring and onboarding the plant team**

* Hire the plant team to the needed-by dates on the org chart: technicians (mechanical, embedded, IQC), stores, QA, logistics and sourcing roles, through ITIs, diploma colleges, staffing agencies and referrals
* Run the pipeline in Workable end to end: sourcing, screening, trade tests with the Plant Supervisor, offers, background checks and joining
* Onboard every joiner with documentation, induction, safety briefing, uniforms and tools, and a 30-day check-in

**People operations**

* Run monthly payroll inputs, attendance, shifts, leave and overtime for the plant with Finance; keep personnel files and HRMS records accurate
* Handle contract-labour and agency compliance, grievances, discipline and exits with fairness and documentation
* Build the plant's people rhythm: skill matrix, training records, retention actions for technicians, and the engagement that keeps a 19-person floor working as one team

**Costs, vendors and records**

* Manage the plant admin budget, vendor contracts and purchase requests for admin and facilities spend; track actuals against the approved plan
* Keep the plant's compliance and facility documentation audit-ready for customers, auditors, customs and SEZ authorities

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* MUST HAVE: Has set up or run plant administration and HR at a manufacturing unit in Karnataka, including the licences and registrations a factory needs to open
* MUST HAVE: Has hired blue-collar technicians at volume through ITIs, agencies or walk-ins, and run their onboarding and payroll compliance
* 4 to 8 years in plant administration, factory HR or a combined admin-HR role in an electronics, automotive, EMS or machinery plant
* Working knowledge of the Factories Act, Shops & Establishments Act, Contract Labour Act, PF, ESI, professional tax and KSPCB categories, and comfort dealing with inspectors and government offices in person
* Fluent in Kannada and English; Hindi or Tamil a plus for the technician pool
* Organized and documented by habit: registers, trackers and calendars that someone else could pick up tomorrow
* Comfortable in a bare industrial space, on your feet, solving the problem in front of you

**Preferred Experience**

* Opening a greenfield unit, or moving a plant from one site to another, on a fixed date
* Export-oriented or bonded premises: SEZ, EOU or MOOWR filings, customs bonding inspections, Development Commissioner liaison
* Workable or a similar ATS, an HRMS, and payroll tools such as GreytHR or Keka
* Startup or small-company environment where you were the only admin and HR person
* ISO 9001 or similar audit preparation for a plant

title: Payroll & Benefits Manager, APAC
description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview**
**Corporate:**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you'll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The APAC Payroll & Benefits Manager is responsible for leading the delivery of payroll and benefits administration across the APAC region, including India, Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, China, and Japan. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational responsibility, ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll processing and employee benefit administration across diverse regulatory environments. The role manages a team of payroll and benefits professionals while maintaining direct involvement in critical payroll activities, vendor management, audits, issue resolution, process improvement initiatives, and regional compliance efforts. The successful candidate partners closely with HR, Finance, Tax, and external service providers to deliver a high-quality employee experience and support the organization's continued growth throughout APAC.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary duties will include:**
**Payroll Operations**

* Lead end-to-end payroll processing across India, Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, China, and Japan utilizing a combination of internal resources and third-party payroll providers
* Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing, statutory filings, tax reporting, and year-end payroll activities in each country
* Review and approve payroll calculations, variance reports, off-cycle payments, incentive payments, equity-related payroll transactions, and termination payments
* Serve as the escalation point for complex payroll, tax, and compliance matters
* Monitor payroll controls and perform periodic audits to ensure data integrity and compliance
* Partner with Finance to support payroll accounting, reconciliations, accruals, and reporting requirements
* Maintain payroll calendars and governance processes to ensure service-level commitments are met
* Support internal and external audits and respond to payroll-related compliance inquiries

**Benefits Administration**

* Oversee administration of employee benefits programs across the APAC region, including medical, life insurance, retirement, wellness, and other local benefit offerings
* Manage enrollments, terminations, employee status changes, and annual renewal processes
* Partner with brokers, carriers, and vendors to ensure effective service delivery and cost management
* Support benefits benchmarking, market reviews, renewal negotiations, and implementation of new programs

**Leadership & Team Management**

* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, customer service, and operational excellence
* Provide hands-on support during payroll cycles, peak periods, system implementations, and critical business initiatives

**Compliance & Risk Management**

* Monitor legislative and regulatory developments impacting payroll, taxation, social insurance, pensions, and employee benefits
* Ensure compliance with local labor laws and statutory obligations across all supported countries
* Develop and maintain payroll and benefits policies, procedures, and documentation
* Partner with Legal, Finance, Compliance, and external advisors on regulatory changes and risk mitigation strategies
* Drive compliance reviews and process audits to identify and address control gaps

**Systems & Process Improvement**

* Identify and implement opportunities to improve payroll accuracy, efficiency, automation, and employee experience

* Serve as a trusted advisor to HR leaders, Finance teams, Business Partners, and employees throughout APAC
* Collaborate with global payroll, HR operations, compensation, mobility, tax, and benefits teams to ensure consistent practices
* Manage relationships with payroll providers, brokers, consultants, and other third-party partners

:**

* 8+ years of progressive payroll and benefits experience with significant responsibility across multiple APAC countries
* 3+ years of people management experience

title: Senior Global HR Specialist
description:
**Job Title**
Senior Global HR Specialist
  
  
**Job Description**
**So, who are we?**
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
  
  
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
  
  
Join us at IG – the future gets built here
*.*
**Your team**
You’ll join People Services, part of People Excellence at IG, supporting 3,000+ colleagues across the globe.
  
  
**Your role in the Team's Success**
This is a 12-month fixed-term role, so you need to be productive from your first week. You’ll work independently from our documented procedures and take full ownership of the work you pick up. You’ll report to the Manager, HR Operation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Resolve HR queries and requests in ServiceNow, accurately and within agreed timeframes
* Process employee lifecycle transactions in Workday, including hires, changes, and leavers
* Own the daily Workday task queue on your assigned days, including anything left over from the previous day
* Prepare, sign, and distribute accurate HR letters and documents, and maintain employee files in our online archive
* Support Japan HR Operations from November
* Handle correspondence from authorities and external bodies, making sure every item is resolved or escalated with a clear next step
* Support colleagues on complex cases and contribute to audits
* Work with team members across India, Poland, and the UK

**What You'll Need**

* You work out what to do when a case doesn’t match the procedure. Procedures cover most cases but not all. When something differs, you work out the right action, or you escalate with your analysis and a proposed next step. You never close a case because “no instruction applies”.
* You own the outcome. If something is unowned or overdue, you pick it up. You don’t wait to be assigned it or assume someone else has it.
* You flag risks early. If you can’t meet a deadline or you’re unsure about a case, you tell your manager straight away, with a proposed way forward.
* You work UK hours one to two days in every two weeks.

**Essential**

* 4+ years of hands-on HR operations or HR shared services experience, ideally in a multi-country environment
* Hands-on experience with Workday or SuccessFactors
* Experience with ServiceNow, Salesforce, or a similar HR case management tool
* Strong written and spoken English (C1)
* Proven track record of working independently from procedures and handling cases that don’t fit them
* Willingness to work UK hours as described above

**Nice to have**

* Experience supporting APAC, EMEA, or Japan HR processes
* Experience handling correspondence from authorities and labour office
* Experience supporting internal or external audits.

**The Perks**
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognize your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
  
  
**Join us for this exciting journey. Apply now!**
**Number of openings**
1

title: People Business Partner
description:

At
****Evotix****
, we’re transforming the way businesses approach health, safety, and wellbeing. Our team thrives on bold ideas, celebrates diversity, and embraces the power of collaboration.

****People Business Partner****
to support our teams across Bangalore and Hyderabad.

****strategic business partnering****
and
****practical delivery****
. You will provide clear advice, use people data to identify priorities and ensure that our People practices support business performance and an engaging employee experience.

* Support managers to make timely, fair and evidence-based decisions, constructively challenging where necessary.

* Support talent reviews, succession planning and employee development, identifying broader capability gaps requiring action.

* Manage employee relations matters including performance, conduct, attendance, grievances and workplace concerns.
* Guide managers through appropriate processes, documentation, investigations and risk considerations, ensuring fair and consistent treatment.
* Maintain accurate and confidential case documentation and engage external advisers where specialist Indian employment law guidance is required.

* Build a visible and trusted People presence across Bangalore and Hyderabad, including quarterly visits to Hyderabad.
* Use employee feedback and engagement data to identify priorities and work with leaders to turn these into measurable actions.
* Support initiatives that strengthen communication, collaboration, inclusion and connection across locations.
* Promote an employee experience consistent with the organisation’s culture and values.

****People Operations and Governance****

* Partner with People Operations to deliver a smooth employee lifecycle, covering onboarding, probation, internal moves, promotions and exits.
* Ensure People policies, processes, documentation and systems are applied and maintained accurately and consistently in India.
* Support payroll, benefits and compliance activities through accurate and timely People information.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve the manager and employee experience.

****People Data and Insights****

* Use people data to identify trends, risks and priorities across retention, absence, performance, engagement and workforce capability.
* Translate data and business context into meaningful insights and practical recommendations for managers.
* Track agreed People actions and hold managers accountable for delivery, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data protection standards.

**Required**
****What You Bring****

* Strong experience in a People Business Partner, HR Business Partner or senior HR generalist role in India.
* Practical knowledge of Indian employment practices and experience managing employee relations matters.
* Experience partnering with managers across different locations, functions and countries.
* Confidence advising international managers who may be unfamiliar with Indian employment practices or local workplace expectations.
* A track record of coaching managers and improving management capability.
* Experience supporting performance management, organisational change and employee engagement.
* Strong judgement, with the ability to balance employee experience, legal risk and commercial priorities.
* A practical, calm and solutions-focused approach.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Confidence working with people data and translating it into clear actions.
* High levels of discretion, integrity and attention to detail.
* Experience using People systems and maintaining accurate employee information.

****Desirable****

* Experience working in a fast-paced, international technology or software business.
* Experience supporting teams across Bangalore and Hyderabad.
* Experience working within a growing or changing organisation.
* Exposure to global People programmes and cross-border stakeholder management.
* A relevant postgraduate HR qualification or professional HR accreditation.

**Please note that Evotix is unable to offer visa sponsorship. You must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application.**
