We’re happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process — just let us know what you need.
  
  
****Ready to Make a Difference?****
If you’re a bold, results-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!
  
  
**Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.**

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.
  
  
As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.
  
  
As a HR Advisor at ICON, you will provide critical support across HR functions, offering guidance and expertise to employees and managers on a range of HR matters.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Your role will involve delivering human resources work to a high standard, working closely with your team and stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Providing day-to-day HR support and advice to employees and managers on topics such as employee relations, performance management, and policy interpretation.
* Assisting in the development and implementation of HR policies, procedures, and initiatives to support organizational goals.
* Collaborating with HR and cross-functional teams on projects related to employee engagement, retention, and talent development.
* Supporting recruitment and onboarding processes, ensuring a positive experience for new hires.
* Maintaining accurate employee records and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

**Your Profile**
You will bring relevant human resources experience, along with the following qualifications and skills.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in human resources, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Proven experience in an HR role, with knowledge of employee relations, HR policies, and employment law.
* Strong Excel skills, including experience creating, modifying, and troubleshooting VBA macros
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear and empathetic support to employees.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* A proactive and solutions-oriented approach, with a commitment to continuous improvement in HR practices.

**What ICON Can Offer You**
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
  
  
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
  
  
**Our Benefits Examples Include**

* Various annual leave entitlements
* A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
* Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
* Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
* Life assurance
* Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.
  
  
At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
  
  
If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know or submit a request here
  
  
Interested in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there’s every chance you’re exactly what we’re looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles.

title: Sr L&D Business Partner
description:
**About Target**
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. Joining Target means fostering a culture rooted in care, inclusion and respect, while striving to make a meaningful and positive impact. At Target, we value diverse perspectives, encourage authentic relationships and believe every team member’s voice matters.
  
  
**Overview Of Target In India**
Target’s success is driven by a timeless purpose and a proven strategy, brought to life by talented teams across the globe. In India, Target operates as a fully integrated part of its global organization, with more than 5,000 team members in Bengaluru supporting enterprise-wide strategy, technology and operations. Target in India offers an inclusive, learning-focused environment where innovation, collaboration and people-first values enable world-class outcomes.
  
  
**About The Team**
Target Human Resources is recognized for building strong, high-performing teams that power the guest experience. We bring Target’s distinctive brand to life through continuous innovation, experimentation and evolution. Supporting nearly 400,000 team members across stores, distribution centers and headquarters, HR serves as a strategic partner to leaders and team members alike. Our diverse community of people professionals works behind the scenes to cultivate a progressive culture of respect, reward, growth and opportunity.
  
  
**About Pyramid**
Our goal is to develop and grow the TII L&D team that is positioned to strategically deliver on the TII learning needs and leadership priorities while continuing to stay aligned with the global HQ priorities and goals. This client + capability aligned structure will prioritize and deliver consistent, high-quality support across key capabilities for Target
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Sr. L&D Business Partner serves as a strategic learning consultant to the business, identifying capability gaps and designing scalable learning solutions that drive behavior change and measurable business outcomes. The role partners closely with senior leaders, HR teams, and internal/external stakeholders to shape learning strategy and deliver Talent development experiences.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Consult with business and senior leaders to diagnose learning and performance gaps, conduct root-cause analysis, and recommend effective solutions.
* Develop short- and long-term learning strategies aligned with business priorities and future capability needs.
* Lead end-to-end L&D projects, including design, development of content, facilitation, budgets, stakeholder communication, vendor management, and project teams.
* Design and facilitate classroom and virtual learning experiences, particularly skill and behavioral programs.
* Measure learning effectiveness, application, and business impact; identify metrics and success stories demonstrating results.
* Act as a trusted learning and change-management consultant while building strong relationships across business, HR, vendors, and other stakeholders.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8–10 years of core L&D experience, spanning needs analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation.
* Strong expertise in facilitation, leadership development, leadership offsites, and learning events.
* Demonstrated consulting capability, executive presence, business acumen, strategic thinking, influencing, and stakeholder management.
* Experience developing scalable and sustainable learning strategies/programs.
* Strong project/program management, communication, analytical, and results-orientation skills.
* Ability to lead complex, cross-functional learning initiatives from intake and diagnosis through execution and impact measurement.

title: HR Admin– Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an HR Admin– Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in managing the people lifecycle and handling day-to-day operational tasks related to employee management. This includes activities such as onboarding, offboarding, payroll and benefits administration, and compliance with labor laws. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and enhancing your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality work even when the path forward isn’t clear.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be a primary HR point of contact, resolving, escalating, or routing inquiries in line with HR protocols. You will be part of a team of problem solvers that help address complex business issues from strategy to execution. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will leverage a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, while upholding professional and technical standards. This opportunity allows you to deepen your understanding of the business context and contribute to the smooth operation of HR processes and systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Managing employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, offboarding, and payroll administration
* Coordinating benefits administration and absence management to support workforce needs
* Handling employee inquiries and issues, providing resolution or escalation as needed
* Maintaining compliance with labor laws and regulations through accurate record-keeping
* Utilizing HR software and digital tools to streamline HR operations and service delivery
* Collaborating with teams to improve HR processes and enhance employee engagement strategies
* Applying analytical thinking to interpret data and inform HR metrics and recommendations
* Supporting human resources management by upholding professional and technical standards
* Facilitating employee relations and terminations in line with HR policies and protocols
* Embracing change and fostering AI-human collaboration to drive innovation in HR practices

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Measurement, Data Science, Industrial-Organizational (I/O) Psychology, or a related field
* Demonstrating proficiency in Human Resources Management (HRM) and HR Software
* Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights
* Excelling in employee engagement strategies and stakeholder communications
* Embracing change and demonstrating learning agility in dynamic environments
* Coordinating staff and managing employee life cycle processes
* Handling confidential information with integrity and professionalism

title: Head of ER Advisory - GCN India
description:
**Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role
**Head of Employee Relations Advisory – Global Capability Network India**
**Location- Hyderabad and Bengaluru**
**Overview Of The Team**

* HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
* Employee Relations Advisory (ERA) team is accountable to deliver the Employee Relations strategy around Policies & Procedures, Conduct and Concerns Management, Business Change and Transformation, People Risk and Governance, Employment Law and Litigation & Industrial Relations by applying appropriate judgement in making decisions taken are compliant with local legislations and Group's guidelines that apply.
* This role will be part of the Employee Relations Advisory Team of Infrastructure that manages Employee Relations Advisory related aspects for Global Capability Networks across 8 countries supporting Global Capability Network in India comprising of c.30k employees and reports in Head of Employee Relations Advisory – Infrastructure.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead Employee Relations Advisory for Global Capability Network India, aligning the agenda with business strategy, workforce priorities, organisational culture, risk appetite and the broader People strategy. Provide strategic counsel and constructive challenge to HR and business leadership on complex employee, workforce and organisational matters, balancing employee experience, business needs, legal and regulatory considerations.
* Own the ER (Employee Relations) risk agenda by proactively identifying litigation, conduct and workforce risks; establish appropriate mitigation strategies and ensure risks remain within the organisation’s risk appetite.
* Lead the development, governance and continuous improvement of ER policies, frameworks and practices, ensuring alignment with Indian employment legislation, regulatory requirements, Group frameworks and evolving business needs.
* Own the governance and resolution of complex and high-risk ER matters, including disciplinary cases, grievances, whistleblowing, investigations and performance matters, ensuring consistency, fairness, procedural robustness and appropriate risk management.
* Lead the India approach to employment litigation and disputes, partnering with Internal Legal and external counsel on litigation strategy with clear accountability for outcomes. Provide strategic advice on workforce transformation and business change, outsourcing, operating-model changes and other complex workforce interventions.
* Provide guidance on Industrial Relations and employee representation matters, including the management of emerging industrial relations risks where applicable. Anticipate and interpret changes in Indian employment legislation, regulatory expectations and market practice, translating these into implications, recommendations and proactive changes to strategy, policies and business practices.
* Establish robust governance and oversight, providing senior leadership with meaningful trends, risk indicators, case insights and recommendations to support informed workforce decisions. Ensure appropriate quality assurance, consolidation and reporting of India ER activity, including material cases, risk themes, litigation, workforce change and service delivery metrics.
* Drive an insight-led ER agenda using case data, ER metrics, employee trends and thematic analysis to identify systemic issues, emerging risks and opportunities for preventative interventions. Oversee, track and monitor Employee Relations Advisory service delivery metrics and provide trends and insights to Entity, Regional and Global Governance Forums.
* Own the effectiveness of the India ER operating model, ensuring appropriate prioritisation, capacity, service standards, escalation mechanisms, quality assurance and consistent delivery of ER advisory services. Lead continuous improvement and simplification of ER processes, leveraging technology, data and innovative approaches to improve manager and employee experience, strengthen controls and increase the effectiveness of ER delivery.
* Build and lead a high-performing Employee Relations team, developing capability in strategic advisory, employment law, investigations, workforce transformation, industrial relations, risk management and stakeholder influence. Coach and enable the ER Advisory Team, HRBPs and people managers to strengthen ER capability, improve manager effectiveness and promote consistent, fair and accountable practices. Build strong strategic partnerships with HRBPs (Human Resource Business partners), business leaders, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Reward and other specialist functions; represent Employee Relations in governance and leadership forums; embed ER considerations into organisational and workforce strategy; and role-model the organisation’s leadership behaviours and values to support high performance, responsible leadership, employee trust and sustainable business outcomes.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Post Graduation in Human Resources, Employee Relations, Law or related disciple, with 15+ years of experience in progressive experience, including significant experience i.e., 10 years leading Employee Relations in a complex, large scale organization.
* Proven track record of leading an Employee Relations Advisory function, shaping ER strategy, policies, frameworks, and practices that enable business outcomes while maintaining appropriate employee, regulatory and reputational risk controls.
* Deep expertise in Indian employment, labor and industrial relations legislations, with the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical, commercially sound ER strategies, policies and interventions.
* Strong experience managing complex and high-risk ER issues, including investigations, disciplinary actions, grievances, employee disputes, litigations, regulatory proceedings, industrial relations. Demonstrated expertise in advising on organizational transformation and workforce changes and other complex workforce interventions.
* Strong risk and governance mindset, with the ability to identify emerging people, legal, regulatory, employee relations risks to establish appropriate controls and provide clear recommendations for active risk mitigation.
* Exceptional influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to consult, challenge and influence stakeholders (across levels) across HR, Business Legal, Compliance, Risk and other control functions to achieve balanced and sustainable outcomes.
* Strong commercial and business acumen with ability to understand business strategy, operating models and workforce priorities and translating them into pragmatic ER solutions.
* Good communication, judgement and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential matters with integrity, empathy and sound judgment.
* Strong leadership capability, including developing ER/ Advisory talent, building organizational capability, creating a high-performance culture and establishing consistent ER standards across a complex organization.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and navigate complex, competing priorities, making sound and timely decisions with limited precedent while maintaining appropriate risk discipline.

title: Compensation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Offsore Company is a growing organization focused on delivering high-quality professional services to clients across diverse industries. The company emphasizes data-driven decision-making, operational efficiency, and sustainable business practices. Team members collaborate across functions and locations, working in a primarily office environment supported by modern tools and technologies. The organization is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people are respected and supported in achieving their professional goals.
  
**Role Description**
The Compensation Specialist is a full-time office role responsible for supporting the design, analysis, and administration of compensation programs. This role involves conducting job evaluations, maintaining compensation structures, and assisting in compensation planning to ensure internal equity and market competitiveness. The Compensation Specialist will analyze salary data, prepare reports, and provide recommendations based on business needs and market trends. Daily tasks include collaborating with HR and management, reviewing compensation requests, supporting annual pay review cycles, and ensuring adherence to relevant policies and guidelines. The role also includes maintaining accurate documentation, supporting process improvements, and helping to build clear, consistent compensation practices.
  
**Qualifications**
Overall 3 to 12 yr experience.
  

* Candidates should possess skills in Compensation Planning and Compensation Management to support the design and administration of pay programs.
* Candidates should possess skills in Job Evaluation and Compensation Structures to help maintain equitable and consistent role-based pay frameworks.
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret data, prepare reports, and provide evidence-based compensation recommendations.
* Knowledge of HR principles, pay equity concepts, and market benchmarking methodologies is beneficial.
* Strong attention to detail, ability to manage confidential information, and proficiency with spreadsheets and HR systems are preferred.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote environment, are important.
* A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is advantageous.

title: Consultant, Information Technology
description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. 
  
  
**Your Role at Baxter:**
Lead the design, configuration, optimization, and delivery of Workday solutions across Baxter's global People Technology platform, with primary responsibility for Core HCM, Time Tracking, Absence, Scheduling, and Advanced Compensation. Partner with HR, IT, business stakeholders, and vendors to deliver scalable, compliant solutions that improve employee experience, operational efficiency, and workforce management.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Workday Configuration & Solution Delivery
* Lead the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Workday solutions across the assigned functional portfolio.
* Serve as the functional lead for Workday enhancements, projects, and bi-annual Workday releases.
* Design scalable and sustainable solutions utilizing native Workday capabilities and enterprise standards.
* Drive process simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives across HR technology processes.
* Collaborate with Integration Consultants and technical teams to ensure alignment between configuration and integration solutions throughout the Workday ecosystem.
* Partner with HR Product Owners, HR leadership, and business stakeholders to define product priorities, roadmaps, and strategic initiatives.
* Translate business requirements into effective Workday configurations and business process solutions.
* Facilitate solution design workshops and provide guidance on solution options, risks, dependencies, and downstream impacts.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve workforce processes, compliance, operational efficiency, and employee experience.
* Serve as a functional subject matter expert (SME) and provide configuration governance to implementation partners and vendors.
* Lead solution reviews, release assessments, testing activities, and deployment readiness evaluations.
* Establish and maintain configuration standards, documentation, governance processes, and best practices.
* Ensure all solutions comply with security, privacy, SOX, audit, and data governance requirements.

  
  
**What You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Information Systems, Human Resources, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience supporting HR technology, HRIS, or enterprise applications, including 5+ years of hands-on Workday configuration experience within complex enterprise environments.
* Proven success leading Workday implementations, enhancements, releases, and governance activities in global enterprise environments.

* Experience with additional Workday modules such as Recruiting, Talent, Performance, Succession, Benefits, or U.S. Payroll.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, consulting, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and present complex concepts clearly.
* Experience partnering with HR leaders, Product Owners, business stakeholders, vendors, and implementation partners to deliver strategic outcomes.
* Knowledge of Workday release management, testing methodologies, security, privacy, audit, SOX, and data governance requirements.
* Workday HCM, Time Tracking, Absence, Scheduling, or Advanced Compensation Certification preferred.
* Experience operating within SOX(Sarbanes-Oxley) regulated environments preferred.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* GBS / GCC Strategy and Setup: Lead analysis of operating model options (centralized, federated, hybrid) and build-operate setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GBS guiding principles, and process taxonomy (L0–L5) design for new and scaling shared services

* Working knowledge of at least 2–3 of the following: GBS / GCC / SSC setup, operating model design, sourcing & location strategy, org design & sizing, process maturity assessment, governance & interaction model design
* Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks and GBS transformation contexts
* Experience designing KPI and SLA frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
* Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches – capability, process, or operating-model maturity – and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
* Familiarity with core functional processes and process taxonomy frameworks such as the L0–L5 process hierarchy
* Awareness of Gen AI adoption in one or more functions including intelligent automation use cases and their implications for GBS process and workforce design
* Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills

**Additional Information:**

* Opportunity to work on GBS / GCC and operating model programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries

**Position Summary**
The Talent Insights & Analytics Analyst is a data-driven role responsible for consolidating, analyzing, and translating talent data into actionable insights that drive enterprise-wide decision making. This role partners closely with the Director, Enterprise Talent & Learning Strategy, HR Business Partners (HRBPs), Talent Leads, and business leaders to create a unified view of talent across the organization. The Analyst will aggregate and interpret data from multiple sources—including learning management systems (LMS), talent reviews, succession planning tools, and critical role frameworks—to provide meaningful insights on workforce capability, top talent, leadership pipelines, and development effectiveness. This role also serves as a key enabler of data visualization and digital talent analytics, leveraging tools such as Power BI to build custom dashboards, deliver proactive insights, and support the evolution of enterprise talent analytics capabilities. Success in this role requires strong analytical capability, technical fluency in reporting tools, and the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights that inform talent, HR, and business strategies.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Talent Data Integration & Reporting (Primary Focus)
* Compile and integrate talent data across multiple platforms and sources (e.g., LMS, talent review systems, succession planning tools, HRIS).
* Build and maintain consolidated talent dashboards and reports that provide a holistic view of workforce insights (e.g., talent segmentation, performance/potential, succession readiness).
* Leverage Power BI and other visualization tools to design dynamic, user-friendly dashboards tailored for HR and business stakeholders.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting outputs; proactively identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Automate and scale reporting processes to improve efficiency, accessibility, and self-service analytics capabilities.
* Talent Insights & Strategic Analysis
* Analyze talent data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities related to top talent, leadership pipelines, and workforce readiness.
* Provide proactive insights to Talent Leads, HRBPs, and business leaders to inform talent strategy decisions.
* Deliver insights on key talent topics, including:

+ Identification and tracking of high-potential and top talent populations
+ Succession plan readiness and coverage for critical roles
+ Bench strength, internal mobility, and retention trends

* Translate data into actionable recommendations that influence enterprise talent and workforce planning strategies.
* Learning & Development Analytics
* Analyze learning data from the LMS and digital learning platforms to assess engagement, completion, and program effectiveness.
* Partner with Talent & Learning stakeholders to measure the impact of enterprise learning initiatives (e.g., leadership development, early career programs, critical role development).
* Connect learning data with talent outcomes (e.g., promotion, progression, readiness) to assess effectiveness and ROI.
* Develop dashboards that provide visibility into learning journeys, utilization, and skill development trends.
* Talent Review & Succession Insights
* Support aggregation and analysis of enterprise talent review data, including performance, potential, and succession planning inputs.
* Track development plans for key talent and succession candidates, providing visibility into readiness progression.
* Enable insights into succession health, including gaps, risks, and pipeline strength for critical roles.
* Support efforts to capture and structure institutional knowledge related to critical roles, including knowledge transfer needs and continuity planning.
* Digital Analytics & Project Enablement
* Support and manage digital talent analytics initiatives, including dashboard development, reporting enhancements, and data transformation efforts.
* Partner with HRIS, IT, and data teams to improve data integration and reporting infrastructure.
* Lead or support continuous improvement projects to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of talent analytics tools and processes.
* Stay current on emerging trends in people analytics, data visualization, and HR technology to recommend forward-looking improvements.
* Support Talent Management initiatives and projects involving HRIS enhancements, system optimization, process improvements, and talent technology solutions.
* Partner with HRIS, HR Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to support talent-related systems, including performance management, succession planning, leadership development, and employee engagement processes.
* Assist with system upgrades, testing, troubleshooting, reporting, and user support to help ensure effective functionality and data integrity across Talent Management platforms.
* Coordinate project activities, maintain process documentation, and support implementation efforts for Talent Management programs and HR technology enhancements.
* Analyze talent-related data and metrics, identify process improvement opportunities, and support change management and user adoption activities related to Talent Management systems and processes.
* Stakeholder Partnership & Reporting Delivery
* Partner with HRBPs, Talent Leads, COEs, and business leaders to understand data needs and deliver tailored insights.
* Prepare executive-ready materials (dashboards, presentations, briefing packs) that clearly communicate talent insights, trends, and implications.
* Support key talent operating rhythms (e.g., talent reviews, succession discussions, quarterly business reviews) with timely, accurate data and analysis.

**Position Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Data Analytics, Business, Organizational Psychology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5+ years of experience in HR analytics, people analytics, talent management, or a related data-focused role.
* Strong proficiency in Power BI (or similar tools such as Tableau) with demonstrated experience building custom dashboards and visualizations.
* Advanced Excel/Sheets skills, including data manipulation and reporting.
* Experience working with HR systems and data sources (e.g., Workday, LMS, HRIS, talent/succession platforms).
* Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and compelling visual narratives.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with senior HR and business leaders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

description:

is a global AI and technology consulting company that helps businesses drive digital transformation through innovative technology solutions. **Job Title:**
Lead HR

**Experience:**
5–9 Years

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
Remote – Work From Home

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Reports To:**
Business Head / Management

The Lead HR will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle, strengthening HR processes, leading talent acquisition initiatives, ensuring statutory and policy compliance, and partnering with business and delivery leaders to build a productive, accountable, and employee-centric work culture.

The ideal candidate should have strong ownership, decision-making abilities, hands-on HR expertise, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Lead end-to-end HR operations, including onboarding, induction, employee documentation, confirmation, transfers, separation, full and final settlement, and exit formalities.
* Establish and maintain standardized HR policies, processes, SOPs, and employee records.
* Manage employee queries related to payroll, leave, attendance, benefits, policies, and employment documentation.
* Ensure timely issuance of offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, appraisal letters, experience letters, and other HR documents.
* Drive process automation and continuous improvement across HR operations.

**2. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment for technical and non-technical positions, including leadership and niche technology roles.
* Work closely with business and delivery heads to understand hiring requirements, workforce plans, and resource priorities.
* Manage recruitment pipelines, sourcing strategies, interview coordination, candidate assessments, offer management, and onboarding.
* Track recruitment metrics, hiring turnaround time, offer acceptance, and joining ratios.
* Improve recruitment efficiency through LinkedIn sourcing, AI-powered recruitment tools, structured assessments, and process automation.

**3. Performance Management & Employee Development**

* Manage the performance appraisal cycle, including goal setting, KPI alignment, feedback collection, performance reviews, and salary revision coordination.
* Partner with managers to establish measurable performance expectations and improve accountability.
* Facilitate employee development plans, performance improvement plans, and career progression discussions.
* Drive employee feedback mechanisms, manager connects, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Align performance outcomes with business priorities, market benchmarks, and internal compensation structures.

**4. Payroll, Compensation & Benefits**

* Coordinate monthly payroll processing, salary inputs, variable pay, incentives, reimbursements, and full and final settlements.
* Ensure accurate employee data and timely coordination with finance and payroll stakeholders.
* Manage compensation benchmarking, salary structures, pay revisions, and employee benefits.
* Oversee PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements in coordination with the relevant internal teams or external advisors.
* Handle payroll-related employee queries with clarity, confidentiality, and accuracy.

**5. Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Develop and implement employee engagement, recognition, retention, and well-being initiatives.
* Conduct employee connect sessions, feedback discussions, and exit interviews to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support managers in addressing employee concerns, workplace conflicts, and performance-related challenges.
* Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous learning.
* Plan and coordinate virtual engagement activities, celebrations, and employee recognition programs.

**6. HR Compliance, Audit & Documentation**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies.
* Maintain employee records, statutory documentation, HR trackers, and audit-ready evidence.
* Support internal audits and compliance requirements, including relevant ISO and CMMI-aligned HR processes.
* Coordinate background verification, employment verification, and employee documentation checks.
* Identify compliance gaps, implement corrective actions, and maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.

**7. HR Analytics, Automation & Process Improvement**

* Develop and maintain HR dashboards covering headcount, attrition, recruitment, employee performance, payroll, and engagement.
* Generate periodic HR reports and management updates to support data-driven decisions.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR activities using HRMS platforms, Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Excel, and other relevant tools.
* Establish clear process ownership, turnaround times, and accountability across HR activities.
* Drive Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance HR efficiency and employee experience.

**8. Strategic HR Business Partnering**

* Partner with leadership, business heads, and delivery managers to align HR initiatives with organizational goals.
* Support workforce planning, organizational structuring, succession planning, and retention strategies.
* Provide data-backed recommendations on compensation, employee productivity, hiring priorities, and HR process improvements.
* Handle sensitive employee matters with professionalism, fairness, discretion, and sound judgment.
* Take ownership of HR deliverables and ensure timely execution with minimal supervision.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 6–9 years of overall HR experience, with at least 2–3 years in a lead or managerial capacity in a mid size startup environment.
* Strong experience managing end-to-end HR operations in an IT, technology consulting, SaaS, or services organization.
* Proven expertise in talent acquisition, payroll coordination, employee lifecycle management, performance management, and HR compliance.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory requirements, including PF and other applicable employment compliances.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF, SUMIFS, and COUNTIFS.
* Experience with HRMS platforms, HR dashboards, and process automation tools.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to manage confidential information and make sound, fair, and business-oriented decisions.

**Preferred Competencies**

* Experience in a remote-first or distributed workforce environment.
* Exposure to ISO/CMMI-aligned processes, internal audits, and documentation standards.
* Experience implementing HR automation, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and timely execution.
* A hands-on, solution-oriented approach with strong ownership and accountability.

title: Technical Talent Partner
description:
**About the Opportunity:**

Join a globally recognized, product-led technology company focused on building innovative software solutions and delivering meaningful value to customers worldwide.

We’re looking for a
**Technical Talent Partner**
who understands the software engineering talent market and is passionate about helping product and engineering teams grow. In this role, you’ll partner closely with engineering leaders, technical leads, and hiring managers to shape recruitment strategies and attract exceptional mid- to senior-level talent, particularly across software development and engineering.

More than filling vacancies, you’ll serve as a trusted talent advisor—bringing market insights, targeted sourcing strategies, and a consultative approach to help build high-performing engineering teams and support long-term product growth.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Partner with software product and engineering teams to understand product roadmaps, technical priorities, team growth plans, and hiring requirements.
* Own the end-to-end technical recruitment process for mid- to senior-level IT positions, with a primary focus on software development and engineering roles.
* Collaborate with engineering leads and hiring managers to define role requirements, assess talent needs, and align on effective recruitment strategies.
* Build targeted talent pipelines for software engineers, developers, and other technical professionals through market mapping, direct sourcing, networking, and Boolean search.
* Provide technical talent market insights on candidate availability, skill demand, compensation trends, and competitive hiring conditions to guide recruitment decisions.
* Act as a strategic talent advisor, helping hiring teams refine requirements, evaluate candidate profiles, and navigate challenging technical searches.
* Deliver a high-quality candidate experience through clear communication, timely feedback, and a thoughtful, engaging recruitment process.
* Use recruitment metrics and funnel insights to monitor hiring progress, identify bottlenecks, and continuously improve recruitment outcomes.
* Support the long-term growth of software product teams by anticipating talent needs and building relationships with qualified technical professionals before vacancies arise.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 3–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Technical Recruitment, or Talent Partnering.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment for mid- to senior-level technology roles, particularly software development or software engineering positions.
* Strong understanding of software engineering talent profiles and the ability to identify relevant technical skills and experience.
* Experience partnering directly with engineering managers, technical leads, product teams, or other technology stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to develop sourcing strategies and attract talent in competitive technical markets.
* Proficiency in Boolean search, LinkedIn sourcing, talent mapping, and other candidate research techniques.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to provide market insights and influence hiring decisions.
* A data-driven, proactive, and consultative mindset, with a focus on hiring quality and long-term team growth.
* Experience supporting global or distributed technology teams is an advantage.

**Why Consider This Opportunity?**

* Join a Tier 1 global technology organization with a strong focus on software product innovation.
* Work closely with software product teams and engineering leaders, directly contributing to their growth and success.
* Manage meaningful mid- to senior-level technical searches rather than focusing solely on high-volume or transactional recruitment.
* Gain exposure to global talent markets, complex technical hiring challenges, and strategic stakeholder partnerships.
* Build your career as a consultative Talent Partner who influences hiring decisions and helps shape high-performing engineering teams.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are a technically minded recruitment professional who enjoys partnering with engineering leaders, identifying exceptional software development talent, and helping product teams scale, this opportunity offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a global technology organization.

description:
Career Services

Location: Bengaluru (On-site)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 2–3 years

Joining: Immediate or within 15 days

About Airtribe

Airtribe is an AI-first upskilling platform for working professionals. Our programs are designed

and delivered by industry leaders, with a strong focus on real-world application, outcomes,

and learner success.

As we scale, career outcomes are becoming a core part of how we create value for our

learners and differentiate ourselves in the market.

The Context

At Airtribe, learning does not end with sessions. It ends with real career outcomes.

As our learner base grows, ensuring consistent, high-quality placement outcomes and strong

hiring partnerships becomes increasingly complex. This requires structured systems, strong

company relationships, and tight alignment between learners and opportunities.

This role exists to build and scale a career services engine that drives learner success and

strengthens our hiring ecosystem.

The Role

As a Career Services Officer, you will own the end-to-end career outcomes function at Airtribe.

You will work at the intersection of learners, hiring partners, and internal teams, ensuring that

opportunities are created, learners are prepared, and outcomes are consistently delivered.

This is a high-ownership role with both execution and strategic responsibility.

What You’ll Own

● End-to-end career services function including partnerships, learner readiness, and

placements

● Outreach and relationship management with product-based startups and tech

companies

● Hiring pipeline management from JD discovery to final placement

● Career readiness initiatives including resume reviews, mock interviews, and coaching

● Internal coordination across teams to ensure learner-job fit

● Tracking systems, dashboards, and reporting for placements and partner performance

● Defining and improving processes across the career services journey

● Contributing to the long-term roadmap and strategy for this function

What Problems You’ll Solve

● Creating consistent placement outcomes as the learner base scales

● Building and maintaining strong hiring partner relationships

● Reducing gaps between learner readiness and job expectations

● Bringing structure and visibility to career outcomes and reporting

● Ensuring career services remains learner-first and outcome-driven

How This Role Evolves

In the initial phase, your focus will be on understanding the current ecosystem, building

partnerships, and driving placements.

Over time, you will build systems, improve efficiency, and define scalable processes for the

function.

As Airtribe grows, this role can evolve into leading the entire career services vertical and

building a team under it.

What We’re Looking For

● 2–3 years of experience in career services, recruitment, placements, B2B partnerships,

or related roles

● Experience working with hiring partners, preferably product-based companies

● Strong stakeholder management and outreach skills

● Excellent written and verbal communication

● High ownership mindset with a bias for execution

● Ability to think strategically while executing hands-on

● Comfort working in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Nice to have:

● Experience in edtech, HR-tech, or employability-focused startups

● Exposure to learner-facing or outcome-driven roles

What This Role Is Not

This is not a coordination or support role.

We are not looking for someone who only manages processes. We are looking for someone

who builds the function, drives outcomes, and takes ownership end-to-end.

Why Join Airtribe

● Opportunity to build and scale a core business function

● High ownership and autonomy in decision-making

● Direct impact on learner careers and company growth

● Close collaboration with founders and leadership

● Space to build systems, experiment, and scale responsibly

title: Senior HRBP
description:
**About Ethos**
**Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE)**
is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an HR Business Partner for India, you'll work closely with the Director of People – APAC to support our Bangalore based teams through a period of rapid growth. You will enable leaders to achieve their business goals through their people - building the capacity of the organization to attract, develop, and retain talent while ensuring every decision holds up against India's statutory and regulatory framework.
  
  
This role combines strategic HRBP partnership with hands-on ownership of India-specific compliance, employee relations, and operational rigor. You'll be a trusted advisor to business leaders and a steady, empathetic presence for employees, while working closely with Payroll & Compliance, Talent Acquisition, and Total Rewards to deliver a consistent employee experience.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
Business Partnership
  
  

* Conduct regular cadence meetings with your assigned business unit(s), acting as the primary People point of contact for leaders and employees.
* Provide compensation and leveling guidance to business unit leaders, in partnership with Total Rewards, anchored to India market benchmarks and internal equity.
* Analyze workforce trends and metrics - attrition, hiring, promotions, engagement - in partnership with the People Operations team to develop solutions, programs, and policies.
* Drive business unit organizational design and talent strategy to achieve business objectives, including headcount planning and role scoping.

Employee Relations & Compliance
  
  

* Manage and resolve complex employee relations issues; conduct thorough, objective, and well-documented investigations.
* Maintain in-depth, current knowledge of Indian labor law - including the Shops and Establishments Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Payment of Gratuity Act, POSH Act, and the New Labour Codes as they come into force - to reduce legal risk and ensure regulatory compliance across Karnataka and any other state of operation.
* Partner with Payroll & HR Compliance and external legal counsel as needed on statutory matters, notices, and filings.
* Own or contribute to background verification (BGV) exception handling and RAG-based risk assessment for your business unit, in line with company policy.
* Provide day-to-day performance management guidance to managers - coaching, counseling, career development, and disciplinary action - consistent with Indian employment norms and documentation standards.
* Work closely with management and employees to improve working relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Provide HR policy guidance and interpretation, flagging gaps between global policy and India-specific legal requirements.

Talent, Training & Culture
  
  

* Identify training needs for business units and individual coaching needs for people managers; monitor and follow up on training and upskilling objectives.
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes for your business unit, partnering with Onboarding & Ops on a smooth, compliant employee lifecycle.
* Gather and report on metrics related to retention, promotion, hiring, and diversity for your client group.
* Help build and refine India People Ops systems and processes - you'll help write a policy when one doesn't yet exist.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* 8+ years of experience as an HRBP, with a strong point of view on how HRBPs move a business forward; experience at a fast-growing technology or insurance company is a plus.
* In-depth working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance - PF, ESI, gratuity, statutory bonus, Karnataka Shops & Establishments Act, and the New Labour Codes. Prior exposure to a multi-state India compliance footprint is a strong plus.
* Experience managing complex employee relations cases, including conducting investigations and resolving disputes; experience partnering with Underwriting, Engineering, or another regulated business function is a plus.
* Working knowledge of multiple HR disciplines - organizational design, learning and development, compensation, HR technology, and data management.
* Exposure to a matrixed or multi-country People team structure (e.g., partnering across India, Singapore, or the US) is a plus.
* You are an empathetic listener who can build trust quickly and hold it, even in difficult conversations.
* You are data-driven - able to back up your recommendations to client groups with solid data and clear reasoning.
* You thrive in a fast-paced, first-principles environment and see the ambiguity of a scaling company as an exciting challenge rather than a blocker.
* You are a strong communicator, comfortable representing the People function to senior stakeholders.
* You have a genuine passion for diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Bachelor's degree required; a postgraduate qualification in HR or a related field is preferred.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
  
  
To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
  
  
***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

title: Specialist - HR Operations
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**
At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
  
  
As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
  
  
We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.
  
  
If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
**About the Role:**
This role ( Specialist - HR Operations) is the operational backbone of our employee experience across multiple entities. You will play a crucial role in managing our HR operations, Vendor management, Benefit administratement, payroll, compliance, audits and general HR functions and You will solve complex compliance and lifecycle challenges, ensuring our internal HR engine runs flawlessly as we scale. It's an exciting opportunity to build scalable workflows, bridge the gap between HR and other cross functional teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* Payroll Management : Oversee and manage the end-to-end in house payroll process, ensuring timely and accurate salary payments, deductions, and tax saving benefits administration. Maintain accurate and confidential payroll records and documentation.
* Tax Reporting : Prepare and file all required tax documents and reports, including quarterly and annual tax filings, 24Q to generate form 16 and other related forms.
* Payroll Reporting : Generate and share payroll reports in prescribed formats, including payroll summaries, tax reports, and compliance reports etc with the finance team.
* Audits and Reviews : Conduct regular payroll audits to ensure accuracy and compliance. Prepare for internal and external audits as required.
* Statutory compliance : Ensure timely preparation and payment of Statutory dues (PF, ESIC, LWF etc) and filling of paid challans.
* Compliance : Ensure adherence to all relevant employment laws and regulations. Conduct regular audits to maintain compliance and address any discrepancies or issues.
* Benefits Administration : Ensure accurate payroll deductions of employee benefits and timely process the payment to respective partners to record in employees wallets/accounts. Support Wellness benefits including health insurance, wellness benefits etc.
* Vendor Management: You’ll be the go-to person for all things related to our HR vendors and consultants. From the moment we decide to partner with someone new, you’ll take the reins—guiding them through onboarding, sorting out NDAs and InfoSec approvals, and getting their agreements finalized. You’ll also keep track of when contracts are up for renewal and handle them smoothly via Spotdraft. But your impact doesn't stop at contracts; you’ll be deeply involved in the financial side of things, too. You’ll run the PR-PO workflows on NetSuite, process invoices, reconcile accounts, and keep our HR Expense Tracker perfectly organized so we always know exactly where things stand.
* HR Operations : Support daily HR operations, including employee onboarding, records management, and HRIS maintenance. Act as a point of contact for HR-related inquiries. Work closely with other HR team members and departments to ensure seamless integration of HR processes and support organizational goals.
* HR System Management : Administrate and update HRMS as per the requirement. Implement and test system upgrades and changes to ensure continued accuracy and efficiency.
* Dashboard and Reporting : Develop and maintain HR dashboards and reports to track key metrics, identify trends, and provide insights.
* Project Management : Lead and participate in HR projects aimed at improving operational efficiency and employee satisfaction. Manage project timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.
* Attention to Detail : Maintain high levels of accuracy in all aspects of payroll processing, compliance, and reporting. Identify and resolve issues proactively. Ensure compliance with data protection regulations.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You Have:**

* Think in first principles and act like an owner, taking absolute accountability for sensitive data and compliance deadlines.
* Possess a sharp eye for numerical accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.
* Communicate with precision and empathy, effectively resolving employee queries and collaborating with external vendors.
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment, seamlessly balancing the operational needs of multiple entities.
* Have a strong bias for action and efficient problem-solving, turning operational bottlenecks into streamlined processes.
* Navigate ambiguity with ease, staying proactively updated on evolving state gazettes and labor laws.

﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿
  
  
**You’ll Know You’re Winning When:**

* You’re delivering 100% error-free and on-time monthly payroll and statutory filings with zero compliance defaults or penalties.
* You’ve established a frictionless benefits administration process, consistently resolving employee queries and enrollments within targeted SLAs.
* You’ve successfully streamlined the PR-PO and vendor onboarding workflows, resulting in fully reconciled and up-to-date HR expense trackers.
* You’ve elevated the new joiner orientation experience, ensuring all statutory forms, COCs, and compliance declarations are seamlessly executed on day one.

**Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You**
As the anchor of our HR team, Your work directly ensures that the people building CoinDCX feel genuinely supported, cared for, and paid on time, all while keeping our company safe and compliant. Along the way, you’ll get incredible hands-on experience managing HR and finance workflows across multiple entities. This is a special chance to shape how we care for our team from the ground up, doing meaningful work in an industry that's changing the world.
  
  
**Hiring Process:**
Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
  
  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round –A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

**Where We Work:**
We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
  
  
With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our
**Bangalore**
office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
  
  
**Perks That Empower You:**
We believe great people deserve great experiences.
  
  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

The role will own end-to-end program management of high-impact initiatives spanning the full L&D value chain: from shaping the hiring strategy and building organizational capability (associates and managers) through programs, to driving content development, expanding centralized learning systems, and leading change management across the network. You will be the single-threaded owner for programs such as Flex (ALFA), global learning benchmarks, and defect reduction — translating data into actionable learning interventions that move the needle on associate performance and operational quality.
  
  
This role demands a leader who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level — someone who can present compelling L&D narratives in Quarterly Business Reviews and Operational Planning forums to senior leadership, while simultaneously diving deep into data cuts to identify root causes and scope improvement opportunities. You will manage the L&D budget with fiscal discipline, drive the expansion of learning technology infrastructure, and navigate the learning implications of externalization changes — all while maintaining focus on the associate experience.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of program management expertise, analytical horsepower, learning domain knowledge, and the ability to influence without authority across operations, HR, quality, and technology teams. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with purpose, and are energized by the opportunity to build mechanisms that scale learning impact across one of the world's most complex fulfillment networks.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Hiring Strategy: Own the end-to-end L&D hiring strategy, including workforce planning, talent pipeline development, and role-specific competency frameworks. Partner with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely and quality hiring aligned to business growth plans.
  
  
ALFA Strategy: Evaluate and iterate on Flex Fulfillment Associate strategy — identify what is working, diagnose gaps, and drive continuous improvement through mechanism-based interventions.
  
  
Capability Building (GB & BB): Design, launch, and scale capability building programs. Define success metrics, track certification throughput, and ensure programs are tied to operational improvement outcomes.
  
  
Program Management: Own program management for new programs, global benchmarks. Drive cross-functional alignment, establish milestones, manage risks, and report progress to senior leadership.
  
  
QBR & OP1: Prepare and present L&D performance narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) and OP1 planning. Own the data story — translate learning metrics into business impact language that resonates with senior leaders.
  
  
Defect Reduction: Lead defect reduction initiatives by generating data cuts that identify scope of improvement. Partner with operations and quality teams to prioritize high-impact defect categories and design targeted learning interventions.
  
  
Content Development: Own the end-to-end content development strategy and execution. Define content standards, manage the content creation pipeline, and ensure learning materials are current, engaging, and aligned to operational needs. Drive content effectiveness measurement and continuous improvement.
  
  
Change Management: Lead change management initiatives related to learning programs and processes. Develop communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adoption frameworks to ensure smooth rollout of new learning initiatives across the network.
  
  
Central Learning Systems Expansion: Drive the expansion and optimization of centralized learning systems and technology infrastructure. Evaluate platform capabilities, manage vendor relationships, and ensure systems scale to meet growing organizational needs.
  
  
Learning: Manage learning implications of ATS externalization changes. Assess impact on training requirements, develop transition learning plans, and ensure associates impacted by externalization are equipped with the right skills and knowledge.
  
  
L&D Cost and Budgeting: Own the L&D budget and cost management process. Develop annual budgets, track spend against plan, identify cost optimization opportunities, and provide regular financial reporting to leadership.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience analyzing business metrics and training data to measure program effectiveness
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams
* Experience developing and implementing training programs
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience creating learning content and driving learning through a Learning Management System

**About The Role**

The incumbent will establish strong governance and controls, maintain audit readiness, manage service providers, support regulatory and policy implementation, and drive continuous improvement across the function.
  
  
MUFG Global Service Private Limited

* Payroll Operations

Lead the end-to-end monthly payroll process, including input governance, validation, approvals, processing, reconciliation and salary disbursement.
  
  
Ensure payroll accuracy, completeness and adherence to the approved payroll calendar and cut-off timelines.
  
  
Oversee variable pay, reimbursements, deductions, leave impacts, tax adjustments, arrears and full-and-final settlements.
  
  
Maintain maker-checker controls, payroll checklists, exception tracking and approval evidence.
  
  
Partner with Finance for payroll accounting, funding, general ledger reconciliation and closure of payroll variances.
  
  
Ensure employee payroll queries and escalations are resolved within agreed service levels.
  
  

* Statutory Compliance

* Benefits Administration

Maintain confidentiality, data privacy and access controls for payroll and benefits information.
  
  
Provide dashboards covering service delivery, compliance, exceptions, risks and vendor performance.
  
  

* Vendor and Stakeholder Management

Manage payroll providers, statutory consultants, insurance brokers, insurers and benefit providers against contracts and service levels.
  
  
Conduct service reviews and track incidents, recurring issues, corrective actions and closure.
  
  
Collaborate with HR Business Partners, Finance, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Procurement and Technology.
  
  
Ensure timely communication of payroll, statutory and benefits-related changes.
  
  

* Process Improvement and Technology

Identify opportunities to standardize, simplify and automate processes.
  
  
Partner with Workday and technology teams to improve data quality, controls, integrations, reporting and employee experience.
  
  
Lead or support implementations, user acceptance testing, change management and stabilization.
  
  
Use trend analysis to strengthen governance and support management decisions.
  
  
MUFG Global Service Private Limited
  
  
Job Description | Human Resources Central Services

Promote ownership, collaboration, customer focus, risk awareness and continuous improvement.
