With clients spanning the globe and an exciting pipeline of projects across industries, Diversified offers more than just a job. We offer a career path with the flexibility to grow personally and professionally, wherever your ambitions take you.
  
  
As a Diversified associate, you'll dive headfirst into big, complex, and rewarding projects that push the boundaries of what's possible. Plus, you'll enjoy a flexible work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and a culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.
  
  
**IF YOU CAN DREAM IT, YOU CAN DO IT AT DIVERSIFIED.**
**Talent Acquisition Lead**
India | Global Talent Acquisition
  
  

* Shift Timing - IST 5 PM - 2 AM

**Overview Of Position**
The Talent Acquisition Lead is responsible for implementing talent acquisition processes across Diversified’s global operations, including the US, Canada, EMEA, Australia and India. Based in Bangalore, this position will lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists supporting sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer coordination, helping deliver consistent service and an outstanding experience for internal and external candidates.
  
  
The Talent Acquisition Lead partners with global (US-based) Talent Acquisition leadership, regional HR teams, and hiring leaders to translate agreed processes into practical workflows, support adoption, and contribute ideas for improvement. Success requires demonstrated experience implementing comparable recruitment processes across regions, excellent spoken and written English, and the ability to use ATS and candidate data to improve hiring efficiency and service quality.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Implement talent acquisition processes globally, adapting execution to regional requirements in partnership with local HR while maintaining consistent standards.
* Develop and execute rollout plans covering process documentation, responsibilities, training, milestones, and adoption tracking; identify barriers and coordinate practical solutions with the appropriate leaders.
* Establish clear workflows and service expectations from requisition intake through sourcing, interview scheduling, offer coordination, and handoff to onboarding.
* Lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists through training, regular feedback, quality reviews, and hands-on support for complex or urgent needs.
* Help coordinate team priorities, monitor capacity and service delivery, and work with the appropriate leaders to address bottlenecks across regions and time zones.
* Ensure sourcing aligns with role requirements and agreed recruiting strategies, interview scheduling is responsive, and offer documentation and approvals are accurate and timely.
* Work collaboratively with senior leaders and hiring teams to understand hiring needs, share progress, and contribute practical ideas that support effective recruitment.
* Partner with recruiters, HRBPs, hiring managers, and external recruitment partners to clarify responsibilities, address questions, and support consistent follow-through.
* Provide a professional, respectful candidate experience through timely updates, clear interview instructions, reliable coordination, and appropriate communication when candidates are not selected.
* Gather candidate and hiring manager feedback and implement improvements to communication, scheduling, and offer processes that reflect Diversified’s values and employer brand.
* Partner with HR Operations and technology teams to align ATS workflows, templates, approvals, and reporting with the global process; support consistent system use and accurate records.
* Analyze ATS utilization, open requisition aging, time to fill, time to hire, time in stage, sourcing effectiveness, candidate conversion, withdrawals, and offer acceptance.
* Prepare recurring dashboards and concise reporting that explain trends, identify bottlenecks, recommend actions, and track the impact of process improvements.
* Establish consistent metric definitions and data quality checks with HR Operations; protect candidate confidentiality and follow company policies and applicable regional requirements in partnership with local HR.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
* Experience: 8+ years of progressive talent acquisition or recruitment operations experience, including at least 3 years leading, guiding, and coaching a recruitment or talent acquisition support team.
* Global Implementation Experience: Demonstrated success implementing standardized recruitment processes across multiple countries or regions, including supporting US stakeholders from India or another global delivery location. Must provide concrete examples of personal ownership from planning through adoption and measurable outcomes.
* Team Leadership: Proven experience leading, guiding, and coaching specialists responsible for sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer preparation or coordination.
* English Communication: Excellent spoken and written English is essential, including the ability to participate effectively in discussions with senior leaders, share ideas clearly, write polished candidate communications, and explain data and process changes.
* Systems and Analytics: Strong working knowledge of enterprise ATS platforms, recruitment workflows, reporting, and data quality practices. Strong Excel skills and the ability to translate recruitment data into practical recommendations. Dayforce ATS and Power BI experience preferred.
* Skills and Competencies: Strong relationship-building, coaching, process implementation, problem-solving, and organizational skills; sound judgment and the ability to balance competing priorities and support change.
* Global Collaboration: Ability to work across cultures and time zones, with planned overlap with US and other regional business hours. Experience building or scaling global recruitment operations or shared services preferred.
* Industry Experience: Experience supporting technology, engineering, or project delivery recruitment preferred.

**Key Success Metrics**

* Delivers agreed global rollout milestones and achieves consistent process adoption across participating regions.
* Strengthens specialist capability and improves responsiveness, accuracy, and completion of sourcing, scheduling, and offer coordination activities.
* Improves ATS utilization, data completeness, and timely updates to requisition and candidate records.
* Reduces avoidable delays, aged open requisitions, and time spent in hiring stages against agreed baselines and targets.
* Improves candidate and hiring manager feedback, candidate progression, and offer acceptance through better communication and coordination.
* Provides accurate, timely reporting and recommendations that result in measurable recruitment process improvements.

**What We Offer**
Along with competitive compensation, you will be eligible for the following benefits:
  
  

* Multiple medical plan for self and family
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, and Employee Assistance Plan (EAP)
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Commuter & Shift Benefits (US / APAC shifts)

To learn more about becoming part of the Diversified team, visit us at https://onediversified.com/careers/careers-at-diversified or email us at careers@onediversified.com.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
  
  
We believe in fair and equitable hiring practices and strive to create an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered.

description:

The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire-to-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Business Operations to bring data-driven, compliant, and innovative solutions to life.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as a Delivery Lead and Principal Product Analyst for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on the
**Growth & Talent**
pod. In this broad role, you will lead complex, multi-system initiatives spanning Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Performance, Learning, and Career Development. You will serve as the crucial conduit between Product Management, Recruiting/Talent Acquisition leadership, Talent Management, and People Operations, driving technical execution against a prioritized backlog to align with Okta's strategic workforce goals.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* **Strategic Leadership:**
  Technically scope and lead the delivery of multi-quarter, high-visibility, executive-sponsored projects across the Growth & Talent ecosystem (e.g., Greenhouse ATS integration & workflows, Cornerstone L&D platform optimization, and Workday Talent & Performance solutions).
* **Subject Matter Expertise:**
  Serve as the functional specialist and delivery lead for the Growth & Talent pod, specializing in talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, learning management, and career development technology integrations.
* **Core Systems Architecture & Integration:**
  Partner with enterprise architects and delivery engineers to drive seamless end-to-end integrations across
  **Greenhouse**
  (Applicant Tracking System),
  **Cornerstone**
  (Learning & Experience Platform), and
  **Workday**
  (Talent, Performance, Skills, and Core HCM).

  Drive delivery against a prioritized backlog for aligned Talent Acquisition and Talent Management stakeholder groups, ensuring successful project execution from start to finish.

  Operate actively in a Scrum framework—breaking down complex epics and business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable technical tasks while participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* **Process Innovation & AI Enablement:**
  Utilize functional and technical talent domain expertise to identify opportunities to optimize, automate, and innovate recruitment workflows, employee learning paths, and internal mobility through modern technology and AI capabilities.
* **Impediment Resolution:**
  Proactively identify and resolve project-level risks, cross-system integration blockers, and requirement trade-offs with Talent Acquisition and Talent Management stakeholders to ensure on-time delivery.
* **Mentorship & Influence:**
  Guide project teams through uncertainty, facilitate technical scoping workshops, and provide mentorship to junior analysts and developers.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:**
  Act as the primary conduit between Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and technical delivery teams, owning and writing detailed functional requirements, business process flows, data mappings, and use cases.

**What You'll Bring to the Role**

* **Experience:**
  10+ years of related experience in a professional People Technology / HRIS role with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6+ years with a Master’s degree.
* **Domain & System Expertise:**
  Deep functional and technical knowledge of core Growth & Talent platforms, specifically
  **Greenhouse**
  (ATS),
  **Cornerstone**
  (LMS/L&D), and
  **Workday Talent & Performance**
  (Succession, Performance Reviews, Goals, Feedback, Skills).
* **Delivery Leadership:**
  Proven track record as a Delivery Lead managing complex, multi-system HR technology initiatives, integrations, and feature rollouts.
* **Problem Solving & Systems Analysis:**
  Ability to handle complex issues spanning multiple applications, data structures, and HR processes, requiring analysis of diverse data factors.
* **Collaboration & Alignment:**
  Exceptional collaboration skills to build strong relationships with key stakeholders across Recruiting, HR Ops, and Talent Development, managing conflicting perspectives and reaching consensus.
* **Strategic Thinking:**
  Strategic mindset to anticipate future talent technology architecture needs, internal mobility initiatives, and proactive system optimizations.
* **Agile Leadership:**
  Strong leadership qualities to guide agile delivery pods, facilitate requirements workshops, and mentor team members.
* **Extra Credit:**
  Experience implementing AI/Automation use cases within HR tech (e.g., candidate matching, skill taxonomy mapping, automated learning pathways); relevant industry certifications (Workday Talent/Performance certifications, Agile/Scrum certification).

**The Okta Experience**

* Supporting Your Well-Being
* Driving Social Impact
* Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + Community

We are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

title: Principal Associate - Business Partnering
description:
**About The Company**
**Who are we?**
Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.
  
  
We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Strategic Business Partnership**

* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, leveraging workforce insights to inform business strategy.

* Drive large-scale organizational transformation, including restructuring, workforce planning, and change management.

**Employee Experience & Relations**

* Shape and embed organizational culture through enterprise-wide engagement initiatives.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex employee relations matters, ensuring risk mitigation and full compliance.

**Performance & Talent Management**

* Drive the talent management strategy, including leadership development and succession planning for critical roles.
* Manage annual and mid-year performance reviews, feedback cycles, and promotion processes in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with the L&D team to identify skill gaps and support capability-building programs.

**Resource Management & Talent Acquisition**

* Track headcount, analyze attrition trends, and maintain accurate employee records.
* Utilize predictive analytics to forecast talent needs and proactively mitigate attrition risks.

**Governance, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Lead audits and risk assessments related to HR processes and employee relations.
* Contribute to policy formulation and HR frameworks while adapting them to business-specific needs.

**Key Competencies**

* HR Generalist Expertise: Deep understanding of core HR processes and policies, with a proven ability to act as a change agent.
* Business Acumen: Strong grasp of the broader business environment, market dynamics, and operational priorities.
* Analytical Thinking & Advanced Analytics: Comfort with large, complex datasets, with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
* Influence & Communication: Outstanding communication skills with a proven track record of collaborating and influencing without formal authority.
* Problem-Solving: A structured, methodical approach to resolving complex issues and implementing effective HR solutions.
* Agility: Capability to thrive and deliver results in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

**Qualifications & Experience**
**Education & Experience**

* Education: MBA from a Tier-1 or Tier-2 institute.
* Experience: 6 to 10 years of relevant HRBP experience, preferably within fashion, retail, or e-commerce.
* Proven track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders effectively.
* Strong decision-making skills paired with high attention to detail.

**Domain Skills**

* Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to translate data insights into actionable business plans.
* Excellent project management capabilities, including managing timelines, resources, and budgets.
* Proficiency in driving cross-functional initiatives and delivering executive-level communications.

This is your chance to fashion the future at scale—while paving your own path to growth. Ready to be the trend? Be Myntra.

workforce analytics, predictive insights, career architecture, change management

**Job Summary**
Helps drive company values and philosophy and ensures all training and development activities are strategically linked to the organization’s mission and vision. Works with property leadership team to identify and address employee and organizational development needs. The position is responsible for ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results. Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills. Conducts needs assessments, designs and develops training programs and facilitates the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs. Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
  
  
**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
**Education And Experience**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer.

OR
  
  

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**
**Administering Employee Training Programs**

* Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
* Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
* Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
* Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
* Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
* Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
* Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.

**Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness**

* Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
* Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
* Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
* Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
* Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
* Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.

**Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets**

* Ensures all training and development activities (department specific and general property training) are strategically linked to the organization’s mission and vision.
* Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
* Makes any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
* Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
* Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
* Develops specific training to improve service performance.
* Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
* Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.

**Managing Training Budgets**

* Participates in the development of the Training budget as required.
* Manages budget in alignment with Human Resources and property financial goals.
* Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
* Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

title: Cluster Assistant Human Resource Manager_South Region
description:
Cluster Assistant Human Resource Manager
  
  
**Brand:**
Holiday Inn Express – IHG Hotels & Resorts
  
  
**Department:**
Human Resources
  
  
**Job Band:**
06
  
  
**Location:**
Cluster Role – Hyderabad, Bengaluru & Chennai, India
  
  
**Reports To:**
Portfolio HR Director
  
  
**Travel Requirement:**
Frequent inter-property travel across assigned hotels
  
  
**About Holiday Inn Express**
At Holiday Inn Express, we believe in making travel simple and smart. We focus on delivering a comfortable stay, friendly service and the essentials that matter most to our guests.
  
  
As part of IHG Hotels & Resorts, we are committed to creating True Hospitality for everyone. We are looking for a people-oriented HR professional who can support our hotel teams, strengthen employee engagement and drive consistent HR practices across our multi-property portfolio.
  
  
Role Overview – What Is the Job?
  
  
The Cluster Assistant HR Manager will support and drive the Human Resources function across assigned Holiday Inn Express hotels in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai. The role will be responsible for implementing HR policies and procedures, talent acquisition, employee engagement, learning and development, performance management, employee relations, payroll coordination and statutory compliance.
  
  
The position will work closely with General Managers, Hotel Managers, Department Heads and the Portfolio HR Director to build a positive workplace culture, ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and support business performance through effective people management.
  
  
This is a multi-property role requiring strong execution, stakeholder management, analytical skills and the ability to travel regularly across assigned hotel locations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Human Resources Operations
* Manage and coordinate day-to-day HR operations across assigned hotel properties, ensuring consistency in HR processes and adherence to company policies.
* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, HR documentation, attendance and employee lifecycle data.
* Coordinate onboarding, induction, confirmation, transfers, promotions, employee separations and full-and-final settlement inputs.
* Support the implementation and effective utilisation of HRMS and recruitment systems.
* Ensure timely preparation of HR reports, manpower updates, organisational structures and other management reports.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of employee information and HR records.
* Talent Acquisition and Manpower Planning
* Coordinate end-to-end recruitment activities, including manpower requisitions, candidate sourcing, interview scheduling, selection coordination and offer management.
* Partner with General Managers and Department Heads to understand manpower requirements and ensure timely recruitment.
* Monitor vacancies, recruitment turnaround time, joining ratios and manpower availability across the assigned hotels.
* Ensure recruitment practices comply with IHG standards, company policies and applicable employment requirements.
* Support effective manpower planning, internal career progression and talent development initiatives.
* Payroll, Compensation & Benefits
* Coordinate monthly attendance, payroll inputs, employee master updates, leave data, incentives and other salary-related information with the respective stakeholders and payroll team.
* Review payroll inputs for completeness and accuracy and facilitate timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Coordinate employee benefits, salary revisions, reimbursements and other compensation-related processes as applicable.
* Monitor employee costs and manpower expenses against approved budgets.
* Support preparation and validation of payroll reports, employee cost analysis and related management information.
* Statutory Compliance and Employee Documentation
* Ensure timely coordination and monitoring of applicable statutory compliances, including EPF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity and other applicable employment requirements.
* Coordinate with payroll teams, external consultants, vendors and relevant stakeholders for statutory calculations, payments, returns, registers and documentation.
* Monitor applicable central and state employment laws, statutory deadlines, regulatory changes and establishment-specific requirements.
* Maintain compliance records, licences, registers, notices and other prescribed documentation as applicable.
* Conduct periodic HR compliance reviews and support internal and external audits.
* Track compliance gaps, facilitate corrective actions and escalate material risks to the Portfolio HR Director and relevant management.
* Employee Engagement, Relations & Retention
* Promote the IHG Winning Ways culture and create a positive, inclusive and engaging work environment.
* Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities, recognition programmes, celebrations and team-building initiatives.

title: Head of Employee Relations for India and APAC, Vice President
description:
As
**Head of Employee Relations for India and APAC,**
you will provide strategic leadership and expert advice to business divisions and corporate functions across the region. You will be responsible for the effective management of complex employee relations matters and associated legal, financial, and reputational risks.
  
  
The Employee Relations function plays a critical role in supporting organisational performance by advising on workplace issues and addressing employee concerns. In this role, you will deliver pragmatic, commercially focused solutions while building manager capability and strengthening employee engagement.
  
  
This position is suited to a senior Employee Relations professional with deep regional expertise across India and APAC and a proven ability to operate in a complex, global environment at both an operational and strategic level.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Head of Employee Relations - India & APAC is a senior leadership role responsible for providing strategic, operational, and people leadership across Employee Relations for India and the broader APAC region.
  
  
This role serves as the primary regional escalation point for complex and high-risk employee relations matters, ensures consistent application of ER standards across jurisdictions, and builds a scalable regional model aligned with global frameworks, local requirements, and evolving data- and technology-enabled ways of working.
  
  
Reporting into Head of Employee Relations – International, the role leads a team of ER professionals across APAC and India and partners closely with HR, Legal, Compliance, Conduct Standards, Ethics, Corporate Audit, Global Security, and business leadership to identify, manage, and mitigate employee-related risk.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Regional ER Leadership & Strategy
  
  

* Provide end-to-end leadership for Employee Relations across India and APAC, ensuring alignment with global ER strategy and standards.
* Partner with the Managing Director, Head of International Employee Relations, to shape and execute the regional ER operating model, including governance, escalation pathways, capability building, and technology-enabled process and service improvements.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior business and HR leaders on complex, sensitive, and high-risk employee relations matters.
* Provide leadership across diverse APAC jurisdictions with varying employment law frameworks, regulatory obligations, and cultural considerations, balancing global consistency with local requirements and business needs.

Case Oversight, Conduct & Risk Management
  
  

* Provide oversight and direction on complex investigations, grievances, employee misconduct matters, executive employee matters, and other high-risk employee relations issues.
* Oversee employee misconduct and conduct-related matters in partnership with Conduct Standards, Ethics, Legal, Compliance, and Global Security, ensuring consistent, fair, and risk-appropriate outcomes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for significant employee conduct matters, sensitive investigations, and issues presenting legal, regulatory, reputational, operational, or cultural risk.
* Ensure matters are handled in a consistent, fair, and risk-aware manner, balancing legal, regulatory, cultural, and reputational considerations.
* Support regional governance and risk management activities, including audit reviews, regulatory inquiries, employee-related risk reporting, and senior leadership forums.

Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Lead, develop, and coach a team of VP/AVP/Officer level Employee Relations consultants across India and APAC.
* Build a high-performing Employee Relations leadership team and succession pipeline through coaching, talent development, learning agility, knowledge sharing, and consistent decision-making.
* Set clear expectations, promote accountability, and foster a collaborative, inclusive team culture.
* Create a cohesive regional Employee Relations function that delivers consistent, high-quality support while effectively navigating local market and jurisdictional differences.
* Develop senior Employee Relations practitioners and sustainable regional capability by promoting continuous learning, adaptability, and readiness for emerging technologies and evolving workforce expectations.

Stakeholder Partnership
  
  

* Establish strong partnerships with HR Business Partners, COEs, and regional leadership teams.
* Provide guidance and challenge to stakeholders to drive appropriate outcomes while protecting the organisation and its employees.
* Support restructurings, integrations, transformation programs, and other organisational change, helping leaders adopt new ways of working effectively.
* Maintain strong relationships with internal and external counsel and relevant industry networks to anticipate legal, regulatory, and market developments across APAC.

Governance, Standards & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Ensure regional ER practices align with global policies, local labour laws, and regulatory expectations.
* Use Employee Relations metrics, case data, trend analysis, and thematic reporting to identify emerging risks, generate actionable insights, inform proactive interventions, and enable evidence-based senior leadership decisions.
* Report on Employee Relations activity, conduct-related concerns, organisational trends, and key risk indicators across the region.
* Contribute to the evolution of ER policies, frameworks, and manager capability initiatives.

**Experience**
**Required Experience & Capabilities**

* Significant senior-level experience in Employee Relations / Employment Law / HR Advisory, ideally within a complex, global organisation.
* Proven experience leading regional or multi-country ER teams.
* Strong track record managing high-risk, high-profile, and senior-level ER matters.
* Experience operating in regulated environments and partnering with Legal and Compliance.

Skills & Attributes
  
  

* Strong judgment and decision-making capability in complex and ambiguous situations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills at senior leadership level.
* Ability to balance global consistency with local nuance and cultural sensitivity.
* Proven people leader with experience developing senior professionals.
* Commercial, pragmatic approach with a strong risk and conduct mindset.
* Ability to use data, technology, and innovative approaches to improve Employee Relations outcomes and processes.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Global Process Owner - Payroll & Absence
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**About The Team**
People Solutions Excellence exists to drive executional excellence in HR operations, services and transactions. We help improve how People Solutions operates by making processes simpler, services better, decisions more data-driven, and change more successful.
  
  
We're a global team of experts in process improvement, people experience, service excellence, data and analytics, reporting, and project delivery. Working closely with our HR Centres of Excellence and People Solutions teams, we solve problems, streamline ways of working, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
Our role is to create consistent, scalable solutions that work globally while allowing for local needs where required. We bridge the gap between business requirements and operational delivery; helping People Solutions deliver better experiences, stronger outcomes, and lasting adoption of change.
  
  
Our Global Process Owners (GPOs) in our Global Process Solutions team are critical to helping us deliver this ambition; ensuring business need is translated into clear, standardised and scalable process solutions, enabling consistent ways of working and driving improved service outcomes.
  
  
**About The Role**
As
**GPO for Payroll, Time & Attendance**
you will be responsible for partnering closely with the Payroll team to design, govern and continuously improve our payroll processes across the globe and ensure we have cost effective, automated and easy to use time & attendance solutions.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end global Payroll, Time & Attendance process framework, driving standardisation, governance and continuous improvement across all markets.
* Define, maintain and optimise global Payroll and Time & Attendance processes, ensuring they are efficient, scalable, compliant and aligned with Haleon’s operating model.
* Act as subject matter expert for Payroll and Time & Attendance processes, providing guidance and decision-making support to People Solutions, HR teams, Digital & Technology teams and business stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Payroll, People Solutions, Finance, Risk & Compliance, and Digital & Technology teams to drive process simplification, automation and service excellence.
* Establish and maintain global process standards, controls, policies, Knowledge contents and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring consistency while balancing local regulatory and legislative requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging process analytics, automation opportunities and industry best practices to improve employee experience, payroll accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with payroll legislation, labour laws, tax regulations, statutory obligations and Haleon policies across all relevant jurisdictions.
* Partner with the Quality & Effectiveness team to define and monitor key process performance indicators (KPIs), service level agreements (SLAs), quality metrics and payroll accuracy measures, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead process governance forums and stakeholder engagement activities, ensuring alignment of process priorities, change initiatives and business requirements.
* Partner with Digital & Technology teams to help shape the payroll and workforce management systems roadmap.
* Provide process leadership for technology enhancements, integrations and digital transformation initiatives.
* Ensure robust governance and integrity of Payroll and Time & Attendance data across HR, payroll and workforce management platforms.
* Support acquisitions, divestitures, organisational redesigns and transformation programs impacting Payroll and Time & Attendance processes.
* Collaborate with vendors, consultants and implementation partners to evaluate and adopt best-in-class solutions and practices.

**About You**
Technical and functional expertise:
  
  

* 8-10 years of experience in Payroll, Time & Attendance, HR Operations, Shared Services, Process Ownership or related disciplines.
* Strong expertise in global payroll operations, workforce management processes, payroll controls and employee lifecycle impacts on payroll.
* Deep understanding of payroll legislation, labour regulations, tax compliance requirements and workforce management practices across multiple countries.
* Experience operating within complex global organisations, ideally using multiple payroll vendors and service delivery models.
* Proven experience leading global process ownership, governance and standardisation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of Workday and payroll-related integrations, with the ability to assess process, data and system impacts.
* Experience working with global payroll providers such as ADP, CloudPay, Workday Payroll or similar solutions is preferred.
* Demonstrable experience leveraging data analytics and process insights to drive business performance improvements.
* Knowledge of automation, digital transformation and emerging technologies impacting HR Operations and Shared Services.
* Certification in Payroll (e.g. CIPP) and/or process improvement methodology (e.g. Lean Six Sigma) is advantageous.

Leadership and behavioural capabilities:
  
  

* Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Strong communication and influencing capabilities across global, virtual and cross-functional environments.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and navigate competing priorities effectively.
* Curious, proactive and solutions-focused, with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Resilient and adaptable, able to navigate ambiguity and changing business needs.
* Demonstrates accountability and ownership for delivering results.
* Strong commercial thinking, analytical capability and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail with a focus on compliance, governance and operational excellence.
* Demonstrable capability to lead change, drive adoption and deliver sustainable business outcomes, preferably in complex environments.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-10-17
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
HR Business Partner — People \& Culture
 



 Panigrahana Weddings \| Bengaluru \| Full\-time, on\-site
 



  





 Build the HR function of a growing wedding planning and design business. We are looking for a hands\-on HR Business Partner who can turn people needs into practical systems, earn employees’ trust and hold managers accountable. You will own the employee lifecycle and help shape how the company hires, works, develops people and handles difficult conversations.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



 • End\-to\-end recruitment: understand hiring needs, define roles, source talent, run structured interviews, coordinate offers and improve quality of hire.
 



 • Joining and onboarding: documentation, induction, role clarity, probation reviews and a consistent new\-joiner experience.
 



 • HR foundations: organisation structure, job descriptions, policies, employee records, attendance and leave processes, and reliable HR reporting.
 



 • Performance and development: clear expectations, review cycles, manager coaching, feedback and practical learning plans.
 



 • Employee relations: listen carefully, handle concerns confidentially, resolve conflict fairly and follow through on commitments.
 



 • Culture and retention: build everyday practices that support trust, accountability, recognition and effective collaboration across sales, design, planning and execution teams.
 



 • Exits: thoughtful exit interviews, handovers, documentation and coordination of final settlements; use the feedback to improve the workplace.
 



 • People operations: coordinate payroll inputs, benefits and applicable compliance with finance and specialist advisers.
 



  





 WHO WILL DO WELL HERE
 



 • You have independently handled both recruitment and broader HR operations, with examples of systems you built or improved.
 



 • You can work in a startup environment: create the process, implement it yourself and keep it usable as the business grows.
 



 • You combine emotional intelligence with sound judgment. You can be empathetic without avoiding difficult decisions, and direct without losing respect for people.
 



 • You are organised, discreet and comfortable working closely with founders and functional leaders.
 



 • Experience in hospitality, events, creative services or another people\-intensive business is helpful.
 



  





 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 



 A dependable hiring pipeline, clear roles and onboarding, accurate people records, useful review routines, and employees who know where to raise concerns and receive follow\-through.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



 Apply with your CV. Please include a short example of an HR process you built from scratch and a people challenge you handled, without sharing confidential employee information. Tell us your current location and notice period.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who wants responsibility for the whole HR function and enjoys doing the work as well as setting direction.

 micro1 is engaging experienced Product \& Engineering Experts to contribute to a customer project focused on improving the quality, clarity, and effectiveness of executive\-level business presentations.

 **1–2 hours**

 for senior stakeholders or client audiences.

 .

 in product management, engineering leadership, or technical program management.

title: Head of HR Operations & Recruitment
description:
ABOUT ARIVUPRO ACADEMY
   

 ArivuPro Academy is South India's leading commerce and professional\-certification academy, coaching students for CA, CS, CMA India, ACCA, CMA USA, CFA, CIA, CPA US, EA, FRM, CFP and CIMA UK, alongside its
   

 integrated ArivuPro One degree\-plus\-certification programme. With centers across Karnataka (Bangalore — Koramangala, Malleshwaram) and Tamil Nadu (Chennai — Tambaram, Nungambakkam; and Coimbatore), over 100,000 students trained, 5,000\+ daily learners and 25\+ institutional partnerships (including RV University and GSSS Institute of Engineering and Technology for Women), ArivuPro operates at a B2B/institutional scale — and is now expanding into new certification tracks including US CPA. That growth has outpaced ad hoc HR support.
   

  

 We're hiring a Head of HR Operations \& Recruitment to build
   

 the function properly — owning everything from faculty and staff hiring to onboarding, policy, compliance and people operations across all five centres.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

 This is a build\-and\-own mandate, not a maintenance role. You will design ArivuPro's HR operations function from the ground up — processes, policies and systems — while personally driving recruitment for a business with two distinct hiring tracks: subject\-matter faculty (CA/CS/CMA/ACCA/CPA and other qualified experts) and corporate/support staff (academic coordinators, business development, operations, admin) across centres in Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. You'll report to the Director and Vertical Head, and have real latitude to
   

 shape how the function runs.
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL OWN
   

 •Recruitment strategy \& delivery — Run full\-cycle hiring for both faculty (qualified CA/CS/CMA/ACCA/CPA professionals and subject experts) and corporate roles across Bangalore, Chennai (Thambaram, Nungambakkam) and Coimbatore, including sourcing channels specific to each (professional networks and alumni for faculty; standard job boards and referrals for staff).
   

 •Faculty pipeline — Build a repeatable pipeline for scarce, high\-demand faculty talent ahead of new batch launches and new certification tracks (e.g., the upcoming US CPA rollout), so hiring never becomes the bottleneck on batch scheduling.
   

 •HR operations infrastructure — Stand up onboarding, attendance, leave, performance and offboarding processes across all five centres; select and implement an HRMS/ATS suited to a multi\-location, dual\-workforce (faculty \+ staff) academy.
   

 •Policy \& documentation — Own and maintain HR policy documentation, including compensation and incentive structures for revenue\-facing roles (e.g., business development), employment contracts, and faculty engagement terms; ensure consistency across centres.
   

 •Compliance — Ensure statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH, shops \& establishments, and other applicable labour law) across both states of operation — Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
   

 •Institutional coordination — Work closely with academic operations on faculty deployment and batch scheduling, and support HR aspects of institutional partnership agreements (e.g., staffing commitments tied to
   

 university/college tie\-ups).
   

 •Team building — Recruit and lead a small HR ops/recruitment team as hiring volume grows across centres.
   

 •Culture \& retention — Own engagement and retention initiatives for a workforce split between full\-time staff and part\-time/visiting faculty — a materially different retention problem from a typical corporate team.
   

  

 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
   

 •8\+ years in HR with at least 3 years owning recruitment and HR operations end\-to\-end, ideally with P\&L or function\-building accountability.
   

 •Proven experience recruiting specialist/credentialed talent, not just generalist corporate hiring — ed\-tech, professional training, higher education, EdTech, or a similarly expertise\-driven hiring environment is a strong plus.
   

 •Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH); multi\-state/multilocation HR experience preferred given ArivuPro's five\-centre footprint across Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
   

 •Track record of building HR processes and policy from scratch, not just operating within an existing system.
   

 •Comfortable in a fast\-scaling, founder\-led environment — able to move between strategic policy work and hands\-on interview scheduling in the same week.
   

 •Strong stakeholder management — this role sits close to the Director and Vertical Head and coordinates constantly with academic operations.
   

 •Familiarity with the CA/CS/CMA/ACCA coaching or broader professional\-certification education space is a strong advantage, though not mandatory.
   

  

 WHAT ARIVUPRO OFFERS
   

 •A genuine build mandate — shape the HR function for a scaling, multi\-location institution rather than inherit someone else's system.
   

 •Direct access to and mentorship from the Director and Vertical Head.
   

 •A fast\-growing organization with 25\+ institutional partnerships and an expanding certification portfolio (ACCA, and now US CPA).
   

 •Competitive compensation, benchmarked to experience and scope of ownership.
   

  

 TO APPLY
   

 Send your resume and a short note on the most complex HR function you've built or scaled to hr@arivupro.com
   

  

  

 Benefits
   

  

 Health Insurance

title: Director, Human Resources
description:
**Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**
 Kobie, a 35\-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi\-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data\-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
   

  

**About The Team And What We'll Build Together**
 Kobie's Human Resources function in India is being built from the ground up as a strategic hub that will drive the teammate experience, culture, and operational excellence of our India Tech Hub. As Director, Human Resources, you are joining at a pivotal moment where you will establish the foundation for building a Top Workplace in India, one that mirrors Kobie's award\-winning culture in the US while honoring the unique needs and context of the Indian talent market and regulatory environment.
   

  

 You will report directly to the AVP, Human Resources (US\-based) and will own all people operations, compliance, and talent strategy for the India site. While you will work closely with the India Site Lead to operationalize their vision and priorities, your primary accountability is ensuring the India team experiences world\-class HR practices, clear career pathways, and a culture of belonging. You will partner with the India leadership team to bring forward their talent and organizational health concerns, and you will translate Kobie's US HR strategy into India\-specific initiatives that drive retention, engagement, and employer brand strength.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role that requires strategic thinking paired with operational rigor. You will build HR policies and processes from the ground up, navigate Indian labor law and compliance, design competitive compensation and benefits, execute talent acquisition in the India market, and create the teammate experiences that make Kobie a destination employer. You will have one direct report, a Manager, Human Resources, and the opportunity to grow this team as India expands.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
* Lead design and launch of compliant, scalable HR policies, processes, and systems aligned with Kobie's global standards. Oversee implementation and ongoing refinement
* Own the complete teammate experience from recruitment through offboarding, ensuring every touchpoint reflects Kobie's values across onboarding, performance management, development, relations, and engagement
* Establish and drive India's talent strategy and recruitment roadmap in partnership with the India Site Lead and US HR leadership. Design a world\-class candidate experience that drives measurable satisfaction. Build and maintain strong pipeline and make final\-round hiring decisions
* Design and oversee India's compensation and benefits strategy, including market benchmarking, salary bands, incentives, and benefits packages that attract and retain top talent competitively and compliantly
* Build a cohesive organizational culture that instills purpose and belonging. Drive engagement initiatives, win celebrations, and recognition programs aligned with Kobie's core values
* Partner with the India Site Lead to operationalize strategic priorities: employer branding and communications, office operations and teammate programs, culture and organizational health, talent development, and cross\-functional collaboration
* Collaborate with India's leadership team to identify and address organizational health concerns (morale, retention, engagement, conflict). Provide guidance, coaching, and resources to help leaders develop their teams and navigate people challenges
* Establish and maintain HR compliance across all India operations: payroll, benefits, statutory requirements, leave management, and labor relations in adherence with Indian employment law and company policies
* Develop direct reports and build HR team capability. Identify learning and development opportunities, provide feedback and coaching, and foster a growth culture as India expands
* Partner with US HR functions to align India initiatives with global strategy while reflecting local needs. Collaborate on tools and processes implementation. Escalate decisions to the AVP, Human Resources
* Track HR metrics including headcount growth, retention rate, time\-to\-fill, quality of hire, offer acceptance rate, offer\-to\-join conversion rate, engagement survey results, and compliance status. Provide regular updates to US leadership and use data to inform continuous improvement
* Anticipate India site needs as the team grows and organization evolves. Identify gaps in processes, tools, or resources and propose solutions proactively. Demonstrate agility in response to changing business priorities
* Serve as the primary HR voice in US\-India leadership forums, communicating site health, opportunities, and challenges while maintaining global HR alignment


**Required**
**What You Need to Be Successful**
* 10\-12 years of HR experience, with a minimum of 5\-6 years in an HR leadership or senior management role overseeing multiple functions (HR Operations, Talent, Compliance, or equivalent scope)
* Deep expertise in Indian labor law, employment regulations, statutory compliance, and payroll/benefits administration. Demonstrated ability to navigate India's complex and evolving regulatory environment
* Proven track record designing and implementing HR policies, processes, and systems. Experience building HR infrastructure from the ground up in a scaling organization preferred
* Demonstrated expertise in compensation and benefits strategy, including market research, salary benchmarking, benefits design, and total rewards planning
* Strong talent acquisition and talent strategy expertise. Experience sourcing, recruiting, and retaining talent in competitive markets. Familiarity with India's tech and talent landscape a strong plus
* Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills. Ability to influence leaders at multiple levels, manage up effectively, and build cross\-functional alignment. Comfort with frequent check\-ins and asynchronous communication across time zones
* Strong people leadership and coaching skills. Ability to attract, develop, and retain HR talent. Experience building high\-performing teams in early\-stage or rapidly scaling environments
* Forward\-thinking and AI\-savvy. Comfort with emerging HR technologies and AI\-enabled tools. Ability to drive AI\-informed thinking and innovation in people practices


**Strongly Preferred**
* Experience in a startup or scale\-up environment where HR infrastructure was built or significantly expanded. Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities
* Experience with US reporting relationship and global HR alignment. Experience supporting international operations or managing cultural bridges between regions
* Proficiency with ADP and Lever
* Strong spreadsheet and data analysis skills


**About Kobie**
 Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth\-focused culture.
   

  

 As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy\-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award\-winning culture to a new region \- creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.
   

  

 We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
   

  

 Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
   

  

 To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well\-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work \- recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work\-life balance.
   

  

 As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.
   

  

 Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.

**1\. Recruitment \& Hiring** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process across various functions and levels.

* Coordinate offer rollouts, negotiations, documentation and joining formalities.

**2\. Onboarding \& Orientation** 



* Own and continuously improve the employee onboarding process from offer acceptance through joining.
* Coordinate pre\-joining documentation, background verification and other joining formalities.
* Ensure all new employees complete the required HR and statutory documentation.
* Conduct HR induction and orientation sessions covering company culture, policies, processes, benefits and employee guidelines.
* Coordinate with IT, Admin, Finance and respective business teams to ensure a smooth joining experience.
* Ensure employee information is accurately updated in HR systems and personnel records.



**3\. Employee Engagement** 



* Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives that strengthen employee connect, culture and team spirit.
* Work closely with the internal engagement/HR team to organize celebrations, events, activities and employee connect initiatives.
* Support initiatives around employee recognition, communication and workplace culture.
* Gather employee feedback and identify opportunities to improve employee experience.
* Support employee connect initiatives across different offices and teams.
* Contribute to creating a positive, inclusive and collaborative work environment.



**4\. Personnel Documentation \& HR Administration** 



* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee personnel records and documentation.
* Ensure timely completion of joining, confirmation, transfers, promotions, salary revisions and separation documentation.

**5\.** 
**Exit \& Offboarding**

* Ensure timely issuance of relieving, experience and other separation\-related documents.

* Act as a point of contact for employees on HR\-related queries and processes.

 Our client is a leading global healthcare organisation with an established presence across the Asia\-Pacific region. As part of a wider HR transformation, the organisation is establishing a Regional HR Shared Services Hub in Bangalore to deliver consistent, efficient and technology\-enabled HR services across APAC.
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced HR Shared Services leader to build and lead this new regional hub. This is a key leadership position responsible for setting up the operating structure, transitioning HR activities from multiple countries and developing a high\-performing team of approximately 20 HR specialists.

* Establish and lead the APAC HR Shared Services Hub in Bangalore, including its operating structure, processes and governance framework.

* Define service levels, performance measures and escalation processes to ensure consistent service delivery.
* Monitor shared services KPIs and implement improvements across HR processes and workflows.
* Standardise HR operational processes while ensuring compliance with local employment requirements and data governance standards.
* Drive the adoption of HR systems, workflow automation and AI\-enabled HR tools.
* Partner closely with regional HR leaders, country HR teams and senior business stakeholders throughout the transition.
* Build a customer\-focused culture based on accountability, service quality and continuous improvement.
* Identify operational risks, resolve service issues and maintain high standards across the hub.



  





**Requirements** 



* Strong HR leadership experience within a shared services, regional HR operations or multi\-site environment.
* Proven experience building an HR shared services team or regional service hub from the ground up.
* Demonstrated success leading and developing sizeable HR operations teams.
* Strong understanding of operational HR processes, employment regulations, HR compliance and data governance across multiple markets.

* Proven ability to improve HR service delivery and shared services performance metrics.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across HR and the wider business.

* Resilient, solutions\-oriented and able to maintain high operational standards.
* Fluent in English.

 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in designing and implementing Performance Management Systems (PMS), developing Goal Sheets, KRAs and KPIs, conducting performance reviews, identifying capability gaps and driving targeted training programs.
 



  





 The role requires a strategic yet hands\-on HR professional who can work closely with leadership and business teams to align employee performance with organisational objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Performance Management System (PMS)** 




 ● Design, implement and continuously improve the organisation's PMS framework.
 



 ● Develop and standardise Goal Sheets, KRAs and KPIs across departments and roles.
 



 ● Work with functional heads to translate business objectives into measurable employee goals.
 



 ● Establish clear performance metrics, weightages and evaluation criteria.
 



 ● Drive goal\-setting, mid\-year reviews, annual appraisals and performance discussions.
 



 ● Ensure PMS timelines and processes are followed consistently across departments.
 



 ● Analyse performance data and identify trends, gaps and improvement areas.
 



 ● Support managers in conducting objective and effective performance evaluations.
 



 ● Identify high performers, low performers and critical talent through performance data.
 



 ● Develop Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) wherever required.
 



  





**KRA \& KPI Development** 




 ● Create role\-specific KRAs and KPIs aligned with business objectives.
 



 ● Review existing KRAs/KPIs and recommend improvements based on changing business requirements.
 



 ● Ensure KPIs are SMART – Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant and Time\-bound.
 



 ● Define appropriate weightages and scoring mechanisms for different roles.
 



 ● Create performance scorecards and evaluation frameworks.
 



 ● Partner with department heads to ensure accountability and measurable outcomes.
 



  





**Training \& Development** 




 ● Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) based on PMS results, business requirements and competency gaps.
 



 ● Develop and execute annual training calendars.
 



 ● Design training programs for leadership, functional, behavioural and professional development.
 



 ● Coordinate internal and external trainers as required.
 



 ● Measure training effectiveness through feedback, assessments and post\-training performance.
 



 ● Build development plans for high\-potential employees and critical talent.
 



 ● Support succession planning and career development initiatives.
 



  





**HR Analytics \& Reporting** 




 ● Develop PMS and training dashboards for management review.
 



 ● Track department\-wise and employee\-wise performance trends.
 



 ● Prepare periodic reports on performance, training, capability gaps and development initiatives.
 



 ● Provide data\-driven recommendations to leadership.
 



 ● Maintain accurate and confidential PMS and training records.
 



  





**Stakeholder Management** 




 ● Partner with senior leadership and department heads on performance management.
 



 ● Coach managers on goal setting, feedback and performance evaluation.
 



 ● Facilitate performance review discussions where required.
 



 ● Drive adoption and consistency of PMS across the organisation.
 



 ● Act as a subject matter expert on performance management and employee development.
 



  





**KRAs – Key Result Areas** 




**KRA Key Deliverables** 




**PMS Design \& Implementation** 
 Effective PMS framework implemented and continuously improved
 



**Goal Setting** 
 Clear, measurable and role\-specific Goal Sheets across departments
 



**KRA \& KPI Framework** 
 Standardised KRAs/KPIs aligned with organisational objectives
 



**Performance Reviews** 
 Timely completion of appraisal and review cycles
 



**Performance Analytics** 
 Accurate analysis of employee and department performance
 



**Training \& Development** 
 Effective training programs based on identified capability gaps
 



**Training Effectiveness** 
 Measurable improvement in knowledge, skills and performance
 



**Talent Development** 
 Development plans for high\-potential and critical talent
 



**Manager Capability** 
 Managers enabled to conduct effective goal\-setting and
 



 performance reviews
 



**HR Reporting** 
 Accurate PMS, training and performance dashboards for
 



 management
 



  





**KPIs – Key Performance Indicators** 




  





**Performance Management** 




 ● PMS Completion: 100% completion of goal\-setting and appraisal cycles within defined timelines.
 



 ● Goal Sheet Coverage: 100% employees with approved and documented Goal Sheets.
 



 ● KRA/KPI Quality: 95%\+ KRAs and KPIs meeting defined SMART criteria.
 



 ● Goal Alignment: 90%\+ goals demonstrably aligned with departmental/business objectives.
 



 ● Performance Review Completion: 95%\+ completion within the scheduled review period.
 



 ● PIP Effectiveness: Track and report measurable improvement for employees under PIP.
 



 ● Manager Adoption: 90%\+ adherence to PMS processes and timelines by managers.
 



  





**Training \& Development** 




 ● Training Plan Execution: 90%\+ of annual training calendar completed as planned.
 



 ● Training Participation: 90%\+ participation in mandatory training programs.
 



 ● Training Effectiveness: 85%\+ average participant satisfaction/effectiveness score.
 



 ● Training Needs Closure: 90%\+ identified critical capability gaps addressed through targeted interventions.
 



 ● Post\-Training Improvement: Demonstrable improvement in skills/performance for priority training programs.
 



  





**HR Analytics \& Reporting** 




 ● Reporting Accuracy: 98%\+ accuracy in PMS and training reports.
 



 ● Dashboard Timeliness: 100% reports submitted within agreed timelines.
 



 ● Data Integrity: 100% confidentiality and accuracy of employee performance records.
 



 ● Management Insights: Regular actionable recommendations based on performance and training data.
 



 Candidate Profile
 



 ● 10–15 years of experience in HR, with strong hands\-on experience in Performance Management and Training \& Development.
 



 ● Proven experience designing and implementing PMS frameworks.
 



 ● Strong expertise in drafting Goal Sheets, KRAs, KPIs, scorecards and appraisal frameworks.
 



 ● Experience working closely with senior leadership and functional heads.

 ● Strong MS Excel/Google Sheets and HR dashboarding capabilities.
 



 ● Ability to work independently, influence stakeholders and drive process adoption.
 



 ● Real Estate industry experience preferred, but strong candidates from other industries will be considered.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For**

title: Senior People Partner (HRBP)
description:
SmartBear delivers application integrity for modern tech stacks, ensuring continuous, measurable assurance that software just works as intended with governance to operate at AI speed and scale. SmartBear offers deep test automation, API lifecycle management, and observability capabilities. With integrations across the SDLC, it sets a new quality standard for application delivery teams.
   

  

 SmartBear is trusted by developers, testers, and software engineers across 32,000 organizations, including 75% of the largest financial institutions and industry leaders such as Adobe, JetBlue, and Microsoft. SmartBear’s open source tools are downloaded more than 100 million times a month and have earned over 30,000 GitHub stars from the developer community. With its best\-loved brands, including Swagger, TestComplete, Reflect, QMetry, Zephyr, and more, SmartBear meets customers where they are to make our technology\-driven world a better place. Learn more at
 
 www.smartbear.com
 
 , or follow us on
 
 LinkedIn
 
 ,
 
 X
 
 , and
 
 Reddit
 
 . 
   

  

 At SmartBear, you will be part of a dynamic team solving one of the most critical challenges facing modern businesses: ensuring the integrity of software in an AI\-driven world. Whether you are working directly with customers, driving go to market strategies, supporting operations, building products, or enabling teams, your contributions help shape the future of software quality for organizations worldwide. Join us in our mission.
 



**Senior People Partner (HRBP)** 




 This is a pivotal role for SmartBear's India operations, combining hands\-on HRBP partnership with company\-wide accountability for statutory compliance. As HRBP to your assigned function, you'll partner with senior business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with business priorities, coach leaders on talent, performance, and organizational effectiveness, and drive strategic people initiatives that build high\-performing, engaged, and inclusive teams. You'll also serve as India's statutory compliance expert, owning alignment with Indian labor law across all India\-based SmartBear employees including those outside your HRBP client group, regardless of function or reporting line, in partnership with our Sr. Director of Global People Operations. 
 



**About the Role:** 



* Partner with business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with organizational goals and translate business priorities into actionable people plans.
* Coach and advise managers on performance management, employee development, organizational design, compensation, and employee relations.
* Analyze employee engagement survey results and develop action plans with leaders.
* Develop and implement talent retention strategies that enhance employee experience.
* Serve as a trusted advisor, influencing leaders through data, business insight, and People \& Culture expertise.
* Collaborate across the People \& Culture organization to deliver consistent, scalable, and impactful people programs.
* Partner with global People \& Culture teams to adapt enterprise\-wide programs to local legal and cultural context.
* The successful candidate will work from our Bengaluru, India office in hybrid model.



**India Statutory Compliance (all India employees):** 



* Own compliance with Indian labor law — including the Industrial Relations Code, Shops \& Establishments Act, and related regulations — for every India\-based employee, regardless of which function or HRBP they are otherwise supported by, serving as SmartBear's go\-to expert on India employment regulation.
* Partner with the Director of Global People Operations, Legal, and other HRBPs to maintain visibility into employment actions (hiring, compensation changes, terminations) across functions, so compliance risk is caught even outside your direct client group.
* Serve as the single point of accountability and escalation for India regulatory questions raised by other HRBPs or business leaders.



**We are looking for you if you have:** 



* 8\+ years of experience in a senior People Partner or HR Business Partner role, ideally within a high\-growth technology environment.
* Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to develop and implement strategic People \& Culture initiatives.
* Strong expertise in performance management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience analyzing employee engagement data and translating insights into measurable action plans.
* Excellent communication, coaching, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* A passion for building inclusive, high\-performing teams and creating exceptional employee experiences.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor law, statutory compliance, and HR regulatory requirements is required, given this role's company\-wide compliance ownership.
* Experience working as part of a global, distributed People \& Culture team is a plus.
* A background in people operations — including HR systems, processes, and policy administration — is a plus.



**Why you should join the SmartBear crew:** 
  
 


* You can grow your career at every level.
* We invest in your success as well as the spaces where our teams come together to work, collaborate, and have fun.
* We love celebrating our SmartBears; we even encourage our crew to take their birthdays off.
* We are guided by a People and Culture organization \- an important distinction for us. We think about our team holistically – the whole person.
* We celebrate our differences in experiences, viewpoints, and identities because we know it leads to better outcomes.



**Did you know?** 



* Our main goal at SmartBear is to make our technology\-driven world a better place.
* SmartBear is committed to ethical corporate practices and social responsibility, promoting good in all the communities we serve.
* SmartBear is headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices across the world including Galway Ireland, Bath, UK, Wroclaw, Poland and Bangalore, India.
* We’ve won major industry (product and company) awards including B2B Innovators Award, Content Marketing Association, IntellyX Digital Innovator and BuiltIn Best Places to Work.



*SmartBear is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for employees where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that reflects a diversity of thought and experience as well as our values of being smart, open, driven, accountable, and curious.*

**Job Description**
