title: Associate Manager, HRBP
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

***Associate Manager, HRBP***
**The Role**
 As an Associate Manager, HR Business Partner, you will be the key People Partner for a business/function within the Business Org, owning the people agenda for your span end\-to\-end with 3\-5years of Experience.
   

  

 You will partner closely with the Functional Head and leaders across the business to understand business priorities, identify people opportunities and independently drive people interventions on the ground. This role is highly hands\-on, with a strong focus on execution, while requiring the ability to bring a broader organisational lens to people decisions.
   

  

**You Will**
* Own the People Agenda: Independently drive people priorities and conversations for your span, with partnership from the HRBP Lead and a broader organisation lens.
* Partner with the Business: Develop a strong understanding of the business, its priorities, teams and people challenges, and translate business requirements into relevant people interventions.
* Be the People Pulse on the Ground: Build meaningful relationships across levels through regular employee connects, 1:1 conversations and active engagement with employees and managers. Surface concerns early and proactively act on emerging themes.
* Drive Transformation: Partner with the business through organisational changes, leadership transitions, restructuring, team build\-outs, workforce planning and evolving ways of working.
* Influence through Insight: Use people data to identify trends, hotspots and risks, and translate these insights into clear recommendations and actions for managers and leaders.
* Build, Not Just Run: Identify opportunities to improve people practices within the business and independently drive relevant projects and interventions based on the key themes emerging within your function.


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Talent Management: Drive talent initiatives for the function, identify critical and high\-potential talent, and partner with leaders on relevant talent actions and interventions.
* Attrition \& Retention: Analyse attrition trends, identify red areas and proactively flag high\-risk cases. Partner with leaders to build and execute interventions focused on retention of critical and top talent.
* Voice of Razors / eNPS: Own the Voice of Razors survey action planning for your function. Deep dive into results, identify key themes and hotspots, work with leaders to build action plans and track progress.
* Employee Engagement: Drive employee engagement initiatives across your span, including employee connects, townhalls and other interventions that strengthen employee experience, culture and connection with the organisation.
* People Insights \& HR Metrics: Analyse relevant people metrics to identify trends, risks and opportunities across the function. Use data alongside on\-ground employee insights to provide clear recommendations and points of view to managers and leaders.
* Business Unit People Projects: Identify and independently drive people projects based on key themes emerging within the function. These could span talent, engagement, retention, manager effectiveness, org effectiveness, ways of working or other business\-specific priorities.
* HRBP for the Function: Serve as the key People point of contact for the allotted span. Build trusted relationships with employees, managers and leaders and provide an informed people perspective on business and people decisions.
* Stakeholder Management: Partner closely with the Functional Head and relevant managers to identify people opportunities, influence decisions and drive interventions through to successful execution.
* Workforce Planning: Partner with business leaders on workforce planning aligned to business priorities, organisational changes and future capability requirements.
* Employee Cost / AOP: Own AOP management of Employee Cost for the respective span, partnering with business stakeholders to ensure people investments and workforce plans remain aligned to business requirements.
* Change Management: Support the organisation through transformation by assessing people implications, proactively identifying risks and driving effective communication and execution of people interventions.
* Performance \& Manager Enablement: Partner with managers on people\-related priorities including performance conversations, goal setting, employee development, difficult conversations and other manager capability requirements.
* 3Ps – Policy, Process \& Practices: Drive effective adoption and implementation of People policies, processes and practices within the function, while identifying opportunities to simplify, improve and build better ways of working.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of proven HRBP experience, preferably in a fast\-paced, high\-growth or transformation\-oriented environment.
* Experience independently partnering with and supporting 200–400 employees across multiple levels of seniority.
* Strong business acumen: You understand that an HRBP is a business partner first. You are able to understand business priorities and connect people interventions to business outcomes.
* High ownership \& bias for action: You don't wait to be told what to do. You identify opportunities, take initiative and move quickly from problem identification to action.
* Strong stakeholder management \& influencing skills: You are comfortable partnering with senior stakeholders, influencing managers and driving outcomes without relying on formal authority.
* Highly employee\-centric: You build genuine relationships with employees, are approachable and trusted, and are comfortable being deeply on the ground with the teams you support.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change: You thrive in evolving environments, can operate without complete answers and are able to navigate organisational transformation with agility.

Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work, building a better and more sustainable world. Join our extraordinary team today!
   

  

 The Service Delivery Manager (HR Operations, including HCM AMS and related non\-AMS services) is accountable for end\-to\-end service delivery across the HR Operations domain. The scope combines the business operations of employee lifecycle administration with Application Management Services (AMS) for the company HCM landscape and the related services outside AMS that are required to deliver complete, stable, and effective HR Operations outcomes. The role integrates HR process delivery, application support, service\-provider performance, controls, data quality, and continuous improvement through a retained\-outsourced operating model.
   

  

****Your Impact:****
* End\-to\-End Service Ownership: Own end\-to\-end service delivery for the HR Operations domain, including employee lifecycle administration, organizational and personal data transactions, HR case and request fulfilment, employee and manager support, and the enabling HCM services. Ensure the combined HR Operations, HCM AMS, and related non\-AMS service landscape meets agreed quality, availability, timeliness, compliance, control, and employee\-experience expectations. Maintain clear end\-to\-end accountability across retained HR teams, outsourced HR Operations, HCM AMS, related non\-AMS providers, HRIS product owners, and other resolver groups, without assuming ownership of policy design or business data ownership assigned elsewhere.
* HCM AMS and Related Non\-AMS Service Management: Govern HCM AMS delivery, including incidents, service requests, defects, problem management, application monitoring, maintenance, minor enhancements, releases, and operational support within the contracted AMS scope. Govern the related non\-AMS services needed for complete HR Operations delivery, such as integrations, interfaces, identity and access dependencies, reporting support, data services, release coordination, specialist technical support, and services delivered under separate contracts or internal ownership. Ensure effective triage, routing, ownership, handoffs, escalation, and resolution across AMS and non\-AMS boundaries, with no gaps or duplicated accountability between providers and internal teams.
* Vendor \& Contract Management: Manage the operational performance of outsourced HR Operations providers, HCM AMS providers, and relevant non\-AMS service providers. Monitor end\-to\-end service performance against SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, contractual commitments, service scope, and business outcomes, including dependencies that span multiple providers. Lead integrated service reviews, operational governance, escalation forums, and corrective\-action follow\-up across the HR Operations service ecosystem.
* Governance, Risk \& Compliance: Ensure HR Operations services and HCM support activities operate in accordance with applicable controls, data\-privacy requirements, security standards, global policies, and locally defined legal requirements. Coordinate audit evidence, control execution, access reviews, operational risk treatment, data\-privacy requirements, and remediation across retained and outsourced services. Own major service escalations affecting employees, managers, HR teams, payroll or downstream processes, ensuring effective business communication and sustainable resolution.
* Financial \& Budget Responsibility: Review provider invoices, resource consumption, charges, and deliverables against contracted scope and approved demand. Support budget monitoring, forecasting, capacity planning, and demand management across HR Operations, AMS, and related non\-AMS services. Identify opportunities to reduce avoidable demand, eliminate service overlap, optimize sourcing, and improve cost\-to\-serve without weakening service quality or controls.
* Continuous Improvement \& Transformation: Drive standardization, automation, knowledge improvement, shift\-left, self\-service, and simplification across HR processes and their enabling HCM services. Improve employee and manager self\-service adoption while ensuring appropriate assisted\-service channels and support for exceptions. Coordinate operational readiness, service transition, testing support, knowledge transfer, release acceptance, and stabilization for HCM changes that enter AMS or affect related non\-AMS services.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with HRIS product owners, HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Finance, Security, Data Privacy, Enterprise IT, Procurement, and service providers. Coordinate operational readiness for HCM releases, organizational changes, annual HR events, provider transitions, and other changes affecting HR Operations demand, data, integrations, or system stability. Provide integrated service\-performance insights, trend analysis, root\-cause findings, risks, capacity views, and recommendations covering HR Operations and the supporting AMS and non\-AMS landscape.


****Your Experience And Qualification:****
* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, Information Systems, Operations, or a related discipline

* Experience governing end\-to\-end HR Operations services and HCM AMS, including incidents, requests, problems, changes, releases, provider handoffs, controls, and related non\-AMS dependencies

 repeatable, and scalable.
 



 This role will build MPC's L\&D function from 0 to 1: creating a system where every new hire becomes floor\-ready quickly, every store
 



 operates to the same standard, and high\-performing frontline employees have a clear path to leadership.
 



 This is a hands\-on role that works closely with Operations to translate SOPs into practical training and continuously improve
 



 standards using frontline insights.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Build \& Own the L\&D Function
 



 • Design and establish MPC's Learning \& Development function end\-to\-end
 



 • Develop the L\&D strategy, training calendar, documentation, and standardized systems aligned with expansion plans
 



 • Create training standards that can be consistently implemented across locations
 



 2\. Frontline Training \& Module Development
 



 • Build role\-specific modules for kitchen, counter/service, delivery packing, hygiene, food safety, and operational SOPs
 



 • Develop practical training content, assessments, checklists, and on\-floor evaluations
 



 • Continuously update modules based on operational requirements and feedback
 



 3\. New Store \& New Hire Training
 



 • Build standardized new\-hire onboarding that gets employees floor\-ready within defined timelines
 



 • Create a new\-store training program to ensure teams are ready before launch
 



 • Work with Operations and HR to plan manpower and training requirements ahead of openings
 



 4\. Train\-the\-Trainer Program
 



 • Build a train\-the\-trainer framework across MPC outlets
 



 • Identify and develop Store Managers and high\-performing employees as internal trainers
 



 • Equip trainers with guides, assessments, and coaching tools so stores can independently train as MPC scales
 



 5\. Career Growth \& Internal Talent Development
 



 • Build a clear frontline career path such as Crew → Shift Lead → Store Manager
 



 • Define competencies and development requirements for progression across levels
 



 • Identify high\-potential employees and build an internal pipeline for store leadership
 



 6\. Training Effectiveness \& Quality Measurement
 



 • Establish measurable training\-readiness metrics, audits, skill assessments, and certification processes
 



 • Track training completion, assessment scores, operational performance, and recurring gaps
 



 • Use store audits, practical checks, and frontline feedback to continuously improve training
 



 7\. SOP \& Operations Partnership
 



 • Partner closely with the GM – Operations to convert new and revised SOPs into structured training
 



 • Ensure operational changes are communicated and embedded through training
 



 • Use recurring training gaps and frontline feedback to improve SOPs and execution
 



 8\. L\&D Systems \& Scalability
 



 • Evaluate and implement suitable LMS, digital learning, and assessment tools where required
 



 • Build systems that scale across locations without requiring a dedicated trainer at every outlet
 



 • Maintain a centralized repository of training modules, SOPs, assessments, and certification records
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




  





 Must\-Have Skills
 



 • 7\+ years of overall experience with significant experience in Learning \& Development
 



 • Senior L\&D/training experience within an organized, multi\-location F\&B/QSR business
 



 • Strong experience designing training modules, not only delivering pre\-existing content
 



 • Proven experience training frontline teams across multiple outlets and supporting new\-store openings
 



 • Experience building train\-the\-trainer and frontline career\-progression frameworks
 



 • Strong understanding of outlet operations and frontline employee challenges
 



 • Hands\-on, analytical, and comfortable spending significant time at outlets while working closely with Operations
 



 Good to Have
 



 • Experience with an LMS or digital learning platform
 



 • Instructional design or digital training\-content experience
 



 • Experience building scalable training systems during rapid expansion
 



  





**Reporting Structure** 




  





 Reports to: Founder (Jash Arora)
 



 Works closely with: GM – Operations, HR, Store \& Area Managers, and functional teams
 



 Owns: Frontline training systems, new\-hire and new\-store training, train\-the\-trainer, career development, and training effectiveness
 



  





**Why MUMBAI PAV CO.** 




  





 • Build the L\&D function from 0 to 1 with real ownership over how frontline capability is developed
 



 • Multi\-city expansion underway — create training systems that can scale across new stores and markets
 



 • Work closely with Operations and leadership to directly influence store standards and people development
 



 • Build an internal leadership pipeline and shape career growth for frontline teams

title: Lead Process Specialist - HR Policy & Compliance
description:
**About Target**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers. Our purpose—helping all families discover the joy of everyday life—is brought to life through our values, culture and commitment to our guests, communities and team members.
   

  

 Joining Target means being part of a culture grounded in care, growth and winning together. We value diverse perspectives, encourage authentic connections and create an environment where every team member can contribute, grow and make a meaningful impact.
   

  

**Overview Of Target In India**
 Target in India is an integral part of Target’s global organization, bringing together more than 5,000 team members in Bengaluru who contribute to enterprise\-wide strategy, technology, data, product, operations and business capabilities.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Target Human Resources plays a critical role in building the high\-performing, diverse and engaged teams that power Target’s strategy and guest experience. Supporting team members across stores, supply chain and headquarters, HR serves as a strategic partner to the business—shaping organizational capability, strengthening leadership and creating an environment where team members can grow and thrive.
   

  

**About this Opportunity** 
 The
 **HR Policy \& Compliance team** 
 is responsible for supporting compliance with applicable employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies. As a member of the HR Compliance team, you will be responsible for the day\-to\-day execution and administration of assigned statutory and HR compliance activities.
   

  

 This role will focus on ensuring timely completion of statutory filings, remittances, payments, maintenance of statutory records and registers, resolution of Team Member queries, and accurate compliance documentation. The role will work closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to support effective and timely compliance execution.
   

  

 As a Lead process specialist, you'll take the lead in:
   

  

**Statutory Compliance Execution**
* Ensure timely and accurate filing of statutory returns, remittance of statutory contributions, and completion of compliance\-related payments within prescribed timelines.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, returns, challans, certificates, and other compliance\-related documentation as required under applicable laws.
* Maintain and monitor compliance calendars and trackers to ensure timely completion of statutory and internal compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, HR Operations, and other relevant stakeholders to obtain and validate information required for statutory compliance activities.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders and external consultants/vendors to ensure timely completion and closure of assigned compliance activities.
* Support periodic reconciliation and validation of statutory contributions, payments, and related records and identify discrepancies for resolution.


**Provident Fund and Team Member Support**
* Handle Team Member queries related to Provident Fund (PF) and other assigned statutory compliance matters and provide accurate and timely resolution.
* Support PF\-related processes, including contribution reconciliation, remittances, UAN\-related activities, documentation, and resolution of discrepancies.
* Coordinate with Payroll, HR Operations, and relevant stakeholders to investigate and resolve PF\-related issues.
* Escalate complex, sensitive, or high\-risk compliance matters to senior members of the HR Compliance team.
* Manage Compliance mailbox and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure the queries are resolved


**Compliance Records and Reporting**
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date compliance trackers, records, and supporting documentation.
* Prepare compliance MIS, reports, dashboards, and data required for periodic reviews.
* Conduct periodic reviews of compliance records and documentation to identify missing information, discrepancies, or potential compliance gaps and support their resolution.
* Ensure appropriate record retention and organization of compliance\-related documents.


**Audits, Inspections and Regulatory Support**
* Support internal and external audits, statutory inspections, and regulatory inquiries by coordinating and providing required records, data, and documentation.
* Track audit findings and compliance action items and follow up with relevant stakeholders to support timely closure.
* Assist in preparing documentation and information required for responses to regulatory notices and other statutory requirements.


**Process and Operational Support**
* Support the implementation of changes to statutory processes, compliance requirements, and internal procedures under the guidance of senior members of the HR Compliance team.
* Identify recurring process gaps, documentation issues, or operational inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
* Support other HR compliance activities and projects as assigned.


**HR Crisis Management**
* Support the identification and tracking of potential HR crisis scenarios at TII in liaison with relevant stakeholders, including maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date crisis management data, records, and trackers.
* Support the coordination and execution of HR crisis management processes, including timely communication and documentation in accordance with established protocols.
* Maintain and update crisis management records, emergency contact information, and related documentation.
* Support periodic reviews and reporting of HR crisis management data and action items.


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Law, or a related field.
* 3–4 years of relevant experience in statutory compliance, HR compliance, payroll, HR operations, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of applicable Indian labour and employment laws and statutory compliance requirements.
* Knowledge of Provident Fund and other employment\-related statutory requirements is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple compliance activities and deadlines.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong documentation, record management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders.
* Self\-driven approach, Problem\-solving ability with adherence to deadlines and tight timelines
* Experience in project tracking (setting up a project plan, managing risk and issue logs, reporting, and governance.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a corporate environment with established HR and compliance processes.
* Experience with statutory compliance processes, compliance calendars and trackers, reconciliations, reporting, and audit documentation.
* Knowledge of or certification in statutory compliance, labour laws, or HR compliance.
* Hands\-on experience managing PF\-related processes, reconciliations, UAN\-related activities, and Team Member queries.
* Experience coordinating with Payroll, Finance, HR Operations, Legal, external consultants, vendors, or similar cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Exposure to internal/external audits, statutory inspections, or regulatory documentation would be an advantage.

title: Total Rewards Manager - APAC [T500-29503]
description:

 We are one of the world’s largest nutrition companies and a global leader in human and animal nutrition. We unlock the power of nature to provide nourishing quality of life by transforming crops into ingredients and solutions for foods, beverages, supplements, livestock, aquaculture, and pets.
 



  





**About ADM India Hub:** 




 At ADM, we have long recognized the strength and potential of India’s talent pool, which is why we have maintained a presence in the country for more than 25 years. Building on this foundation, we have now established ADM India Hub, our first GCC in India.
 



 At ADM India Hub, we are hiring for IT and finance roles across diverse technology and business functions. We stand at the intersection of global expertise and local excellence, enabling us to drive innovation and support our larger purpose of unlocking the power of nature to enrich quality of life.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 The
 **Total Rewards Lead – APAC** 
 serves as a strategic partner to regional HR and business leaders, providing governance, oversight, and advisory support for compensation, benefits, and recognition programs across the Asia\-Pacific region.
 



 Reporting to the
 **Director, Global Compensation** 
 , this role is responsible for ensuring regional rewards programs align with ADM's global Total Rewards philosophy, governance standards, and business objectives while addressing local market conditions, workforce needs, and regulatory requirements across multiple APAC jurisdictions. The role promotes consistency, compliance, and operational excellence through effective governance, stakeholder engagement, and regional oversight.
 



  





**Title Total Rewards Manager \- APAC** 




**Location** 
 :
 **ADM Capability Center** 




**Role Overview:** 




 The
 **Total Rewards Lead – APAC** 
 works closely with the
 **Global Compensation Center of Excellence (COE)** 
 to support the implementation of global compensation frameworks, policies, governance standards, and reward programs throughout the region. The role partners with the COE on compensation strategy, job architecture, market benchmarking, annual compensation planning, and other global initiatives, while providing regional insights and recommendations to address APAC\-specific talent and business needs.
 



 For benefits and wellbeing programs, the role oversees the governance and strategic direction of regional benefit offerings and serves as the key liaison with ADM's Captive Insurance team and Aon as the global benefits broker. In partnership with country HR teams, the role supports benefits harmonization efforts, vendor governance, risk management, market competitiveness, and cost optimization initiatives, while local implementation and administration remain the responsibility of in\-country teams.
 



  





 The position provides consultative support to HR Business Partners, Recruiting, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders on compensation and benefits matters, leveraging data, market intelligence, and regional expertise to develop recommendations that enhance the employee value proposition and support business objectives. The role also oversees regional recognition program governance and supports initiatives that strengthen employee engagement and retention.
 



 The
 **Total Rewards Lead – APAC** 
 collaborates extensively with the Global Compensation COE, regional HR leaders, Finance, Payroll, and external partners to strengthen governance, drive continuous improvement, and ensure the effective delivery of Total Rewards programs across APAC. This role requires a balance of strategic leadership, influence, and operational oversight to support organizational priorities and deliver a competitive and sustainable rewards experience for employees throughout the region.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 




**Compensation Strategy \& Program Management:** 



* Lead the development and execution of the APAC Total Rewards strategy, ensuring alignment with global frameworks, governance standards, and regional business objectives.
* Partner closely with the Global Compensation COE to implement compensation programs, policies, and initiatives across the region.
* Oversee annual compensation processes, including salary planning, merit reviews, incentive programs, and equity cycles.
* Conduct market benchmarking and compensation analyses using external surveys and market data to ensure competitiveness.
* Support pay governance by promoting equitable and consistent compensation practices across roles, geographies, and employee populations.
* Partner with HR and business leaders on job architecture, job evaluations, leveling, and career framework initiatives.



  





**Benefits \& Wellbeing Programs:** 



* Oversee the governance, strategic direction, and policy framework for regional benefits and wellbeing programs, including health, retirement, leave, and financial wellbeing offerings.
* Establish benefits governance standards and ensure regional programs are aligned with ADM's overall Total Rewards philosophy, business objectives, and financial stewardship requirements.
* Partner with in\-country HR teams to provide strategic guidance and oversight while supporting local implementation and administration of benefits programs.
* Serve as the primary liaison with the ADM Captive Insurance team and Aon as the global benefits broker to support program financing, risk management, market benchmarking, and benefits strategy development.
* Drive regional benefits harmonization and governance efforts where appropriate, balancing global consistency with local market requirements, regulatory considerations, and workforce needs.
* Oversee benefits vendor governance, including broker and provider performance management, contract oversight, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Review market trends, risks, and opportunities and provide recommendations to enhance the employee value proposition through sustainable, competitive, and compliant benefits programs.
* Monitor program effectiveness through governance reviews, analytics, and stakeholder engagement to support informed decision\-making and continuous improvement.



  





**Governance, Compliance \& Risk Management:** 



* Ensure compliance with local labor laws, tax regulations, statutory benefits requirements, and compensation\-related legislation across APAC countries.
* Establish and maintain governance frameworks, policies, and controls for compensation, benefits, and recognition programs.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, Payroll, and HR stakeholders to mitigate compliance and operational risks.
* Support audits, regulatory reporting, and documentation requirements related to Total Rewards programs.



  





**Business Partnership \& Advisory Support:** 



* Serve as the primary Total Rewards partner for APAC HR Business Partners, leaders, and key stakeholders.
* Provide expert consultation on compensation decisions, employment offers, promotions, retention strategies, and workforce planning initiatives.
* Collaborate with regional leadership teams and Global Centers of Excellence to address business and talent challenges through effective rewards solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and industry networks.



  





**Analytics \& Insights:** 



* Leverage compensation, benefits, and workforce data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Develop analyses and insights to support talent attraction, retention, engagement, and workforce planning strategies.
* Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, and presentations for regional and global stakeholders.
* Provide data\-driven recommendations to support strategic Total Rewards decision\-making.



  





**Process Improvement \& Transformation:** 



* Drive continuous improvement of Total Rewards processes, tools, technologies, and operating models.
* Support HRIS, rewards technology, and reporting enhancements across the APAC region.
* Lead or contribute to regional and global compensation and benefits transformation initiatives.
* Ensure effective implementation and adoption of new programs, processes, and governance standards.



  





**Global Mobility:** 



* Manage end\-to\-end mobility programs for inbound and outbound international assignments across the APAC region.
* Partner with Global Mobility, HR, Payroll, Tax, and external providers to support assignment planning, administration, and compliance.
* Ensure mobility programs align with company policies, business needs, and local regulatory requirements.
* Provide guidance to employees and leaders on international assignment policies, relocation support, and mobility\-related benefits.



  





**Qualifications Required:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field
* 10 years of progressive Total Rewards experience, including significant responsibility across APAC markets.
* Strong knowledge of compensation practices, benefits design, and regulatory requirements across key APAC countries, including India, China, Singapore, and other major regional markets.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-country compensation, benefits, and rewards programs within the APAC region.
* Experience operating effectively within a global, matrixed organization and partnering across multiple functions and geographies.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and stakeholders, providing strategic guidance and driving business\-aligned reward initiatives.
* Strong understanding of job architecture, job evaluation methodologies, and market pricing frameworks; experience with Mercer, Willis Towers Watson, or similar methodologies preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience utilizing HR analytics, reporting, and market benchmarking tools.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data interpretation skills with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, consulting, communication, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to balance global consistency and governance requirements with local market customization and business needs.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to handle sensitive employee and compensation information with a high degree of confidentiality and professionalism.
* Experience leading or supporting compensation, benefits, HR technology, and Total Rewards transformation initiatives preferred.
* Global mobility experience supporting international assignment programs across multiple countries preferred.

 experiences.

 Operations executive.

 progress.

 learner feedback.

 and processes.
 



 4\.

 ● Create and maintain a structured training material and resource repository.
 



 ● Ensure learning resources, program documentation and relevant records are organised
 



 and updated.
 



 ● Support the creation of program reports and documentation as required.
 



 5\.
 **Stakeholder Collaboration** 




 ● Work closely with PDI Program manager, school leadership, educators and other
 



 stakeholders to understand learning needs and implement relevant interventions.
 



 ● Build positive working relationships with facilitators, participants and internal
 



 stakeholders.
 



 ● Coordinate effectively with multiple stakeholders to ensure timely design and delivery of
 



 programs.
 



  





**Required Skills** 




 ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 ● Strong facilitation and presentation skills.
 



 ● Comfortable using technology tools required for training, facilitation and program
 



 management.

 learning and development will be an advantage.

title: Associate Manager HR
description:
**About the Organization** 




  





 At
 **eGov** 
 , we start with citizens and the everyday public services that shape their lives. A parent is bringing a child to a clinic. A family waiting for water . A streetlight that finally gets fixed. In those moments, government is not policy or process—it is lived experience. We believe everyone deserves public services that are
 **accessible, responsive, and transparent** 
 —services that work consistently, reach everyone, and respect people’s time and dignity.
 



  





 To make this possible, we partner closely with governments to strengthen the foundations on which public services run. Our core approach is offering the
 **DIGIT platform** 
 \- a Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI
 **)** 
 \- that helps create shared, reusable digital systems that enable governments to plan, deliver, and monitor public services at scale. DPI is not about a single application or program; it is about creating
 **common rails** 
 that many services, departments, and partners can use over time.
 



  





 But public services do not improve solely through technology. We work with governments on
 **strategy, institutional design, and implementation** 
 , and we help build
 **ecosystems of partners** 
 that can deliver together. By aligning policy, processes, people, financing, and digital systems, we support the state to turn intent into services that work on the ground.
 



  





 Across India, Africa, and other emerging economies, we help governments move from fragmented, project\-led digitisation to
 **durable public infrastructure** 
 that belongs to the state and quietly improves public services day after day. When this works well, citizens may never see the systems behind it—but they feel the difference in how services show up in their lives.
 



  





 We currently work in 10 countries, and more than 1 billion people and hundreds of sectoral public services systems have been built on DIGIT.
 



  





 You’ll thrive here if you:
 


* Care deeply about citizens and the quality of public services
* Believe strong state capacity is essential to inclusive development
* Enjoy working across strategy, partnerships, and execution
* Want to build systems that endure beyond individual projects



  





 We are strategists, technologists, momentum builders, and partners—but above all, people committed to
 **making public services work better for everyone** 
 .
 



  





**Why Work With Us?** 




**Make Large\-Scale Impact:** 
 Contribute to initiatives that drive significant societal change at national and global levels.
 



**Learn from Experts:** 
 Gain mentorship from experienced professionals across our ecosystem.

 Be part of a team dedicated to solving real\-world problems through digital innovation.

**3\. HR Partnering (HRBP)** 



* Act as a strategic partner to organizational leaders on workforce planning and organizational design

* Provide guidance on employee relations, conflict resolution, and disciplinary actions

**4\. Talent \& Capability Development** 



* Identify skill gaps and support learning \& development initiatives
* Facilitate leadership development and capability\-building programs

**5\. HR Analytics \& Reporting** 



* Track and analyze key HR metrics (attrition, engagement, performance, diversity, etc.)

* Use data insights to drive strategic HR interventions



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:**

 **HRBP roles \+ HR Operations**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

 Interested candidates may upload their updated CV and details in the link: https://forms.gle/dV3HmTJ9DQrxDPLe8

title: HR Commercial Pilot Partner — Retention Risk Investigation & Intervention
description:
**You don't know they're going to leave.** 

  




**You just know something isn't right.** 

  






 You have an employee you really don't want to lose.
 




  






 They're valuable. They're still delivering. There hasn't been a resignation. There may not even be an obvious problem.
 




  






 But something has changed.
 




  






 Maybe their behaviour is different.
 





 Maybe their workload has become unsustainable.
 





 Maybe their engagement is slipping.
 





 Maybe they've been waiting too long for a promotion.
 





 Maybe something has changed with their manager.
 





 Maybe compensation has started bothering them.
 




  






 You don't know yet.
 




  





**And that's where the work begins.** 




  






 You start looking.
 




  






 You pull information from the HRIS. You look at performance history. You check engagement or pulse data. You look at compensation. You speak to the manager. You look at previous conversations. You search for other signals that might explain what you're seeing.
 




  






 One piece points in one direction. Another piece points somewhere else.
 




  






 So you investigate further.
 




  






 You speak to the manager again.
 




  






 You try to understand whether this is temporary or structural. Whether it's workload, compensation, career progression, management, recognition, something personal, or something you haven't even considered yet.
 




  






 Eventually, you have to speak with the employee.
 




  






 So you prepare.
 




  






 What should you ask?
 




  






 How should you approach the conversation?
 




  






 What should you avoid saying?
 




  






 How do you make sure you don't turn a sensitive retention conversation into something that actually accelerates disengagement?
 




  






 You have the conversation.
 




  






 And now you have even more information.
 




  






 But you're still left with the hardest part:
 




  





**What do I actually do about this?** 




  






 Which signal matters most?
 




  






 What is the real underlying problem?
 




  






 How serious is the risk?
 




  






 What intervention has the best chance of working?
 




  






 Do you change the workload?
 




  






 Redesign the role?
 




  






 Address compensation?
 




  






 Change something in the manager\-employee relationship?
 




  






 Accelerate a career conversation?
 




  






 Do something else entirely?
 




  






 And what happens if you get the decision wrong?
 




  






 Do nothing, and you may lose someone you could have retained.
 




  






 Act incorrectly, and you may make the situation worse.
 




  






 Meanwhile, there are other employees, other managers, other business problems and other HR priorities waiting for you.
 




  






 And then another employee needs investigating.
 




  






 And another.
 




  






 And another.
 




  






 This is the retention job HR is already being paid to do.
 




  






 The problem isn't that HR doesn't know how to retain people.
 




  





**The problem is how much manual intelligence work sits between noticing a problem and knowing what to do about it.** 




  






 Today, getting this job done can mean moving between multiple systems, gathering fragmented information, speaking with multiple people, connecting weak signals, interpreting incomplete evidence, preparing conversations, documenting what happened, deciding what action to take and then following up to see whether that action actually worked.
 




  






 The HRBP is doing the job.
 




  





**But the intelligence required to do the job is fragmented around them.** 




  






 That's the thing we're trying to change.
 




  




**What if you could move through that same situation without having to carry all of that manual intelligence work yourself?** 

  






 Imagine facing that same employee with Mindpex.
 




  






 Instead of searching across different systems for the information you need,
 
**Mindpex brings the relevant information together in one place** 

 — so you can start investigating the situation without first having to assemble the pieces yourself.
 




  





 Instead of manually piecing scattered signals together,
 **Mindpex lets you investigate the employee as one retention case** 

 — with the information and context connected around that case.
 




  





 Instead of wondering what to ask or how to approach a sensitive conversation,
 **Mindpex gives you conversation guidance and a game plan for that particular situation** 

 — so you know how to approach the conversation and what to avoid.
 




  





 So you don't walk into the conversation guessing.
 



  





**You have a game plan.** 




  






 You have the conversation.
 




  






 Then, instead of having to manually make sense of everything you just heard,
 
**Mindpex helps interpret the conversation in the context of the employee's other signals and information** 

 — so you can understand what the conversation means for the case.
 




  





 Instead of reaching the hardest question —
 **“What do I actually do now?”** 

 — and having to work out the intervention yourself,
 
**Mindpex helps identify the underlying issue, the intervention to consider, and the actions to take in that particular context.** 




  






 And instead of starting the investigation over every time new information emerges,
 
**you can keep adding context to the same case** 

 — allowing the investigation and guidance to become more refined as you learn more.
 




  





 So the job is still the same.
 



**You are still investigating the employee.** 




**You are still having the conversation.** 




**You are still making the decision.** 




**You are still responsible for the outcome.** 




  






 But the obstacles between
 
**“something has changed”** 

 and
 
**“I know what to do about it”** 

 are no longer yours to navigate manually at every step.
 




  





**Mindpex helps you make progress through the job.** 




  





**The HR professional remains the decision\-maker. Mindpex does the intelligence work around that decision.** 




  






 It helps turn scattered signals and conversations into a structured retention case — so you can spend less time piecing the situation together and more time actually doing something about it.
 




  




**That's what we're testing.** 

  






 Not whether another HR dashboard looks interesting.
 





 Not whether AI can generate another HR report.
 




  





**Whether Mindpex can actually get this retention job done better than the way you're doing it today.** 




  






 We're looking for our first
 
**commercial pilot partners** 

 .
 




  





 If you are currently employed in an HR/People role and you recognize this problem from your own work, we want to test Mindpex with you.
 



  





 This is a
 **paid commercial pilot run by your organization.** 




  






 Your organization would pay Mindpex to run the pilot on a real retention problem it is facing. The purpose is simple:
 
**test whether Mindpex can actually help your team get this job done better in practice.** 




  






 This is not a free feedback exercise, and
 
**we are not paying you to participate.** 




  






 You will be able to use Mindpex on a real retention problem in your organization and determine for yourself whether it creates enough value to become part of the way you do this work.
 




  






 If you read the situation above and thought:
 




  





**“Yes. We do this manually.”** 




  





**“Yes. This takes far more time and cognitive effort than it should.”** 




  





**“Yes. We have had situations where we had all the information but still weren't sure what to do.”** 




  






 Then we'd like to hear from you.
 




  





**If your organization is willing to pay for a commercial pilot to test whether Mindpex can solve this problem, apply below.**

 If you're the right person, currently employed in the right organization, genuinely dealing with this problem and able to move forward with a software purchase, we'll contact you.

title: Human Centered Change Manager
description:
**Description**
 As a Manager, Human\-Centered Change Management, you will serve as a strategic advisor, partnering with Salesforce customers to optimize platform value realization through the design and implementation of change strategies that prioritize the human aspect of transformative change. Working collaboratively with customers and Salesforce delivery teams, you will drive impactful team dynamics, cultivate awareness, and secure alignment with a unified change vision. Leading essential change management and enablement initiatives, you will establish the groundwork for successful and enduring change adoption, using AI\-enabled delivery practices. Additionally, you will provide guidance, coaching, and mentorship to members of the project team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Change Leadership:**
* Partner with customers to develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies aligned with organizational goals and Salesforce platform implementation.
* Analyze the human impact of technological changes and develop adaptive strategies to address organizational challenges.


**Proactive Engagement And Team Building**
* Proactively foster high\-impact team dynamics, building awareness and securing buy\-in for shared change objectives.
* Collaborate closely with customers and Salesforce delivery teams to ensure alignment and commitment to the change vision.


**Key Change Management Initiatives**
* Lead critical change management and enablement activities to facilitate successful and sustained change adoption.
* Design and implement tailored training programs for stakeholders at all levels to ensure effective utilization of Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to align user experience design with change management strategies, ensuring user\-centric adoption of Salesforce solutions.


**Oversight And Mentoring**
* Provide oversight, coaching, and mentoring to project team members, guiding them in executing change management strategies effectively.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and development within the project team.
* Facilitate the integration of change management processes into Salesforce.com projects.
* Work closely with Salesforce.com administrators, BAs, Solutions Architects and developers to understand system changes and ensure alignment with change management strategies.
* Support team upskilling in user experience principles to strengthen collaboration with design teams and improve the effectiveness of training, communications, and adoption strategies.


**Qualifications**
* Prosci Certification or equivalent is mandatory, with demonstrated expertise in change management and training within the context of technology implementations. Salesforce experience is highly desirable.
* Background in technology or digital transformation projects, showcasing advanced problem\-solving abilities and analytical acumen.
* Minimum of 5 years of dedicated experience in change management, with a strong foundation in Instructional Design.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* Awareness and practical exposure to AI\-enabled delivery tools (e.g., Gemini, Notebook LM, Claude) and an Agentic Delivery mindset.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field is required. A Master's degree is considered advantageous.


**Overview**
 The Manager, Human\-Centered Change Management, is a pivotal leader who drives transformative change within organizations by prioritizing the human aspect of change and ensuring alignment with organizational goals and Salesforce platform capabilities. If you are a seasoned Change Management Professional with a track record of success in guiding organizations through complex technology implementations, we invite you to apply and contribute to our mission of driving impactful and sustainable change.

title: HRIS Senior Associate -  Data, Reporting & Testing
description:
**Summary:** 




 The Indus HRIS Senior Associate – Techno\-Functional Data, Reporting \& Testing plays a critical role in enabling scalable, compliant, and audit\-ready HR data operations within Oracle HCM as the organization expands across countries, legal entities, and integrated systems. This role combines
 



 functional HR process understanding with technical HRIS execution, owning expanded responsibilities across HR reporting rationalization, country\-specific regulatory and audit reporting (including ISQM\-equivalent requirements), and complex testing efforts supporting entity onboarding and integrations.
 



 The Senior Associate operates with a high degree of independence may serve as a bridge between HR, Compliance, and IT by translating business and regulatory requirements into technical reporting logic, data validations, and testing outcomes.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Techno\-Functional Reporting \& Data Ownership** 



* Own and enhance HR reporting solutions within Oracle HCM (OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts), translating functional HR and regulatory requirements into technical report logic.
* Collaboration on the rationalization, standardization, and streamlining of existing HR reports by assessing business usage, aligning data definitions, and eliminating duplication across countries and entities.
* Design and support country\-specific regulatory, compliance, and audit reporting, including requirements aligned to ISQM\-equivalent control frameworks.
* Perform advanced data analysis and reconciliation, validating report outputs against Oracle HCM source data and downstream integrations.
* Define and maintain functional and technical documentation, including data definitions, report logic, transformation rules, and checkpoints.



**Testing \& Integration Validation** 




 Participate and/or lead end\-to\-end testing efforts for new country/entity onboarding, configuration changes, and HR system integrations.
 



 Develop and execute detailed test scenarios and scripts that reflect real HR business processes (hire, transfer, termination, organizational changes) and country\-specific variations.
 



 Validate integrations through source\-to\-target testing, ensuring accuracy of employee, assignment, organizational, and regulatory data.
 



 Own defect triage, root cause analysis, and retesting, partnering with HRIS, IT, and vendors through resolution.
 



 Coordinate and execute regression testing for reporting, extracts, and integrations following releases or configuration changes.
 



**Controls, Audit \& Risk Management** 



* Support HRIS control frameworks by ensuring reporting and testing processes meet documented control standards and audit expectations.
* Prepare and maintain audit\-ready evidence, including reconciliations, test results, report logic, and approvals.
* Proactively identify data and control risks introduced by new countries, entities, or integrations and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR systems, reporting accuracy, and data controls.



**Stakeholder Partnership \& Functional Leadership** 



* Act as a techno\-functional SME for HR reporting and testing within the HRIS team.
* Collaborate with IT and integration teams to align functional requirements with technical solutions (APIs, extracts, downstream feeds).
* Mentor Associate\-level team members and contribute to continuous improvement of HRIS reporting and testing standards.



  





**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications:** 



* 4–7\+ years of experience in HRIS, HR technology, or HR data roles with both functional and technical responsibilities.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle HCM data structures and reporting tools.
* Demonstrated experience owning testing activities for HR processes, integrations, or multi\-entity implementations.
* Ability to translate business, regulatory, and audit requirements into technical reporting and testing solutions.
* Proven experience working in audit\-sensitive, controlled environments.
* Experience supporting multi\-country HR implementations and local regulatory reporting.
* Strong documentation, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Demonstrates the ability to effectively prioritize competing priorities and pivot focus as business needs evolve, particularly in response to regulatory deadlines, country/entity expansion, and integration\-driven dependencies.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Advanced experience with OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL.
* Exposure to system integrations (payroll, benefits, IAM, finance, data warehouse/ODS).
* Familiarity with ISQM or equivalent quality, audit, or control frameworks.
* Basic SQL or data querying skills for validation and analysis

Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

**About The Role**
 People Services is where Ethos shows up for its employees every day, and this role leads it. As Manager, People Services, you'll lead the team that handles the high\-volume, transactional work that keeps the employee lifecycle running, and you'll hold it to the highest quality bar. Reporting to the Director, Global People Operations, you'll set delivery and quality standards, manage service levels, and make sure every employee interaction is timely, accurate, and genuinely helpful. Because this work is transactional and repeatable by nature, a core part of your role is spotting and prioritizing the workflows that should be automated, then partnering with our People Product Manager to bring those automations to life. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who takes pride in operational excellence and believes a stellar employee experience is built on consistent flawless execution.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and develop the People Services team, setting clear goals, managing capacity and workload, and building a high\-performing, service\-minded culture.
* Own delivery and quality standards for high\-volume transactional People work across the employee lifecycle (onboarding, employee changes, records, offboarding, and employee queries), holding the team to the highest accuracy bar.
* Define, manage, and report service levels: response and resolution times, SLAs, and quality scores.
* Ensure a stellar employee experience in every interaction, timely, accurate, empathetic, and easy.
* Continuously assess workflows to identify, prioritize, and scope the ones that should be automated, partnering with the People Product Manager to design and deploy those automations and agents.
* Manage case handling and routing within the tiered service model, resolving at the People Services tier where possible, escalating complex cases to experts, and driving deflection to self\-service.
* Build and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and quality controls so execution is consistent, compliant, and repeatable across regions.
* Monitor volume trends and root causes, reducing recurring tickets through process fixes, better documentation, and automation.
* Ensure data accuracy and integrity in our People systems for every transaction the team handles.
* Handle escalations and sensitive cases with discretion and sound judgment.
* Partner with HR Technology, People Partners, and centers of excellence to align on process, systems, and clean handoffs.
* Support compliance and data governance across the markets the team serves.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* 5\+ years in People/HR Operations, shared services, or service delivery, including direct team leadership or people management.
* Proven track record running high\-volume transactional work to a high quality and accuracy standard.
* Experience defining and managing SLAs, quality metrics, and day\-to\-day service delivery.
* Strong process\-improvement instinct: able to spot and prioritize what to automate and partner effectively on building it.
* Employee\-experience mindset, with a bias for making interactions easy and getting the details right.
* Comfort leveraging People systems and workflow or case\-management tools, and partnering with HR Technology rather than administering systems directly.
* Familiarity with AI or automation in an operations context is a plus.
* Excellent communication and people\-leadership skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive situations and maintain strict confidentiality.
* Bachelor's degree required.


**Shift Schedule**
* Mid\-shift: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
   

  

 To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
   

  

***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

title: Learning and Development Manager
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3\.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5\.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
   

  

 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
   

  

 With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Harness Talent Experience, Development and Impact team is seeking a dynamic and results\-driven Learning and Development Manager to join our team in our Bangalore, India office. You’ll partner with the VP, Talent Experience, Development and Impact, People and Places team and key business stakeholders, to address the enablement needs of the 500\+ team members in Bangalore and across India, spotting friction points, building highly engaging learning programs, and tracking ROI to prove their impact. The ideal candidate will operate like a product owner for learning: knowing the business, knowing your clients, and pinpointing where to add value and resolve friction. As a Learning and Development Manager, you will play a key role in fostering a high\-performance culture and ensuring our workforce remains competitive and future\-ready. You'll own these programs end to end — from needs identification through design, delivery, and measurement — accountable for outcomes, not just execution.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Stakeholder Partnership \& Business Alignment**
* Partner with the VP, Talent Experience, Development and Impact, the People Business Partners, India Talent Team and key business stakeholders to build deep partnerships, understand organizational and employee development needs and priorities, and deliver global and India\-specific programming.
* Collaborate across the People and Places team to keep programs globally consistent while adapting for local needs in Bangalore and beyond.
* Collect and analyze post\-course data to assess learning impact, and share findings with leadership to inform decisions.
* Communicate program goals, timelines, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders across the business, so everyone knows what's coming and why.
* Lead and support special projects.


**Training Program Delivery**
* Design, implement, facilitate, and evaluate learning programs, including workshops, asynchronous learning modules, and enablement and leadership development initiatives.
* Deliver engaging, impactful learning sessions in both virtual and in\-person settings.
* Own all course logistics — classroom and virtual coordination, materials, and related arrangements — to ensure sessions and programs run smoothly.
* Conduct assessments to identify skill gaps, development needs, and untapped potential across the organization.
* Own the LMS (currently LinkedIn Learning) end\-to\-end — backend administration, content curation, troubleshooting, and reporting — and develop and implement adoption strategies that drive usage, completion rates, and a strong learner experience.


**Program Evaluation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Hold regular check\-ins with the VP and key stakeholders to review participant feedback and course evaluations.
* Turn that feedback into concrete changes — recommend and implement improvements each cycle, not just report on them.


**Career \& Development Support**
* Partner with managers and HR to help employees build career development plans
* Act as the go\-to resource for employees and managers on available learning and development opportunities, required and recommended.
* Stay current on emerging learning technology and bring innovative tools into development programs.
* Measure the effectiveness of talent development programs using data\-driven approaches.


**Requirements**
**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Education, Business, or a related field.
   

  

**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in talent development, training, learning \& development, or a related role.
* Experience in designing and delivering enablement programs.
* Hands\-on experience administering an LMS — backend configuration, content management, troubleshooting, and reporting; LinkedIn Learning experience a plus.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple complex learning initiatives at the same time, at scale.


**Skills**
* Strong facilitation, coaching, and presentation skills.
* Instructional design and curriculum development skills — able to build programs, not just deliver them.
* Data analysis and reporting skills, with the ability to translate learning metrics into business insights and ROI.
* Proficient in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other e\-learning tools. LinkedIn Learning preferred.
* Product owner, business\-partnering approach — able to diagnose organizational needs and translate them into learning solutions.
* Solid grounding in adult learning principles.
* Strategic and analytical thinking — able to spot patterns across data and turn them into a point of view.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, across all levels of the organization.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and project management skills.
* Comfortable working collaboratively across all levels of the organization.


**Harness In The News**
* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5\.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale \| Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success


 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
   

  

 At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness\-privacy.relyance.ai/
   

  

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
 We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
   

  

 Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
   

  

 If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job\-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

 Leverage your HR domain expertise to map complex, traditional People processes and re\-architect them into highly efficient, multi\-step agentic workflows that optimize operational efficiency and enhance the quality of process execution.

 Work closely with the Lead, People Ops AI Strategy,

 The

You will be hands\-on in the platform specifically leveraging Google Gemini Enterprise, Workday \& Custom Agents to build, test, and maintain the autonomous workflows that will modernize our day to day operations. * Direct, hands\-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining custom\-coded and low\-code/no\-code AI automations, specifically with AI agent platforms (experience with Workday Agents and Google Gemini Enterprise Agents is highly preferred)..
* Advanced proficiency in prompt engineering, with a deep understanding of Large Language Model (LLM) behaviors, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and data grounding techniques.
* Strong background in systems administration, HRIS configuration, or technical process automation (experience with Workday architecture is a strong plus).
* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements from HR stakeholders into functional, technical AI workflows.
* Meticulous attention to detail with strong skills in technical writing, process mapping, and system documentation.
* Understanding of enterprise data privacy standards, role\-based permissions, and compliance within a highly secure or regulated enterprise environment.
* A builder's mindset: highly analytical, resilient in troubleshooting, and passionate about creating seamless digital experiences.

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected, and opinions count. As part of the Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function, you’ll play a vital role in supporting HSBC’s second line of defence, ensuring robust risk management and operational excellence across the Group.
   

  

 The Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function is HSBC’s Second Line of Defence, responsible for reviewing and challenging the activities of the Group’s businesses to ensure effective risk management.
