title: HR Business Partner - BLR
description:
Who Are We?
   

  

 RZR is an AI\-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full\-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose\-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
   

  

 We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
   

  

 RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M\&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 As Sr. HR Business Partner (People Business Partner) at RZR, you will serve as the primary strategic People partner for our teams in India, working directly with regional leadership to align people strategy with business goals. This role is critical to enabling planned growth by building strong people practices, driving performance, ensuring compliance, and improving day\-to\-day organizational effectiveness in\-region.
   

  

 This is a highly embedded, hands\-on role. You will work alongside GMs and functional leaders to manage employee relations, run performance cycles, build retention programs, and shape how the organization scales — with a clear mandate to make people decisions that move the business forward.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep HRBP experience, strong commercial instincts, and the confidence to influence and challenge senior leaders. This role offers high visibility and direct impact on how a key international market grows and performs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 People Partnership
   

  

* Serve as the primary People Partner for the India region, partnering closely with regional leadership to align people strategy with business goals and planned growth
* Drive retention and reduce attrition by proactively identifying talent risks and implementing data\-informed interventions
* Own and execute the end\-to\-end performance management lifecycle, including goal setting, 90\-day reviews, performance cycles, and talent planning
* Establish and reinforce a high\-performance culture with clear expectations, accountability, and differentiation across teams
* Act as a trusted advisor and coach to managers and senior leaders, providing candid guidance on performance, organizational design, and employee engagement
* Lead and manage complex employee relations matters, ensuring timely resolution, risk mitigation, and compliance with local labor laws and regulations
* Operate as a hands\-on partner across the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and day\-to\-day employee support
* Maintain HRIS data integrity, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely updates to support reporting, compliance, and decision\-making
* Identify opportunities to improve and scale People Operations processes, driving efficiency, consistency, and impact
* Leverage HR systems and data to generate insights, inform decision\-making, and enhance overall people practices
* Partner cross\-functionally to ensure alignment and execution of people initiatives across regions


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in a People Partner or Senior People Partner role, preferably in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments (ad tech, gaming, tech, or similar)
* Strong experience supporting international teams, with direct experience in India strongly preferred
* Proven track record managing core HRBP responsibilities including performance management, talent planning, and complex employee relations within local regulatory frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands\-on individual contributor, balancing strategic partnership with day\-to\-day execution
* Experience coaching and influencing senior leaders, with the ability to provide direct, candid feedback and drive decision\-making
* Strong knowledge of local labor laws and employment practices, with the ability to navigate compliance and mitigate risk effectively
* Experience driving process improvements and scaling people programs in growing organizations
* Proficiency with HR systems and tools such as BambooHR, Lattice, or CultureAmp, and comfort using data to inform people decisions
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Experience in ad tech, programmatic advertising, gaming, or platform technology environments
* Exposure to scaling a People function from early\-stage to structured operations
* Experience supporting teams across multiple Indian cities or geographies


 Why Join RZR?
   

  

* High\-impact, embedded ownership — not a shared services role — you will be the sole Sr. HR Business Partner for the India region, with a direct line to regional leadership and a real mandate to shape how the business runs from a people perspective.
* Own the full HRBP scope — performance management, employee relations, retention, organizational design, talent planning, and manager capability are all yours to own and build, not manage from a distance.
* Autonomy to build from scratch — you will have the freedom to design programs, improve processes, and create structure where none exists today, with the visibility to influence decisions at leadership level.
* True strategic partnership in a performance\-driven environment — without the politics of a large HR function. Your work has direct bearing on how the India region grows and performs.
* A function that keeps growing — as the region scales, this role becomes the foundation for a broader People team, with a clear path toward leading it.


 RZR Behaviors
   

  

 RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership
   

  

* Move Fast
* Drive for Excellence
* Proactive Communication
* Courage
* Curiosity
* Deliver Results
* Manage Ambiguity

**Description**
 At Amazon, HR Partners (HRP) provide high\-judgment HR support to managers across levels at scale, enabling them to become force multipliers for customer impact and positive employee experience. They demonstrate advanced knowledge of HR policies, processes, and tools, acting as trusted consultants to managers and senior managers. HRPs work backwards from the voice of the manager to deliver personalized experiences and drive large\-scale initiatives using technology and simplified processes that match the speed and agility of our business. They operate independently as subject matter experts with deep knowledge of regional programs and policies, collaborating extensively with PXT teams including HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Legal, and others to provide integrated people solutions. As established practitioners, they mentor junior team members and shape best practices across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers and senior managers collaborate with Senior HR Partners to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. The Sr. HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes at the country or regional level. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, Sr. HRPs are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders. Sr. HRPs are also expected to partner on complex global and regional strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives. As a subject matter expert, Sr. HRPs mentor and guide junior team members.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Performance Management: Partner with managers on complex and nuanced performance management cases including performance improvement plans and assessments. Guide managers in implementing performance management processes and tools effectively. Partner with managers to ensure bias\-free evaluations and effective coaching approaches across teams. Analyze performance data to identify trends, share insights, and develop solutions for systemic issues.
* Employee Relations: Handle complex and nuanced employee relations cases and investigations following established processes and policies. Conduct thorough and impartial investigations, support grievance processes, and lead informal discussions or mediation. Provide guidance to managers on sophisticated ER matters including policy violations and workplace concerns across countries. Partner with Legal and Employee Relations teams to resolve sensitive cases while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation. Analyze investigation findings, prepare recommendations, and identify trends to prevent future risks.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Drive implementation of employee programs and lead improvements in manager experience. Partner with HR Business Partners and central teams on complex change initiatives across countries. Use data and insights to advocate for and influence process improvements. Design and execute change management strategies to ensure effective adoption across diverse employee groups.
* Process Improvement: Drive complex strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives across India. Partner with global HRP team, other HR teams and CoEs to drive global and regional HRP strategic projects.


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool that enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives.

* Experience coaching and mentoring at the management level
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Experience in computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience working effectively across cross\-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
* Business and HR acumen, including problem solving skills, critical thinking, and self\-initiative


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources or related field with about 6\-10 years’ work experience. Proven track record of accomplishments in a dynamic environment, which is fast paced and customer driven. Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and make the best use of available resources. Project management and the ability to deliver, with a proven track record of influencing through data\-driven recommendations. Coaching and consulting skills; Ability to work with and influence multiple stakeholders. Experience in dealing with contingent workforce will be an advantage. Presentation skills and knowledge of employment laws.

* Conduct stay interviews and listening sessions; surface themes and insights to HR leadership with a clear point of view on what needs to move.

* Support the annual and mid\-year performance process \- ensuring meaningful participation, consistent execution, and clear outcomes.
* Coach managers and employees through goal\-setting, feedback, and development conversations.

* Strong employee relations instincts \- you know how to hold a difficult conversation and reach a fair outcome.
* Track record of building trusted relationships with managers and employees at all levels.
* Experience supporting talent development, career frameworks, and performance processes.
* Comfortable working in a lean team where you own your domain end\-to\-end.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS or tech company.

* You're energised by the complexity of people and organisations \- no two situations are the same and that's what keeps you engaged.
* You give advice that leaders actually take because it's grounded, practical, and delivered with confidence.
* You believe great HR partnership makes the business better, not just more compliant.

description:
A leading European manufacturer is setting up an India shared\-services centre, and the HR pillar of that centre is being built from the ground up over the next two quarters. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India, and this manufacturer has engaged Flexiple to hire the HR Manager who will lead that build.
 



**The remit** 




 This is not a caretaker role. You will design the HR operating model for a plant\-adjacent, shared\-services population that will grow from around eighty to over two hundred and fifty people, spanning finance, engineering support and customer service functions housed in the same centre.
 



**What the team is building** 



* Onboarding and induction that works for both office staff and shift\-based plant liaisons
* A performance and rewards framework aligned to the parent company's global structure but adapted for Indian market benchmarks
* HR service delivery processes, covering query management, documentation and letters, that can scale without adding headcount linearly



**How the work actually happens** 




 Expect a lot of ambiguity in month one: policies will need to be written, not just administered, and you will be the one drafting the leave policy, the travel policy and the exit process from close to nothing. You will work directly with the global HR director in Europe on anything that needs headquarters sign\-off, and with local labour law counsel on anything that does not.
 



**Who fits this** 




 You will have six to nine years of HR generalist experience, including at least one stint where you built a function rather than inherited one. Manufacturing, shared\-services or GCC background is preferred, and comfort with English and Hindi is expected given the plant\-adjacent stakeholder group, with additional regional language ability a bonus.
 



**Where you will sit** 




 This role is based in Pune or Chennai, given proximity to the manufacturing footprint, with Remote (India) workable for a candidate willing to travel to site every few weeks.
 



**Getting there** 




 The process runs through an initial HR conversation, a task where you sketch out a real policy, a round with the plant and functional stakeholders, and a final conversation on fit.
 



 Flexiple will also keep this profile in view for other India HR\-build mandates as they open, beyond this one role.

title: Lead - People intelligence
description:
**Lead, People Intelligence:\-**
 A senior analytics role at the heart of People Intelligence \& Tech Transformation. You will turn Sapiens' people, commercial, and organisational data into the intelligence that helps leaders see the company clearly and decide with evidence. This is hands\-on analytical work — you model, analyse, and tell the story. You are fluent with modern AI tools and comfortable inside HR systems, and you use both to do sharper analysis, faster.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**People intelligence on large, complex data**
* Work with large, multi\-source HR datasets — HRIS, ATS, LMS, payroll, engagement surveys, performance, compensation — across grades, geographies, and functions.
* Run diagnostic analyses on the questions— the drivers of attrition and where it concentrates, bottlenecks and drop\-off in the hiring funnel, the relationship between organisational structure and team performance, the impact of learning on behaviour, movements in productivity, and patterns in pay etc.
* Build workforce planning and scenario models — projecting the size, shape, and cost of the workforce needed to deliver the business strategy over time, and running simulations that let leaders test different growth, structure, and efficiency scenarios against real data.
* Own compensation analytics end\-to\-end — comp\-ratio and range\-penetration analysis, internal pay equity, and bonus and total\-cost modelling.
* Design and maintain composite people metrics and indices that connect workforce data to business outcomes, with sound methodology, clear weighting, stable baselines, and a defined refresh cadence.
* Build the dashboards and reporting that leaders genuinely use — spanning headcount, attrition, hiring, internal mobility, diversity, engagement, productivity (including revenue and profit per employee), and leadership health — designed for decisions, not just for record\-keeping.


**Data storytelling**
* Turn analysis into a clear narrative — the finding, the evidence, what it means, and a recommended action — pitched for senior decision\-makers who need to act on it quickly.
* Communicate with clarity and precision in writing: a problem framed in a few sentences, a recommendation that stands on its own, and analysis documented well enough to stand up to scrutiny and be picked up by others later.
* Maintain the analytics playbook — definitions, metric logic, methodology notes, and documentation — so the work is consistent, repeatable, and easy for others to understand and build on


**What You Will Bring**
* 5–7 years across people analytics, HR analytics, or analytics consulting, with meaningful time spent analysing people or workforce data. You operate independently — someone a leader can hand a question to and trust to return with an answer that holds up.
* Comfort with large, multi\-source datasets. You have wrangled, joined, and reconciled HR data across systems and geographies, and you know how data lies when nobody is checking.
* Strong technical toolkit: advanced Excel (modelling, Power Query, statistical functions), SQL fluency, Power BI or equivalent. Python or R for data wrangling and applied statistics — pandas, numpy, scipy, statsmodels, or R equivalents.
* A strong grasp of statistical fundamentals — descriptive statistics, correlation, regression, significance testing, sampling. Enough to test a hypothesis, not just describe a number.
* Data storytelling that actually lands. You can take a complex analysis and reduce it to a one\-page narrative a non\-analytical leader will understand and act on.
* Hands\-on experience working within HRMS platforms and a strong grasp of core HR process flows — hire\-to\-retire, comp cycles, performance management, engagement surveys. You know what data lives in these systems and how the processes behind it work.
* Demonstrable, current AI fluency. You use LLMs and agentic tools every day and can talk credibly about what they do well, where they fail, and where they do not belong. You do not need to have built production AI systems; you do need to use these tools fluently to sharpen your own work.
* Sharp written and verbal communication in English.


**Nice to have**
* Experience at a global SaaS or product company.
* Exposure to survey analytics platforms — Glint, Qualtrics, or Culture Amp.
* Organisational network analysis or text analytics on unstructured HR data.
* Experience building or contributing to composite people indices.
* Working knowledge of a major HRMS — SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle HCM, or HiBob — at the level of pulling clean data out of it. You do not need to configure it; you do need to know what is in it.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust across diverse stakeholders
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; comfort working with data, reports, and basic dashboards
* Curiosity about HR analytics and digital HR tools, including interest in using AI responsibly to improve productivity
* Analytical mindset with strong problem‑solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach
* Ability to learn quickly, manage multiple tasks, and follow through in a fast‑paced, global environment
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and respect for confidentiality and data privacy
* Positive attitude with a growth mindset and enthusiasm for building a long‑term career in Human Resources



**Be Successful — Your Path** 




**First 90 Days:** 
 Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals.
 



**Six Months:** 



* Support routine HRBP activities with increasing independence across core HR programs
* Build and maintain HR dashboards and standard reports for headcount, movement, and people metrics
* Contribute to at least one engagement or culture initiative, from planning through post‑event analysis
* Demonstrate ability to use Oracle HCM, collaboration tools, and at least one AI‑enabled or analytics tool
* Establish trusted working relationships with HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, and People \& Places colleagues



**One Year:** 



* Independently manage defined portions of HR cycles for assigned client groups
* Provide clear, data‑backed insights on attrition, hiring, engagement, and organization health
* Recommend at least one process improvement or automation using AI or analytics tools
* Be recognized as a reliable, detail‑oriented partner with strong stakeholder management skills
* Be considered for future opportunities within the HR function based on performance and business needs



**Belong — Your Community** 




 Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.
 



**Be Rewarded — Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong** 



* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career‑mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match
* We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications



**Ready to Be the Difference?**

 ● Building relationships (ability to generate respect and trust from others), exercising good judgement, professionalism, strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative style

title: HRBP
description:
**Company Description**
 Founded in 2018, Lokal is on a mission to strengthen hyperlocal communities by enabling its mostly non\-English users to share, interact and transact in their regional language. Lokal users gain access to hyperlocal information such as daily commodity prices, local jobs, real estate, matrimonial, local business advertorials and classifieds which would otherwise be scattered across local newspapers. The app is available in Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam and Marathi, and has 10 million downloads with a presence in 100\+ districts across South India. Having achieved unmatched user density in deep tier 2 \& 3 locations in India, Lokal has been supported by marquee investors, namely 3one4 Capital, India Quotient, Y Combinator.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview :**
 We are looking for a Senior HRBP to partner closely with GyanTV leadership and own the people's agenda across organisation effectiveness, talent, performance, manager capability, employee relations and culture.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is commercially curious, hands\-on and able to translate business priorities into practical people solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Own :**
**Business Partnership \& Organisation Effectiveness**
* Partner with leaders on business priorities, organisation design, workforce planning, role clarity and organisational challenges.
* Act as a trusted advisor while independently assessing people and business risks.


**Talent \& Performance**
* Drive talent reviews, succession, critical\-role planning, performance management and development.
* Identify capability gaps, performance trends and retention risks, and drive timely interventions.


**Manager \& Leadership Effectiveness**
* Coach managers on feedback, performance, conflict resolution, team dynamics and employee development.
* Challenge stakeholders constructively and strengthen manager effectiveness.


**Employee Experience \& Retention**
* Build employee pulse through connects, skip\-levels and engagement data.
* Identify engagement and attrition drivers and create targeted retention interventions.


**People Analytics**
* Use headcount, attrition, performance, engagement, hiring and organisation data to identify trends and recommend actions.
* Provide leaders with clear insights on organisational health and people risks.


**Employee Relations \& Culture**
* Handle complex employee relations matters with maturity, confidentiality and sound judgement.
* Support organisational changes, leadership transitions and culture initiatives.


**GyanTV Focus :**
* Partner on scaling the organisation, workforce planning and evolving capability needs.
* Strengthen performance culture, manager accountability and role clarity.
* Proactively identify talent, succession, retention and organisational risks.


**Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For**
* 5–8 years of progressive HR experience with strong HRBP ownership.
* Experience with product, content, growth, operations or consumer internet teams preferred.
* Strong business acumen and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Good understanding of organisation design, performance, talent, ER and workforce planning.
* Comfortable with people analytics, Excel/Google Sheets and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Strong judgement, ownership and ability to influence without authority.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-changing, ambiguous environment.
* MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.

**Job Title: HRBP \- Bangalore** 




**About Us** 




 “Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with
 **Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award**

 **Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by Avtar \& Seramount** 
 . With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100\+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.
 



**WHY JOIN CAPCO?** 




 You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.
 



**MAKE AN IMPACT** 




 Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.
 



**\#BEYOURSELFATWORK** 




 Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.
 



**CAREER ADVANCEMENT** 




 With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.
 



**DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION** 




 We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.
 



**Role Description:**




**Job Title: HRBP \- Bangalore** 




**Location: Electronic City , Bengaluru** 




**Overview:** 




***Role Description :***




**Job Description – HR Business Partner (HRBP)** 




**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced and people\-focused
 **HR Business Partner (HRBP)** 
 to manage end\-to\-end HR responsibilities for designated accounts/business units, drive location\-level HR initiatives, and contribute to strategic HR projects. The role will work closely with business leaders, managers, and employees to understand business requirements, provide effective HR solutions, and ensure seamless execution of people practices. initiatives.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



1. **Account / Business Partnering**


* Act as the primary HR point of contact for assigned accounts/business units.
* Partner with business leaders and managers to understand workforce requirements, people challenges, and business priorities.
* Drive key employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, career development, transfers, promotions, and exits.
* Provide HR advisory and guidance to managers on employee relations, policies, performance issues, and people matters.
* Track and monitor key people metrics and provide insights/recommendations to business stakeholders.
* Identify people\-related risks and proactively work with stakeholders to address them.


1. **Location\-Level HR Responsibilities**


* Own and drive HR initiatives and employee experience for the assigned location.
* Partner with location leadership to address workforce and employee\-related requirements.


1. **Strategic HR Projects**


* Participate in and contribute to strategic HR projects and organization\-wide initiatives.
* Support projects related to employee engagement, performance management, organization development, HR transformation, culture, and workforce planning.
* Analyze HR data and business trends to identify opportunities for process improvement and better people outcomes.
* Take ownership of specific project workstreams and ensure timely execution.


1. **Employee Relations \& Engagement**


* Build strong relationships with employees and business stakeholders.
* Handle employee grievances and workplace concerns with appropriate sensitivity and confidentiality.
* Support managers in effectively addressing employee relations and performance\-related matters.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives and gather feedback to identify areas of improvement.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and high\-performance work culture.



**Education \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification preferred.
* **5–7 years of relevant HR experience** 
 , preferably with experience in HR Business Partnering.



***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

title: Manager HRBP
description:
Manager – HR Business Partner
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Experience:** 
 5–8 Years
 



**Function:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head – Human Resources
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for a
 **Manager – HR Business Partner** 
 to partner with business leaders and managers in building a high\-performing, engaged, and talent\-driven organization.
 



 This role will be responsible for translating business priorities into
 **people strategies and interventions** 
 , with primary ownership across
 **Employee Relations \& Engagement, Talent Development, and Performance Management** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate will bring strong business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to influence leaders, coach managers, and drive people initiatives from
 **diagnosis to execution and measurable outcomes** 
 .
 



  





 What You Will Own
 



 01 \| Employee Relations \& Engagement
 



 Build a strong employee experience and create an environment where employees can perform at their best.
 


* Partner with leaders and managers to proactively identify and resolve employee and team\-level people challenges.
* Own employee relations matters including grievances, conflicts, disciplinary situations, and sensitive employee concerns.
* Build strong employee connects through structured 1:1s, skip\-level interactions, pulse checks, and engagement forums.
* Identify patterns across engagement, attrition, employee sentiment, and manager effectiveness and translate insights into action.
* Design and drive initiatives that strengthen engagement, culture, retention, and employee experience.
* Coach managers through complex people situations and enable them to become stronger people leaders.
* Act as a trusted and objective advisor to both employees and business leaders.



 02 \| Talent Development
 



 Build a strong internal talent pipeline and create meaningful growth opportunities for employees.
 


* Partner with business leaders to identify critical capabilities, talent gaps, and future talent requirements.
* Identify high\-potential and critical talent and create structured development plans.
* Drive Individual Development Plans, career conversations, internal mobility, and capability\-building initiatives.
* Partner with leaders to develop succession plans for critical roles.
* Design and implement leadership and manager development interventions.
* Identify emerging talent and create differentiated development journeys based on individual and business needs.
* Measure the effectiveness of talent interventions through defined business and people outcomes.



 03 \| Performance Management
 



 Build a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous feedback.
 


* Own the performance management agenda for assigned business functions.
* Partner with leaders and managers on goal setting, KRAs/KPIs, performance reviews, calibration, and feedback mechanisms.
* Ensure performance expectations are clear, measurable, and aligned with business priorities.
* Coach managers on delivering effective feedback and having high\-quality performance conversations.
* Identify performance gaps and drive structured interventions, including Performance Improvement Plans where required.
* Use performance data to identify high performers, underperformance, capability gaps, and talent risks.
* Strengthen a culture of continuous feedback, ownership, accountability, and performance differentiation.



  





 HR Business Partnership
 



 Beyond the core pillars, you will serve as a strategic people partner to the business.
 


* Develop a deep understanding of the business, operating model, teams, and growth priorities.
* Translate business challenges into practical and scalable people solutions.
* Partner with leadership on workforce planning, organization effectiveness, team structures, and people priorities.
* Provide data\-backed insights on attrition, engagement, performance, talent, and workforce trends.
* Challenge and influence business leaders and managers on people decisions when required.
* Drive organization\-wide HR initiatives within assigned business units and ensure strong adoption.
* Partner closely with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, L\&D, and other HR teams to deliver an integrated employee experience.
* Support organizational change and transformation initiatives as the business evolves.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



**Experience \& Background** 



* 5–8 years of experience in
 **HR Business Partnering / People Partnering** 
 , preferably in a high\-growth organization.
* Strong hands\-on experience across
 **Employee Relations, Performance Management, and Talent Development** 
 .
* Experience partnering directly with business leaders and senior people managers.
* Demonstrated experience in managing complex employee relations and performance situations.
* Experience building or improving performance management and talent development frameworks.
* Strong exposure to employee engagement and retention initiatives.



**Capabilities** 



* Strong business acumen with the ability to understand people challenges in the context of business outcomes.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong coaching and conflict\-resolution capabilities.
* Data\-driven approach to identifying and solving people problems.
* High degree of ownership and ability to operate independently.
* Strong judgment, discretion, and maturity in handling sensitive employee matters.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and continuously evolving environment.



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



 In the first 12–18 months, success in this role will be reflected through:
 


* **Higher employee engagement and stronger employee experience**
* **Improved manager effectiveness and quality of people leadership**
* **Stronger performance management discipline and accountability**
* **Improved identification and development of high\-potential talent**
* **Stronger internal talent pipeline and career mobility**
* **Effective resolution of employee relations matters**
* **Reduction in avoidable and regrettable attrition**
* **Business leaders viewing HR as a strategic partner rather than a support function**



  





 Core Competencies
 



**Employee Relations \| Employee Engagement \| Talent Development \| Performance Management \| HR Business Partnering \| Manager Coaching \| Stakeholder Management \| Talent Management \| Conflict Resolution \| Organizational Effectiveness \| Data\-driven Decision Making \| Change Management** 




  





 The Profile We Want
 



 We are looking for someone who is
 **not just an HR process owner** 
 .
 



 You should be someone who can walk into a business team, understand
 **what is happening, why it is happening, and what needs to change** 
 — and then work with leaders and managers to make that change happen.
 



**Strong HR judgment \+ Business understanding \+ Data orientation \+ Ability to influence \= Strong HRBP**

title: Principal Associate, HR Business Partner
description:
Voyager (94001\), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka
   

  

 Principal Associate, HR Business Partner
   

  

 At Capital One, we think big and do bigger things. We were the first company to develop and offer mass customization and personalization of credit card, auto loans and other financial services products, and we have been innovating relentlessly ever since.
   

  

 Today, we are a progressive financial services powerhouse spanning Credit Cards, Auto Loans, Savings, and Commercial Banking and at the same time a high\-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a well\-recognized brand all in one. We are a passionate and entrepreneurial team with heart – a team that embraces bold ideas, fosters collaboration, and delivers world\-class products and services impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder\-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change.
   

  

 At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business \- including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more \- from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale.
   

  

 Are you interested in joining a team of best\-in\-class HR consulting leaders who enable game\-changing business results by providing programs and solutions that unleash greatness in our associates? Here at Capital One you have the opportunity to work in an environment in which the business truly values the strategic HR partnership. If you have a passion for shaping the overall people strategy for the business and want to be part of a winning team, then look no further! We work in a business\-casual, collaborative environment where one’s contributions are recognized, successes are elevated and effort is rewarded. Capital One provides a fast paced, dynamic environment where you can excel in your career while still maintaining a work life balance that others will desire. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared Values, come together to make Capital One a great company – and one of the best companies to work for.
   

  

 We are hiring a Principal Associate to support key HR priorities. The Principal associate plays a critical role in identifying and executing on process improvement areas across the team along with planning, monitoring and coordinating logistics for a number of processes, such as talent management and performance management activities.
   

  

*Roles and Responsibilities:*
* Partner with clients to build effective relationships, manage stakeholders, and understand business imperatives to execute on HR solutions that are aligned to the business needs
* Lead and provide direction to People Leaders regarding Performance and Talent Experience. Support conversation with respect to talent attraction, development and retention
* Seek continuous improvements in HR policies and evaluate current processes for increased efficiencies. Reinforces policies and practices – promptly escalates and assists to resolve issues.
* Proactively explore, pilot, and integrate emerging technologies, including AI, to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of core HR processes and talent strategies
* Support the planning, delivery, and facilitation of core HR processes ranging from performance \& talent management, leadership development, change management, succession planning, all associate surveys, and organizational design
* Develop walk\-around decks, communications, data analysis, and training materials to be used in preparing managers and associates; may include facilitator or “train the trainer” sessions
* Prepare consolidated summaries for business leaders to describe outcomes of talent conversations


*Basic Qualifications:*
* MBA or Master’s Degree or PGDM Full\-time
* At least 2 years of client facing experience OR at least 2 years of consulting experience OR a combination
* At least 2 years of experience in Human Resources
* At least 2 years of experience in Google Suite products


*Preferred Qualifications:*
* Professional Human Resources Certification or Project Management Professional Certification or combination
* 3\+ years of client facing experience or 3\+ years of consulting experience or a combination
* 3\+ years of experience in in Human Resources or Human Capital Consulting
* 1\+ year of experience in Project or Process Management


*At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.*
 No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non\-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug\-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23\-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901\-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.
   

  

 If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1\-800\-304\-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.
   

  

 For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com
   

  

 Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third\-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.

title: Learning Business Partner
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Quantiphi is an AI\-first digital engineering company that leverages artificial intelligence, machine learning, and cloud technologies to solve complex business problems and drive innovation across diverse industries. They specialize in building data platforms and developing custom AI solutions, primarily on Google Cloud Platform, to deliver measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**What This Role Is** 




 This is not a training coordinator role. It is not a curriculum administrator role.
 



 We are looking for a Learning Business Partner who operates as a learning solutions architect. Someone who sits with a business unit leader, diagnoses the real capability gap, designs the intervention, builds it, ships it, and proves it worked.
 



 You will own a portfolio of internal business units. For each one, you are the single point of accountability for capability. You will understand their delivery pressures, their hiring plans, their client commitments, and their skill gaps well enough to propose solutions before they ask.
 



 You will also be expected to go outside the company for talent. When the expertise does not exist internally, you will find the practitioner who has it, reach them directly, and bring them in.
 



*A partner who takes requests is a service desk. A partner who builds solutions is a multiplier. We are hiring for the second.* 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Business Partnership and Diagnosis** 



* Own a defined portfolio of business units and functions as their primary L\&D partner.
* Build direct working relationships with unit leaders, delivery heads, and practice owners. Earn a seat in their planning conversations, not just their training requests.
* Diagnose capability gaps using business evidence. Delivery metrics, client feedback, deployment readiness, attrition patterns, project staffing constraints. Not survey data alone.
* Distinguish problems that learning can solve from problems it cannot. Say so clearly when the answer is a process fix, a hiring decision, or a management conversation.
* Translate business goals into capability requirements. Translate capability requirements into learning solutions with defined outcomes.
* Challenge poorly framed requests. When a leader asks for a two\-day workshop, your job is to ask what changes on Monday if it works.



  





**2\. Solution Architecture and Build** 



* Architect end\-to\-end learning solutions across modalities. Instructor\-led, digital, cohort\-based, on\-the\-job, coaching, assessment, certification.
* Build the solution yourself. This role is hands\-on. You will write learning objectives, structure content, design assessments, build assets, and configure delivery. You will not hand a brief to someone else and wait.
* Design role\-based learning paths for technical and business roles. Data Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Cloud and Backend Engineering, Prompt Engineering, Test Automation, Business Analysis, Software Development, and roles that do not exist yet.
* Integrate AI tools, agentic workflows, and applied AI concepts as a foundational layer across solutions, not as a bolt\-on module.
* Use AI to build faster. We expect you to work with LLMs, authoring tools, and automation to compress design cycles. Craft matters. So does speed.
* Design assessment and gating logic. Every solution needs a way to tell who is ready and who is not.
* Reuse before you rebuild. Maintain a modular content library so solutions compose rather than start from zero.



  





**3\. External Practitioner Sourcing and Negotiation** 



* Use LinkedIn Recruiter fluently. Build Boolean and filtered searches, run projects, manage pipelines, track response rates, and refine sourcing strategy based on what converts.
* Identify practising experts in the market who can teach. Distinguish credible practitioners from professional trainers with thin field experience.
* Write InMail that senior practitioners actually answer. Personalised, specific, and short.
* Negotiate directly on scope, rate, delivery dates, intellectual property, and quality expectations. Close the engagement without escalating every conversation.
* Build and maintain a standing bench of external Subject Matter Experts, freelance trainers, and boutique vendors who can be mobilised at short notice.
* Manage commercial hygiene. Contracting, purchase orders, invoicing, and vendor onboarding, working with Procurement and Finance.
* Hold external practitioners to the same delivery and quality standard as internal SMEs. Exit the ones who do not meet it.



  





**4\. Delivery Ownership** 



* Be fully accountable for delivery of every solution in your portfolio. No session goes undelivered.
* Identify, engage, and manage internal Subject Matter Experts. Build a named backup for every critical session before the calendar is published.
* Bring in external SMEs, vendors, and freelance trainers when internal capacity is insufficient.
* Facilitate sessions yourself where it is the right call. You should be able to hold a room of 100 plus learners and be credible with a technical audience.
* Run multiple cohorts and parallel tracks without dropping operational quality.



  





**5\. Measurement and Impact** 



* Define success metrics with the business leader before the solution is built, not after it is delivered.
* Instrument every solution. Track completion, capability movement, and business outcome.
* Report to leadership in the language of impact. Deployment readiness, billable ramp time, certification attainment, client feedback. Not attendance counts.
* Kill solutions that do not work. Scale the ones that do.



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Work with Talent Acquisition on the capability implications of hiring plans, and share sourcing intelligence gathered from the external market.
* Work with delivery leadership on bench readiness and redeployment.
* Work with practice leads on certification targets and partner requirements.
* Contribute to the L\&D operating model. Share what you build. Improve what others built.



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 




  





**Business Partnering** 



* Proven experience acting as a strategic partner to senior business stakeholders, not an order taker.
* Ability to influence without authority. You will have no formal power over the leaders you serve.
* Comfort with commercial context. You should understand how the business makes money and how capability affects that.
* Skill in reframing requests, managing pushback, and holding a position when the evidence supports it.
* Track record of turning a vague business complaint into a scoped, measurable intervention.



  





**Solution Design and Build** 



* Exceptional instructional design skills. Strong pedagogical and aesthetic judgment. Learning experiences must be engaging, well structured, and effective.
* Demonstrated experience building structured, multi\-week programs for technical and professional audiences.
* Fluency in writing role\-specific learning objectives and converting them into practical content.
* Hands\-on ability with authoring tools, LMS platforms, assessment design, and content production.
* Experience designing for measurable behaviour change, not content completion.
* Strong understanding of adult learning principles and how to apply them under real delivery constraints.



  





**Sourcing, Negotiation, and Vendor Management** 



* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, including Boolean search, projects, InMail campaigns, and pipeline management. Working knowledge of LinkedIn Sales Navigator or comparable sourcing tools is an advantage.
* Proven track record of cold outreach to senior external practitioners with a credible response rate.
* Direct experience negotiating commercial terms with freelancers, consultants, and training vendors.
* Ability to assess practitioner credibility from a profile, a portfolio, and a thirty minute conversation.
* Experience running a vendor bench with documented backup coverage for every critical delivery.
* Comfort with contracting workflows, rate benchmarking, and procurement processes.



  





**Technical Credibility** 



* Working knowledge of foundational concepts across at least three of the following: Data Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Software Engineering, Cloud Platforms (GCP or AWS), Business Analysis, Test Automation.
* Practical familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic systems, and AI\-assisted development workflows.
* Ability to read a technical curriculum, assess its quality, and hold your own in a design conversation with a senior engineer.
* Understanding of industry certifications and technical competency frameworks.



  





**Delivery Assurance and Program Management** 



* Proven ability to identify, engage, and manage internal and external Subject Matter Experts.
* Experience building SME backup strategies that guarantee zero disruption to live delivery.
* Track record of maintaining continuity in high\-pressure, resource\-constrained conditions.
* Ability to run multiple portfolios, cohorts, and tracks in parallel.
* Strong organisational discipline across scheduling, resourcing, tracking, and reporting.
* Comfort with LMS platforms, project management tools, and reporting systems.



  





**Communication** 



* Strong written and verbal communication in English.
* Confidence presenting to senior leadership and defending a design decision.
* Skill in translating learning outcomes into business impact metrics.
* Ability to write short, sharp progress updates that a busy leader will actually read.
* Experience facilitating workshops and stakeholder alignment sessions.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* 7 to 9 years in Learning and Development, capability building, technical training, or learning consulting.
* Prior experience as a Learning Business Partner, HR Business Partner, learning consultant, or solutions architect is strongly preferred.
* Experience in a technology company, AI and data services firm, or professional services environment is a significant advantage.
* Demonstrated success building capability programs from the ground up, not inheriting and maintaining them.
* Track record of managing delivery for cohorts of 50 or more learners.
* Experience in fast\-paced, high\-growth organisations where scope changes and priorities move.
* Prior exposure to multi\-location delivery and distributed teams is a plus.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**About Us** 




 Ushur delivers the world's first Customer Experience Automation platform built specifically for regulated industries. With guardrails and compliance\-ready infrastructure, Ushur powers vertical AI Agents for healthcare, financial services and insurance.
 



 Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Ushur is backed by Third Point Ventures, Tiger Global, 8VC, Iron Pillar, Aflac Ventures and Pentland Ventures, with a sizeable Fortune 500 customer base. Our Bengaluru office is one of two principal locations and is central to how the company is built and run.
 



 We build AI agents for regulated enterprises, and we run our own operations the same way.
 



**About Ushur
 
 l
 
 Ushur GenAI**




**Title:** 
 HR Generalist
 



**Experience:** 
 2–3 years
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Hybrid
 



**Reports to:** 
 Director, People Operations
 



**About the Role** 




 The HR Generalist sits within Ushur's global Operations team — finance, accounting, legal, revenue operations, enablement and HR. The role supports the People function globally, with most day\-to\-day focus on India operations, spanning payroll and statutory administration, benefits, the employee lifecycle, compliance, recruitment and engagement.
 



 You work directly with Operations colleagues in India and the US as a peer on one global team, with shared ownership of company\-wide processes.
 



 Alongside the operational core, the role carries the People function's automation work — identifying where AI can take on repetitive tasks across hiring, onboarding and reporting, and supporting new ways of working as they are adopted across the India team. Ushur is becoming an AI\-native company, and this is where that shows up in People processes.
 



 Operational accuracy comes first: payroll correct and filings on time. The Director, People Operations reviews work carrying statutory or financial risk, with independent ownership building through the first few cycles.
 



 Three things distinguish this role. You work across the whole India People function rather than a slice of it, at a point when most people are still administering parts of it. You work on a question few practitioners at any level get near: how AI is used responsibly in decisions about people, in a business built for regulated industries. And you sit in a global Operations function, not a local support desk.
 



**AI\-Native Operations** 




 Automation is core to the Operations team's mandate, and the standard is straightforward: where a process can be run by a workflow, it should be, and a person's time should go to the parts requiring judgment. Dedicated time is allocated to this, with access to Ushur's own platform. In practice, that means:
 


* Finding repetitive tasks in People processes and automating them.
* Using AI to help with screening, scheduling, checks and reporting — with a person always making the final call on anything that affects an individual.
* Helping new joiners get comfortable with these tools from the start.



**Responsibilities** 




**Payroll and statutory compliance** 



* Run the monthly India payroll cycle — inputs, validation, and post\-payroll reconciliation — working with Finance and Director, People Operations.
* Prepare termination pay inputs and full and final settlements, including notice, leave encashment and recovery calculations, for review before release.
* Support periodic salary structure and labour code updates led by the Director, People Operations.
* Support statutory compliance across PF, EPFO, NPS and professional tax, and act as the first point of contact for employee queries on tax regimes, declarations and payslips.
* Maintain accurate employee records, leave data and reporting in the HRIS.



**Benefits and vendor management** 



* Administer the India benefits programme, including group medical insurance, OPD, meal cards and wellness initiatives.
* Manage benefits vendors : onboarding and offboarding of employees, claims escalations, invoice processing with Finance, quarterly reviews and annual renewals.
* Gather market and cost data to support annual renewals and vendor evaluations.



**Employee lifecycle** 



* Run onboarding end\-to\-end: pre\-joining documentation, HRIS workflows, induction, systems and access coordination with IT, and 30\-60\-90 plans.
* Run offboarding end\-to\-end: exit formalities, relieving and experience letters, asset and access recovery, benefits removal, final settlement coordination, and exit conversations.
* Issue employment letters and respond to employment and background verification requests.
* Administer the HRIS and improve the workflows within it.



**Talent acquisition** 



* Conduct first\-level screening for candidates against structured rubrics and present evidence\-based recommendations.
* Coordinate interview loops across India and US time zones, and keep candidates informed throughout.
* Administer and improve the applicant tracking system, and maintain hiring data and reporting.



**Compliance, policy and documentation** 



* Provide administrative support to the POSH Internal Committee, including the statutory training cadence, record\-keeping and awareness communication.
* Maintain the India People folder set as the single source of truth for the function.
* Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and responding to information requests.



**Employee experience and engagement** 



* Translate engagement survey findings into practical actions and track them through to closure.
* Run recognition programmes, milestone celebrations and engagement initiatives for the India office.
* Support all\-hands and internal communication for the India team.
* Partner with workplace and administration colleagues on office operations, and administer operational programmes such as the on\-call roster.



**Qualifications** 




**Essential** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* 2–3 years' experience in Human Resources, with broad exposure across its core functions.
* Experience supporting an employee population of comparable size, approximately 100 to 200, preferably within a startup or scale\-up environment.
* Demonstrated experience running payroll inputs, onboarding, compliance administration and employee query resolution with limited supervision.
* Exposure to recruitment, including interview coordination, candidate communication and applicant tracking system use.
* Familiarity with and enthusiasm for using AI tools to improve efficiency.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to organise and interpret significant volumes of information accurately.
* Working knowledge of Indian employment law and payroll practices.



**Attributes** 



* Receptive to feedback and able to act on it promptly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills across employees, candidates, leadership and external partners.
* Ownership\-minded, with a track record of taking tasks through to closure and escalating issues early.
* Adaptable and able to re\-prioritise at pace without compromising accuracy.
* Comfortable working with limited supervision, having run core HR processes directly rather than only in a support capacity.
* Interested in AI and automation, with practical use of AI tools to simplify repetitive work.



**Selection criteria** 



* Established use of AI tools in your daily work, with examples of what you have built. Informal work is fine; demonstrated application is required.
* A track record of identifying repetitive work and addressing it.
* The ability to explain the purpose of a process before proposing changes to it.
* A considered view on where AI should not be applied, and the reasoning behind it.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* **Company culture.** 
 A values\-driven environment built on respect, inclusion, and collaboration.
* **Paid time off.** 
 Twenty days of flexible paid time off annually.
* **Health benefits.** 
 Preventive check\-ups, medical insurance for employees and dependents, wellness sessions, and health talks.
* **Compensation and equity.** 
 Competitive compensation and stock options — a direct stake in Ushur's success.
* **Professional development.** 
 Reimbursed certifications, plus the Ushur Community's learning resources.

title: Benefits & Wellness Manager
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This role is responsible for delivering core benefit design \& planning initiatives to all plan participants by applying professional judgment, knowledge, experience and a broad perspective. The individual will be responsible for managing all aspects of retirement plans and programs including vendor management, compliance, project management, strategic planning and design and communication. In addition, the individual will be responsible for implementing, managing and developing innovative solutions that support the business unit strategy and design by applying thought leadership and their subject matter expertise.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Manager – Benefits \& Wellness will be responsible for designing, administering, and continuously improving Allstate India's employee benefits programs and wellness initiatives. This is a strategic and operational role that requires deep expertise in Indian statutory benefits, market best practices, and holistic employee wellbeing frameworks. The incumbent will partner closely with HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal, and global Total Rewards teams to deliver a competitive, compliant, and employee\-centric benefits experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Benefits Program Design \& Administration**
* Own the end\-to\-end administration of all employee benefits including Group Health Insurance (GHI), Group Term Life (GTL), Group Personal Accident (GPA), and supplemental coverage plans.
* Lead annual benefits renewals — including vendor negotiations, RFP/RFQ processes, plan redesign, and cost benchmarking — to ensure market competitiveness and fiscal responsibility.
* Manage relationships with insurance brokers, TPAs (Third Party Administrators), and wellness vendors; monitor service delivery SLAs and resolve escalations.
* Ensure seamless enrolment processes for new joiners, life events (marriage, childbirth, etc.), and annual open enrolment windows.
* Maintain and update benefits documentation, employee\-facing communications, and FAQs on the HR portal.


**Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Ensure full compliance with Indian statutory benefits including Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), Gratuity, Maternity Benefit Act, and Professional Tax.
* Monitor regulatory changes from EPFO, ESIC, IRDAI, and other authorities; proactively update programs and communicate implications to leadership.
* Liaise with statutory consultants, auditors, and government bodies as required for filings, inspections, and assessments.
* Maintain accurate records for statutory audits and coordinate responses during compliance reviews.


**Employee Wellness Strategy**
* Develop and execute a comprehensive, multi\-dimensional employee wellness strategy encompassing physical, mental, financial, and social wellbeing.
* Curate and manage wellness vendor partnerships — including EAP (Employee Assistance Programs), telehealth platforms, fitness reimbursements, and mindfulness apps.
* Drive participation in wellness programs through effective communication campaigns, challenges, and manager enablement initiatives.
* Measure wellness program effectiveness using engagement metrics, utilisation data, and employee survey insights; report findings to HR leadership on a quarterly basis.
* Champion mental health awareness within the organisation; coordinate with EAP providers to ensure accessible and confidential support for employees.


**Data Analytics \& Reporting**
* Analyse benefits utilisation trends, claims data, and cost metrics to identify opportunities for plan optimisation and cost containment.
* Prepare regular dashboards and reports for HR leadership and Finance, covering benefits spend, renewal outcomes, vendor performance, and wellness engagement.
* Conduct benefits benchmarking surveys and competitive analyses to inform the annual Total Rewards strategy.
* Support HR Analytics team with data for compensation surveys (Aon, Mercer, Willis Towers Watson) covering benefits components.


**Employee Experience \& Communication**
* Design and deliver clear, engaging benefits communication materials — total rewards statements, onboarding guides, benefits booklets, and digital content.
* Conduct benefits orientation sessions for new hires and awareness sessions for the broader employee population.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for employee benefits queries, ensuring prompt and accurate resolution.
* Collaborate with HRBPs to proactively address benefits\-related concerns raised during stay interviews, exit interviews, and pulse surveys.


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Projects**
* Partner with the Global Total Rewards team to align India benefits with global philosophy, governance standards, and reporting requirements.
* Support M\&A, workforce expansion, and restructuring activities from a benefits due diligence and integration perspective.
* Lead or participate in cross\-functional HR projects related to Total Rewards, employee experience, and digital HR transformation.
* Manage a team of 1–2 Benefits Analysts; provide coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field. MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
* Certifications in Total Rewards (e.g., WorldatWork CEB, GRP) are a strong advantage.


**Experience**
* 14 years of progressive HR experience with a minimum of 5 years in a dedicated Benefits and/or Total Rewards function.
* Proven track record in managing large\-scale Group Health, Life, and Accident insurance programs in a multinational or technology\-driven organisation.
* Experience working with statutory compliance (PF, Gratuity, ESI, etc.) in India is mandatory.
* Prior experience in wellness program design and vendor management is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to global/regional Total Rewards governance in a shared services or GCC (Global Capability Centre) environment is an added advantage.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong proficiency in HRIS platforms (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent); experience with benefits modules preferred.
* Advanced Excel skills; familiarity with data visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.
* Understanding of insurance products, actuarial concepts, and claims management processes.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory benefit regulations.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect benefits strategy to broader business and talent objectives.
* Analytical Mindset: Data\-driven approach to decision\-making; comfortable with numbers, trends, and cost modelling.
* Stakeholder Management: Skilled at building relationships across levels — from front\-line employees to C\-suite leaders.
* Execution Excellence: Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to simplify complex benefits concepts for diverse audiences.
* Empathy \& Employee Focus: Genuine commitment to employee wellbeing and advocacy for a positive employee experience.


**What We Offer**
 At Allstate India, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We are committed to providing a workplace where every employee can thrive.
   

  

* Competitive compensation and a comprehensive Total Rewards package including performance bonuses and long\-term incentives.
* Industry\-leading health and wellness benefits for employees and their families.
* Generous paid leave programs including privilege leave, sick leave, maternity/paternity leave, and bereavement leave.
* Robust learning and development programs including access to global L\&D platforms and certification sponsorships.
* A diverse, inclusive, and respectful work culture grounded in Allstate's core values.

 Allstate India Private Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of gender, caste, religion, ethnicity, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

description:
Back to jobs
   

  

 Senior HRBP
   

  

 Bangalore, India
   

  

****About Ethos****
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

****About The Role****
 As an HR Business Partner for India, you'll work closely with the Director of People – APAC to support our Bangalore based teams through a period of rapid growth. You will enable leaders to achieve their business goals through their people \- building the capacity of the organization to attract, develop, and retain talent while ensuring every decision holds up against India's statutory and regulatory framework.
   

  

 This role combines strategic HRBP partnership with hands\-on ownership of India\-specific compliance, employee relations, and operational rigor. You'll be a trusted advisor to business leaders and a steady, empathetic presence for employees, while working closely with Payroll \& Compliance, Talent Acquisition, and Total Rewards to deliver a consistent employee experience.
   

  

****Duties And Responsibilities:****
 Business Partnership
   

  

* Conduct regular cadence meetings with your assigned business unit(s), acting as the primary People point of contact for leaders and employees.
* Provide compensation and leveling guidance to business unit leaders, in partnership with Total Rewards, anchored to India market benchmarks and internal equity.
* Analyze workforce trends and metrics \- attrition, hiring, promotions, engagement \- in partnership with the People Operations team to develop solutions, programs, and policies.
* Drive business unit organizational design and talent strategy to achieve business objectives, including headcount planning and role scoping.


 Employee Relations \& Compliance
   

  

* Manage and resolve complex employee relations issues; conduct thorough, objective, and well\-documented investigations.
* Maintain in\-depth, current knowledge of Indian labor law \- including the Shops and Establishments Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Payment of Gratuity Act, POSH Act, and the New Labour Codes as they come into force \- to reduce legal risk and ensure regulatory compliance across Karnataka and any other state of operation.
* Partner with Payroll \& HR Compliance and external legal counsel as needed on statutory matters, notices, and filings.
* Own or contribute to background verification (BGV) exception handling and RAG\-based risk assessment for your business unit, in line with company policy.
* Provide day\-to\-day performance management guidance to managers \- coaching, counseling, career development, and disciplinary action \- consistent with Indian employment norms and documentation standards.
* Work closely with management and employees to improve working relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Provide HR policy guidance and interpretation, flagging gaps between global policy and India\-specific legal requirements.


 Talent, Training \& Culture
   

  

* Identify training needs for business units and individual coaching needs for people managers; monitor and follow up on training and upskilling objectives.
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes for your business unit, partnering with Onboarding \& Ops on a smooth, compliant employee lifecycle.
* Gather and report on metrics related to retention, promotion, hiring, and diversity for your client group.
* Help build and refine India People Ops systems and processes \- you'll help write a policy when one doesn't yet exist.


****Qualifications And Skills:****
* 8\+ years of experience as an HRBP, with a strong point of view on how HRBPs move a business forward; experience at a fast\-growing technology or insurance company is a plus.
* In\-depth working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance \- PF, ESI, gratuity, statutory bonus, Karnataka Shops \& Establishments Act, and the New Labour Codes. Prior exposure to a multi\-state India compliance footprint is a strong plus.
* Experience managing complex employee relations cases, including conducting investigations and resolving disputes; experience partnering with Underwriting, Engineering, or another regulated business function is a plus.
